    (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).segments = poly.segments
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zip_p1_covers_vertex
statement:
private lemma zip_p1_covers_vertex (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) (p : Vector2D)
    (hp : p ∈ (v :: vs)) :
    ∃ seg ∈ (List.zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [v])).map fun (a, b) => (⟨a, b⟩ : LineSegment),
      seg.p1 = p
proof:
:= by
  have h_map_fst : (List.zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [v])).map Prod.fst = (v :: vs) :=
    List.map_fst_zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [v]) (by simp)
  have hp_in_map : p ∈ (List.zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [v])).map Prod.fst := by
    rw [h_map_fst]; exact hp
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab_in, hab_fst⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp_in_map
  simp only at hab_fst; subst hab_fst
  exact ⟨⟨a, b⟩, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(a, b), hab_in, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: polygonToEvenGraph_toVertexSet_eq
statement:
theorem polygonToEvenGraph_toVertexSet_eq (poly : Polygon)
    (h_len : poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h_distinct : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).toVertexSet = Polygon.toVertices poly
proof:
:= by
  cases h_eq : poly.vertices with
  | nil => simp [h_eq] at h_len
  | cons v tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil => simp [h_eq] at h_len
    | cons w rest =>
      have h_poly : poly = ⟨v :: w :: rest⟩ := by cases poly; simp_all
      subst h_poly
      ext p
      simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Graph.toVertices, polygonToEvenGraph,
                 Polygon.toVertices, Polygon.segments, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_flatMap,
                 List.mem_cons, (List.not_mem_nil _), or_false, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨seg, hseg, rfl | rfl⟩
        · exact List.mem_cons.mp (zip_fst_mem v (w :: rest) seg hseg) |>.elim
            Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mp h))
        · exact List.mem_cons.mp (zip_snd_mem v (w :: rest) seg hseg) |>.elim
            Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mp h))
      · intro hp
        have hp_list : p ∈ (v :: w :: rest) := by
          rcases hp with rfl | rfl | hp
          · exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
          · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
          · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)
        obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hp1⟩ := zip_p1_covers_vertex v (w :: rest) p hp_list
        exact ⟨seg, hseg, Or.inl hp1.symm⟩

name: polygonToEvenGraph_boundary_eq
statement:
theorem polygonToEvenGraph_boundary_eq (poly : Polygon) (h_len : poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h_distinct : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).toBoundarySet = poly.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Graph.toBoundarySet, Polygon.toBoundarySet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
             polygonToEvenGraph]

name: polygonToEvenGraph_interior_eq
statement:
theorem polygonToEvenGraph_interior_eq (poly : Polygon) (h_len : poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h_distinct : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    { p : Vector2D |
        (∀ seg ∈ (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).segments,
          pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ∧
        ∀ r : Ray, r.origin = p →
          rayAvoidsGraphVertices r (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct) →
          intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct)
            % 2 = 1 } =
    { p : Vector2D |
        (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ∧
        ∀ r : Ray, r.origin = p → rayAvoidsVertices r poly →
          intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly % 2 = 1 }
proof:
:= by
  ext p; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  
  
  have h_segs : (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).segments = poly.segments := rfl
  have h_vset : (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).toVertexSet =
      Polygon.toVertices poly :=
    polygonToEvenGraph_toVertexSet_eq poly h_len h_distinct
  constructor <;> intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · refine ⟨fun seg hs => h1 seg hs, fun r hr hav => ?_⟩
    apply h2 r hr
    rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset]
    rwa [rayAvoidsVertices] at hav
  · refine ⟨fun seg hs => h1 seg hs, fun r hr hav => ?_⟩
    have hav' : rayAvoidsVertices r poly := by
      rw [rayAvoidsVertices]
      rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset] at hav
      exact hav
    have := h2 r hr hav'
    show intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct) % 2 = 1
    change (polygonToEvenGraph poly h_len h_distinct).segments.countP _ % 2 = 1
    rw [h_segs]
    exact this

name: total_ext_count_eq
statement:
private lemma total_ext_count_eq (hpi : HalfPlaneIntersection) (G : EvenGraph) :
    (G.segments.map fun seg => hpi.segExtCount seg).sum =
    (G.segments.map fun seg =>
      (if seg.p1 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0) +
      (if seg.p2 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HalfPlaneIntersection.segExtCount]

name: even_ext_contribution
statement:
private lemma even_ext_contribution (hpi : HalfPlaneIntersection)
    (G : EvenGraph) (v : Vector2D) :
    Even ((G.segments.countP fun seg => decide (seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v)) *
      (if v ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  have h_even := G.even_degree v
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h_even
  rw [hk]
  by_cases hv_ext : v ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet
  · simp [hv_ext]
  · simp [hv_ext]

name: even_cc_plus_ext
statement:
private lemma even_cc_plus_ext (hpi : HalfPlaneIntersection) (G : EvenGraph)
    (h_vertices_not_boundary : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, v ∉ hpi.toBoundarySet)
    (h_avoids_vertices : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments, ∀ q ∈ seg.toSet, q ∉ hpi.toVertexSet) :
    Even ((G.segments.map fun seg =>
      segCrossingCount seg hpi + hpi.segExtCount seg).sum)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have h_each : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments,
      Even (segCrossingCount seg hpi + hpi.segExtCount seg) := by
    intro seg hseg
    exact (hpi.segment_parity seg
      (h_vertices_not_boundary seg.p1 (G.segments_endpoints seg hseg).1)
      (h_vertices_not_boundary seg.p2 (G.segments_endpoints seg hseg).2)
      (h_avoids_vertices seg hseg)).2
  
  have h_sum_even : ∀ (xs : List ℕ), (∀ x ∈ xs, Even x) → Even xs.sum := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x tl ih =>
      intro h
      simp only [List.sum_cons]
      exact Even.add (h x (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
        (ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hy))))
  apply h_sum_even
  simp only [List.mem_map]
  rintro _ ⟨seg, hseg, rfl⟩
  exact h_each seg hseg

name: sum_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  simp [h_ne v hv]

name: single_seg_sum_eq
statement:
private lemma single_seg_sum_eq (verts : List Vector2D) (p : Vector2D)
    (h_nodup : verts.Nodup) (h_mem : p ∈ verts) (E : Set Vector2D) :
    (verts.map (fun v => (if p = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum =
    if p ∈ E then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction verts with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons] at *
    obtain ⟨h_nhead, h_nd⟩ := h_nodup
    rcases h_mem with rfl | h_mem_tail
    · simp only [ite_true]
      have := sum_zero_of_ne tl p (fun v hv => fun h => h_nhead (h ▸ hv)) E
      omega
    · have h_ne : p ≠ hd := fun h => h_nhead (h ▸ h_mem_tail)
      simp only [if_neg h_ne, zero_mul, zero_add]
      exact ih h_nd h_mem_tail

name: sum_indicator_eq_verts_sum
statement:
private lemma sum_indicator_eq_verts_sum (segs : List LineSegment) (verts : List Vector2D)
    (h_nodup : verts.Nodup) (h_cover : ∀ s ∈ segs, s.p1 ∈ verts) (E : Set Vector2D) :
    (segs.map (fun s : LineSegment => if s.p1 ∈ E then (1 : ℕ) else 0)).sum =
    (verts.map (fun v => segs.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons seg rest ih =>
    have h_cover_rest : ∀ s ∈ rest, s.p1 ∈ verts := fun s hs => h_cover s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
    have h_p1_mem := h_cover seg (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [ih h_cover_rest]
    have h1 : (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => (seg :: rest).countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) *
            (if v ∈ E then (1 : ℕ) else 0))).sum =
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D =>
            (if seg.p1 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0) +
            rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum := by
      congr 1; apply List.map_congr_left; intro v _
      simp only [List.countP_cons]
      by_cases h : seg.p1 = v <;> by_cases he : v ∈ E <;> simp [h, he]; omega
    rw [h1, show (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D =>
            (if seg.p1 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0) +
            rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum =
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => (if seg.p1 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum +
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum from by simp,
      single_seg_sum_eq verts seg.p1 h_nodup h_p1_mem E]

name: sum_indicator_p2_eq_verts_sum
statement:
private lemma sum_indicator_p2_eq_verts_sum (segs : List LineSegment) (verts : List Vector2D)
    (h_nodup : verts.Nodup) (h_cover : ∀ s ∈ segs, s.p2 ∈ verts) (E : Set Vector2D) :
    (segs.map (fun s : LineSegment => if s.p2 ∈ E then (1 : ℕ) else 0)).sum =
    (verts.map (fun v => segs.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons seg rest ih =>
    have h_cover_rest : ∀ s ∈ rest, s.p2 ∈ verts := fun s hs => h_cover s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
    have h_p2_mem := h_cover seg (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [ih h_cover_rest]
    have h1 : (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => (seg :: rest).countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) *
            (if v ∈ E then (1 : ℕ) else 0))).sum =
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D =>
            (if seg.p2 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0) +
            rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum := by
      congr 1; apply List.map_congr_left; intro v _
      simp only [List.countP_cons]
      by_cases h : seg.p2 = v <;> by_cases he : v ∈ E <;> simp [h, he]; omega
    rw [h1, show (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D =>
            (if seg.p2 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0) +
            rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum =
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => (if seg.p2 = v then (1 : ℕ) else 0) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum +
        (verts.map (fun v : Vector2D => rest.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) * (if v ∈ E then 1 else 0))).sum from by simp,
      single_seg_sum_eq verts seg.p2 h_nodup h_p2_mem E]

name: even_sum_of_even_terms
statement:
private lemma even_sum_of_even_terms (verts : List Vector2D) (f : Vector2D → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ verts, Even (f v)) : Even (verts.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction verts with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    exact Even.add (h hd (List.mem_cons_self _ _)) (ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx))))

name: even_total_ext
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HalfPlaneIntersection.segExtCount]
  have h_split : (G.segments.map fun seg =>
      (if seg.p1 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0) +
      (if seg.p2 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0)).sum =
    (G.segments.map fun seg => if seg.p1 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0).sum +
    (G.segments.map fun seg => if seg.p2 ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0).sum := by
    induction G.segments with
    | nil => simp
    | cons seg tl ih => simp [ih]; omega
  rw [h_split]
  let verts := G.toVertices.dedup
  have h_nodup : verts.Nodup := List.nodup_dedup _
  have h_p1_cover : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, s.p1 ∈ verts :=
    fun s hs => List.mem_dedup.mpr (G.segments_endpoints s hs).1
  have h_p2_cover : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, s.p2 ∈ verts :=
    fun s hs => List.mem_dedup.mpr (G.segments_endpoints s hs).2
  rw [sum_indicator_eq_verts_sum G.segments verts h_nodup h_p1_cover hpi.toExteriorSet,
      sum_indicator_p2_eq_verts_sum G.segments verts h_nodup h_p2_cover hpi.toExteriorSet]
  rw [show (verts.map (fun v => G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) *
          (if v ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0))).sum +
      (verts.map (fun v => G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v)) *
          (if v ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0))).sum =
      (verts.map (fun v => (G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = v)) +
          G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = v))) *
          (if v ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0))).sum from by
    induction verts with
    | nil => simp
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      have : (G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = hd)) +
              G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = hd))) *
              (if hd ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then (1 : ℕ) else 0) =
          G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p1 = hd)) * (if hd ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0) +
          G.segments.countP (fun s => decide (s.p2 = hd)) * (if hd ∈ hpi.toExteriorSet then 1 else 0) := by ring
      omega]
  apply even_sum_of_even_terms
  intro v _hv
  have h_deg_even := G.even_degree v
  rw [countP_or_of_disjoint G.segments G.segments_nondegenerate v] at h_deg_even
  exact Even.mul_right h_deg_even _

name: graph_crossings_even
statement:
theorem graph_crossings_even
    (hpi : HalfPlaneIntersection) (G : EvenGraph)
    (h_vertices_not_boundary : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, v ∉ hpi.toBoundarySet)
    (h_avoids_vertices : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments, ∀ q ∈ seg.toSet, q ∉ hpi.toVertexSet) :
    (∀ seg ∈ G.segments, (seg.boundaryCrossings hpi).Finite) ∧
    Even ((G.segments.map fun seg => segCrossingCount seg hpi).sum)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro seg hseg
    have hp1_nb := h_vertices_not_boundary seg.p1 (G.segments_endpoints seg hseg).1
    have hp2_nb := h_vertices_not_boundary seg.p2 (G.segments_endpoints seg hseg).2
    exact (hpi.segment_parity seg hp1_nb hp2_nb (h_avoids_vertices seg hseg)).1
  · 
    have h1 := even_cc_plus_ext hpi G h_vertices_not_boundary h_avoids_vertices
    have h2 := even_total_ext hpi G h_vertices_not_boundary
    
    
    have h_split : (G.segments.map fun seg =>
        segCrossingCount seg hpi + hpi.segExtCount seg).sum =
      (G.segments.map fun seg => segCrossingCount seg hpi).sum +
      (G.segments.map fun seg => hpi.segExtCount seg).sum := by
      induction G.segments with
      | nil => simp
      | cons seg tl ih => simp [ih]; omega
    rw [h_split] at h1
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := h2
    exact ⟨k1 - k2, by omega⟩

name: lineSegment_toSet_swap
statement:
lemma lineSegment_toSet_swap (a b : Vector2D) :
    (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet = (LineSegment.mk b a).toSet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [LineSegment.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, h0, h1, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨1 - t, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hx]; ring
    · rw [hy]; ring
  · rintro ⟨t, h0, h1, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨1 - t, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hx]; ring
    · rw [hy]; ring

name: lineSegment_toSet_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
lemma lineSegment_toSet_eq_of_pair_eq (s1 s2 : LineSegment)
    (h : ({s1.p1, s1.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) = {s2.p1, s2.p2}) :
    s1.toSet = s2.toSet
proof:
:= by
  cases s1 with
  | mk a b =>
  cases s2 with
  | mk c d =>
  simp only at h
  have ha_cases : a = c ∨ a = d := by
    have ha : a ∈ ({c, d} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
      rw [← h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp ha with hc | hd
    · exact Or.inl hc
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hd)
  rcases ha_cases with ha_eq | ha_eq
  · subst ha_eq
    have h_eq : ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) = {d} := by
      have step :
          Multiset.erase ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) a =
          Multiset.erase ({a, d} : Multiset Vector2D) a := by rw [h]
      have l1 : ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      have l2 : ({a, d} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({d} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      rw [l1, l2, Multiset.erase_cons_head, Multiset.erase_cons_head] at step
      exact step
    have hbd : b = d := by
      have : b ∈ ({d} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
        rw [← h_eq]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mp this
    subst hbd
    rfl
  · subst ha_eq
    have h_swap : ({c, a} : Multiset Vector2D) = ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) :=
      Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
    rw [h_swap] at h
    have h_eq : ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) = {c} := by
      have step :
          Multiset.erase ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) a =
          Multiset.erase ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) a := by rw [h]
      have l1 : ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      have l2 : ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({c} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      rw [l1, l2, Multiset.erase_cons_head, Multiset.erase_cons_head] at step
      exact step
    have hbc : b = c := by
      have : b ∈ ({c} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
        rw [← h_eq]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mp this
    subst hbc
    exact lineSegment_toSet_swap a b

name: boundarySet_subset_of_perm
statement:
lemma boundarySet_subset_of_perm {G1 G2 : EvenGraph}
    (h : G1.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) ~
         G2.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D))) :
    G1.toBoundarySet ⊆ G2.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩
  have hm1 :
      ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) ∈
        G1.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨seg, hseg, rfl⟩
  have hm2 :
      ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) ∈
        G2.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) :=
    h.mem_iff.mp hm1
  obtain ⟨seg', hseg', h_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm2
  refine ⟨seg', hseg', ?_⟩
  have h_pair : ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) =
                ({seg'.p1, seg'.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := h_eq.symm
  rw [lineSegment_toSet_eq_of_pair_eq seg seg' h_pair] at hp
  exact hp

name: toVertexSet_subset_of_perm
statement:
lemma toVertexSet_subset_of_perm {G1 G2 : EvenGraph}
    (h : G1.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) ~
         G2.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D))) :
    G1.toVertexSet ⊆ G2.toVertexSet
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
  rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff] at hp
  obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hpoint⟩ := hp
  have hm1 :
      ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) ∈
        G1.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨seg, hseg, rfl⟩
  have hm2 :
      ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) ∈
        G2.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) :=
    h.mem_iff.mp hm1
  obtain ⟨seg', hseg', h_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm2
  simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff]
  refine ⟨seg', hseg', ?_⟩
  have h_p_in : p ∈ ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
    rcases hpoint with rfl | rfl
    · exact Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
    · exact Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem (Multiset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
  rw [← h_eq] at h_p_in
  rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp h_p_in with hp1 | hp1
  · exact Or.inl hp1.symm
  · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hp1).symm

name: countP_eq_via_map
statement:
private lemma countP_eq_via_map {α β : Type*} {L1 L2 : List α} {f : α → β} {p : α → Bool}
    (h : (L1.map f) ~ (L2.map f))
    (hp : ∀ x1 x2 : α, f x1 = f x2 → p x1 = p x2) :
    L1.countP p = L2.countP p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : β → Bool := fun y =>
    if hy : ∃ x : α, f x = y then p (Classical.choose hy) else false
  have hq : ∀ x : α, q (f x) = p x := by
    intro x
    show (if hy : ∃ x' : α, f x' = f x then p (Classical.choose hy) else false) = p x
    have hy : ∃ x' : α, f x' = f x := ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [dif_pos hy]
    exact hp _ _ (Classical.choose_spec hy)
  have key : ∀ L : List α, L.countP p = (L.map f).countP q := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a t ih =>
      simp only [List.countP_cons, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih, hq a]
  rw [key L1, key L2]
  exact h.countP_eq q

name: intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_of_perm
statement:
lemma intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_of_perm {G1 G2 : EvenGraph}
    (h : G1.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D)) ~
         G2.segments.map (fun s => ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D))) (r : Ray) :
    intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G1 = intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G2
proof:
:= by
  show G1.segments.countP _ = G2.segments.countP _
  apply countP_eq_via_map h
  intro s1 s2 h_pair
  have h_ts : s1.toSet = s2.toSet := lineSegment_toSet_eq_of_pair_eq s1 s2 h_pair
  show decide (rayIntersectsSegment r s1) = decide (rayIntersectsSegment r s2)
  have h_ris : rayIntersectsSegment r s1 = rayIntersectsSegment r s2 := by
    unfold rayIntersectsSegment
    rw [h_ts]
  rw [h_ris]

name: Equiv_toBoundarySet_eq
statement:
theorem Equiv_toBoundarySet_eq {G1 G2 : EvenGraph} (h : G1.Equiv G2) :
    G1.toBoundarySet = G2.toBoundarySet
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (boundarySet_subset_of_perm h)
    (boundarySet_subset_of_perm h.symm)

name: Equiv_toVertexSet_eq
statement:
theorem Equiv_toVertexSet_eq {G1 G2 : EvenGraph} (h : G1.Equiv G2) :
    G1.toVertexSet = G2.toVertexSet
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (toVertexSet_subset_of_perm h)
    (toVertexSet_subset_of_perm h.symm)

name: Equiv_interior_eq
statement:
theorem Equiv_interior_eq {G1 G2 : EvenGraph} (h : G1.Equiv G2) :
    G1.interior = G2.interior
proof:
:= by
  have h_boundary := Equiv_toBoundarySet_eq h
  have h_vset := Equiv_toVertexSet_eq h
  have h_count : ∀ r, intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G1 =
                      intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G2 :=
    fun r => intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_of_perm h r
  have hP : ∀ p : Vector2D, (∀ seg ∈ G1.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ↔
                             (∀ seg ∈ G2.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) := by
    intro p
    have eq1 : (∀ seg ∈ G1.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ↔ p ∉ G1.toBoundarySet := by
      refine ⟨fun hAll ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩ => hAll seg hseg hp,
              fun hNot seg hseg hp => hNot ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩⟩
    have eq2 : (∀ seg ∈ G2.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ↔ p ∉ G2.toBoundarySet := by
      refine ⟨fun hAll ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩ => hAll seg hseg hp,
              fun hNot seg hseg hp => hNot ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩⟩
    rw [eq1, eq2, h_boundary]
  have h_avoid : ∀ r : Ray, rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G1 ↔ rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G2 := by
    intro r
    unfold rayAvoidsGraphVertices
    rw [h_vset]
  ext p
  simp only [EvenGraph.interior, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [hP p]
  refine and_congr_right (fun _ => ?_)
  constructor
  · intro hAll r hro hav
    rw [← h_count r]
    exact hAll r hro ((h_avoid r).mpr hav)
  · intro hAll r hro hav
    rw [h_count r]
    exact hAll r hro ((h_avoid r).mp hav)

name: combine_segments
statement:
lemma combine_segments (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    (combine Gs).segments = Gs.flatMap (·.segments)
proof: := rfl

name: combine_toBoundarySet
statement:
theorem combine_toBoundarySet (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    (combine Gs).toBoundarySet = ⋃ G ∈ Gs, G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Graph.toBoundarySet, combine_segments,
             Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_flatMap, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨seg, ⟨G, hG, hs⟩, hp⟩
    exact ⟨G, hG, seg, hs, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, hG, seg, hs, hp⟩
    exact ⟨seg, ⟨G, hG, hs⟩, hp⟩

name: combine_toVertexSet_eq_iUnion
statement:
lemma combine_toVertexSet_eq_iUnion (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    (combine Gs).toVertexSet = ⋃ G ∈ Gs, G.toVertexSet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion,
             EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff, combine_segments, List.mem_flatMap,
             exists_prop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨seg, ⟨G, hG, hseg⟩, hp⟩
    exact ⟨G, hG, seg, hseg, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, hG, seg, hseg, hp⟩
    exact ⟨seg, ⟨G, hG, hseg⟩, hp⟩

name: combine_intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_sum
statement:
lemma combine_intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_sum
    (r : Ray) (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r (combine Gs) =
    (Gs.map (fun G : EvenGraph => intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G.toGraph)).sum
proof:
:= by
  show (combine Gs).segments.countP _ = _
  simp only [combine_segments]
  induction Gs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons G rest ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.countP_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih]
    rfl

name: Nat_sum_mod_two_eq_countP_odd_mod_two
statement:
private lemma Nat_sum_mod_two_eq_countP_odd_mod_two (l : List ℕ) :
    l.sum % 2 = (l.countP (fun n => decide (n % 2 = 1))) % 2
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.sum_cons, List.countP_cons]
    by_cases h : a % 2 = 1
    · simp [h]; omega
    · simp [h]; omega

name: combine_crossing_parity_eq
statement:
lemma combine_crossing_parity_eq (r : Ray) (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r (combine Gs) % 2 =
    (Gs.countP
      (fun G : EvenGraph =>
        decide (intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G.toGraph % 2 = 1))) % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [combine_intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber_eq_sum,
      Nat_sum_mod_two_eq_countP_odd_mod_two, List.countP_map]
  rfl

name: point_mem_seg_of_endpoint
statement:
private lemma point_mem_seg_of_endpoint {seg : LineSegment} {p : Vector2D}
    (h : seg.p1 = p ∨ seg.p2 = p) : p ∈ seg.toSet
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact ⟨0, le_refl _, zero_le_one, by rw [← h]; ring, by rw [← h]; ring⟩
  · exact ⟨1, zero_le_one, le_refl _, by rw [← h]; ring, by rw [← h]; ring⟩

name: combine_interior_iff_xor_aux
statement:
private theorem combine_interior_iff_xor_aux (Gs : List EvenGraph) (p : Vector2D)
    (h_avoid : ∀ G ∈ Gs, p ∉ G.toBoundarySet) :
    p ∈ (combine Gs).interior ↔
    Odd (Gs.countP (fun G => decide (p ∈ G.interior)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have h_p_not_vertex_G : ∀ G ∈ Gs, p ∉ G.toVertexSet := by
    intro G hG hv
    simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv
    rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff] at hv
    obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩ := hv
    exact h_avoid G hG ⟨seg, hseg, point_mem_seg_of_endpoint hp⟩
  
  have h_p_not_vertex_combine : ∀ v ∈ (combine Gs).toVertices, v ≠ p := by
    intro v hv hvp
    subst hvp
    rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff] at hv
    obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩ := hv
    rw [combine_segments, List.mem_flatMap] at hseg
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hsG⟩ := hseg
    exact h_avoid G hG ⟨seg, hsG, point_mem_seg_of_endpoint hp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr_origin, hr_avoids⟩ :=
    exists_ray_avoiding_graph_vertices p (combine Gs) h_p_not_vertex_combine
  
  have hr_avoids_G : ∀ G ∈ Gs, rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G := by
    intro G hG
    have h_subset : G.toVertexSet ⊆ (combine Gs).toVertexSet := by
      intro v hv
      rw [combine_toVertexSet_eq_iUnion]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨G, hG, hv⟩
    rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices] at hr_avoids ⊢
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hr_avoids ⊢
    intro x ⟨hx_r, hx_G⟩
    exact hr_avoids x ⟨hx_r, h_subset hx_G⟩
  
  have h_p_avoid_G : ∀ G ∈ Gs, ∀ seg ∈ G.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg := by
    intro G hG seg hseg hp
    exact h_avoid G hG ⟨seg, hseg, hp⟩
  have h_p_avoid_combine : ∀ seg ∈ (combine Gs).segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg := by
    intro seg hseg
    rw [combine_segments, List.mem_flatMap] at hseg
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hsG⟩ := hseg
    exact h_p_avoid_G G hG seg hsG
  
  have h_G_iff : ∀ G ∈ Gs,
      (p ∈ G.interior ↔ intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G % 2 = 1) := by
    intro G hG
    refine ⟨fun hp_int => hp_int.2 r hr_origin (hr_avoids_G G hG), fun hcount => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨h_p_avoid_G G hG, ?_⟩
    intro r' hr'_origin hr'_avoids
    have h_origin_seg : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments, pointAvoidsSegment r.origin seg := by
      rw [hr_origin]; exact h_p_avoid_G G hG
    have := intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsGraphVertices
      r r' G (by show r.origin = r'.origin; rw [hr_origin, hr'_origin])
      (hr_avoids_G G hG) hr'_avoids h_origin_seg
    omega
  
  have h_combine_iff : p ∈ (combine Gs).interior ↔
      intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r (combine Gs) % 2 = 1 := by
    refine ⟨fun hp_int => hp_int.2 r hr_origin hr_avoids, fun hcount => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨h_p_avoid_combine, ?_⟩
    intro r' hr'_origin hr'_avoids
    have h_origin_seg : ∀ seg ∈ (combine Gs).segments, pointAvoidsSegment r.origin seg := by
      rw [hr_origin]; exact h_p_avoid_combine
    have := intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsGraphVertices
      r r' (combine Gs) (by show r.origin = r'.origin; rw [hr_origin, hr'_origin])
      hr_avoids hr'_avoids h_origin_seg
    omega
  rw [h_combine_iff, combine_crossing_parity_eq]
  
  have h_countP_eq :
      Gs.countP (fun G : EvenGraph =>
          decide (intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G.toGraph % 2 = 1)) =
      Gs.countP (fun G : EvenGraph => decide (p ∈ G.interior)) := by
    apply List.countP_congr
    intro G hG
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact (h_G_iff G hG).symm
  rw [h_countP_eq]
  exact Nat.odd_iff.symm

name: combine_interior_iff_xor
statement:
theorem combine_interior_iff_xor (Gs : List EvenGraph) (p : Vector2D) :
    p ∈ (combine Gs).interior ↔
    p ∉ (combine Gs).toBoundarySet ∧
      Odd (Gs.countP (fun G => decide (p ∈ G.interior)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h_boundary_iff :
      p ∉ (combine Gs).toBoundarySet ↔ ∀ G ∈ Gs, p ∉ G.toBoundarySet := by
    rw [combine_toBoundarySet]
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and]
  refine ⟨fun hp => ?_, fun ⟨h_not_bnd, hodd⟩ => ?_⟩
  · have h_not_bnd : p ∉ (combine Gs).toBoundarySet := by
      rintro ⟨seg, hseg, hp_seg⟩
      exact hp.1 seg hseg hp_seg
    exact ⟨h_not_bnd,
      (combine_interior_iff_xor_aux Gs p (h_boundary_iff.mp h_not_bnd)).mp hp⟩
  · exact (combine_interior_iff_xor_aux Gs p (h_boundary_iff.mp h_not_bnd)).mpr hodd

name: mem_symmDiffAll_iff_odd_countP
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    show p ∈ (∅ : Set α) ↔ Odd 0
    simp
  | cons A t ih =>
    show p ∈ symmDiff A t.symmDiffAll ↔ _
    rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
    by_cases hpA : p ∈ A
    · rw [List.countP_cons_of_pos (p := fun S => decide (p ∈ S)) (l := t)
            (pa := decide_eq_true hpA)]
      have hLHS :
          (p ∈ A ∧ p ∉ t.symmDiffAll ∨ p ∈ t.symmDiffAll ∧ p ∉ A) ↔
            p ∉ t.symmDiffAll := by
        constructor
        · rintro (⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩)
          · exact h
          · exact absurd hpA h
        · intro h; exact Or.inl ⟨hpA, h⟩
      rw [hLHS, ih, Nat.odd_add_one]
    · have hnd : ¬ ((fun S => decide (p ∈ S)) A = true) := by
        simp [hpA]
      rw [List.countP_cons_of_neg (p := fun S => decide (p ∈ S)) (l := t)
            (pa := hnd)]
      have hLHS :
          (p ∈ A ∧ p ∉ t.symmDiffAll ∨ p ∈ t.symmDiffAll ∧ p ∉ A) ↔
            p ∈ t.symmDiffAll := by
        constructor
        · rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩)
          · exact absurd h hpA
          · exact h
        · intro h; exact Or.inr ⟨h, hpA⟩
      rw [hLHS]; exact ih

name: combine_interior_eq_symmDiff_sdiff_boundary
statement:
theorem combine_interior_eq_symmDiff_sdiff_boundary (Gs : List EvenGraph) :
    (combine Gs).interior =
    (Gs.map EvenGraph.interior).symmDiffAll \ (combine Gs).toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [combine_interior_iff_xor, Set.mem_diff,
      mem_symmDiffAll_iff_odd_countP, List.countP_map]
  exact and_comm

name: segment_split
statement:
private theorem segment_split (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet =
    (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hsx, hsy⟩ := h_pt
  ext p; simp only [LineSegment.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩ | ⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩)
    · exact ⟨u * s, mul_nonneg hu0 hs0, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
    · exact ⟨s + u * (1 - s), by nlinarith, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
  · intro ⟨t, ht0, ht1, htx, hty⟩
    by_cases hts : t ≤ s
    · by_cases hs_zero : s = 0
      · have ht_zero : t = 0 := le_antisymm (hs_zero ▸ hts) ht0
        left
        exact ⟨0, le_refl 0, zero_le_one, by simp [htx, ht_zero], by simp [hty, ht_zero]⟩
      · left
        have hs_pos : (0 : ℚ) < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_zero)
        exact ⟨t / s, div_nonneg ht0 (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ hts (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩
    · push_neg at hts
      by_cases hs1' : s = 1
      · linarith
      · right
        have h1s_pos : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - s := by linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hs1']
        exact ⟨(t - s) / (1 - s),
               div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hts)) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ (by linarith) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩

name: mem_boundary_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil => simp [List.zip, List.map, cyclicBoundary]
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons,
               cyclicBoundary, Set.mem_union]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨seg, h, hp⟩ =>
             h.elim (fun h => Or.inl (h ▸ hp)) (fun h => Or.inr ((ih w).mp ⟨seg, h, hp⟩)),
           fun h => h.elim (fun hp => ⟨⟨v, w⟩, Or.inl rfl, hp⟩)
                    (fun hp => let ⟨seg, hm, hp'⟩ := (ih w).mpr hp; ⟨seg, Or.inr hm, hp'⟩)⟩

name: toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary
statement:
private lemma toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary (v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    (Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs)).toBoundarySet = cyclicBoundary v (v :: w :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  ext p; simp only [Polygon.toBoundarySet, Polygon.segments, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact mem_boundary_iff v v (w :: vs) p

name: insertInEdge_cons
statement:
private lemma insertInEdge_cons (p1 p2 pt first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    ∃ tail, insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (v :: vs) = v :: tail
proof:
:= by
  cases vs with
  | nil => simp [insertInEdge]; split <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | cons w rest => simp [insertInEdge]; split <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: insertInEdge_form
statement:
private lemma insertInEdge_form (p1 p2 pt first v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    ∃ w' vs', insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (v :: w :: vs) = v :: w' :: vs'
proof:
:= by
  unfold insertInEdge; split
  · exact ⟨pt, w :: vs, rfl⟩
  · cases vs with
    | nil =>
      simp only [insertInEdge]; split
      · exact ⟨w, [pt], rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨w, [], rfl⟩
    | cons x rest =>
      simp only [insertInEdge]; split
      · exact ⟨w, pt :: x :: rest, rfl⟩
      · cases rest with
        | nil =>
          simp only [insertInEdge]; split
          · exact ⟨w, x :: [pt], rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨w, [x], rfl⟩
        | cons y rest' =>
          exact ⟨w, insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (x :: y :: rest'), rfl⟩

name: insertInEdge_preserves
statement:
private lemma insertInEdge_preserves (p1 p2 pt first : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk p1 p2).toSet)
    (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    cyclicBoundary first (insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (v :: vs)) =
    cyclicBoundary first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertInEdge]; split
    · rename_i h; obtain ⟨hv, hf⟩ := h; subst hv; subst hf
      simp only [cyclicBoundary]; exact segment_split _ _ pt h_pt
    · rfl
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [insertInEdge]; split
    · rename_i h; obtain ⟨hv, hw⟩ := h; subst hv; subst hw
      simp only [cyclicBoundary]; rw [← Set.union_assoc, segment_split _ _ pt h_pt]
    · show cyclicBoundary first (v :: insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (w :: rest)) =
           cyclicBoundary first (v :: w :: rest)
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertInEdge_cons p1 p2 pt first w rest
      rw [htail]; simp only [cyclicBoundary]; congr 1; rw [← htail]; exact ih w

name: refinement_boundary_eq
statement:
theorem refinement_boundary_eq
    (poly : Polygon) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ poly.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    (polygonRefinement poly seg pt).toBoundarySet =
    poly.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | [_] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    show (Polygon.mk (insertInEdge seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v (v :: w :: vs))).toBoundarySet =
         (Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs)).toBoundarySet
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertInEdge_form seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v v w vs
    rw [hform, toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary v w' vs',
        toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary v w vs]
    conv_lhs => rw [← hform]
    exact insertInEdge_preserves seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v h_pt v (w :: vs)

name: countP_zip_eq_cyclicCount
statement:
private lemma countP_zip_eq_cyclicCount (r : Ray) (first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    (((v :: vs).zip (vs ++ [first])).map fun (a, b) => (⟨a, b⟩ : LineSegment)).countP
      (fun seg => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) =
    cyclicCount r first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.nil_append, List.zip_nil_right,
               List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.countP_cons,
               List.countP_nil, cyclicCount]
    split <;> simp
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.countP_cons, cyclicCount,
               ih w, Nat.add_comm]

name: count_eq_cyclicCount
statement:
private lemma count_eq_cyclicCount (r : Ray) (v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r ⟨v :: w :: vs⟩ = cyclicCount r v (v :: w :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber Polygon.segments
  exact countP_zip_eq_cyclicCount r v v (w :: vs)

name: ray_not_both_sub_segments
statement:
private lemma ray_not_both_sub_segments (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    ¬(rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∧ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨⟨q1, hq1_ray, hq1_seg⟩, ⟨q2, hq2_ray, hq2_seg⟩⟩
  apply h_avoids
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1_0, ht1_1, hq1x, hq1y⟩ := hq1_seg
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2_0, ht2_1, hq2x, hq2y⟩ := hq2_seg
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hptx, hpty⟩ := h_pt
  obtain ⟨tr1, htr1_0, hq1x_r, hq1y_r⟩ := hq1_ray
  obtain ⟨tr2, htr2_0, hq2x_r, hq2y_r⟩ := hq2_ray
  
  dsimp only at hq1x hq1y hq2x hq2y hptx hpty
  
  by_cases ht1_eq_1 : t1 = 1
  · subst ht1_eq_1; simp at hq1x hq1y
    exact ⟨tr1, htr1_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  by_cases ht2_eq_0 : t2 = 0
  · subst ht2_eq_0; simp at hq2x hq2y
    exact ⟨tr2, htr2_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have ht1_lt_1 : t1 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1_1 ht1_eq_1
  have ht2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < t2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht2_0 (Ne.symm ht2_eq_0)
  
  set D := s * (1 - t1) + t2 * (1 - s) with hD_def
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    rw [hD_def]
    by_cases hs_eq_0 : s = 0
    · simp [hs_eq_0]; linarith
    · have : s > 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_eq_0)
      nlinarith
  have hD_ne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD_pos
  set u := s * (1 - t1) / D with hu_def
  have hu_0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
  have hu_1 : u ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hu_def]; exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by rw [hD_def]; nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
  
  have hcomb_x : pt.x = (1 - u) * q1.x + u * q2.x := by
    rw [hq1x, hq2x, hu_def]; field_simp [hD_ne]; rw [hD_def, hptx]; ring
  have hcomb_y : pt.y = (1 - u) * q1.y + u * q2.y := by
    rw [hq1y, hq2y, hu_def]; field_simp [hD_ne]; rw [hD_def, hpty]; ring
  
  exact ⟨(1 - u) * tr1 + u * tr2, by nlinarith,
         by rw [hcomb_x, hq1x_r, hq2x_r]; ring,
         by rw [hcomb_y, hq1y_r, hq2y_r]; ring⟩

name: segment_split_rayIntersects
statement:
private lemma segment_split_rayIntersects (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, b⟩ ↔
    (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∨ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h_union := segment_split a b pt h_pt
  constructor
  · intro ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩
    have : q ∈ (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet :=
      h_union ▸ hq_seg
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩ | ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩)
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ mem_union_left _ hq_seg⟩
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ mem_union_right _ hq_seg⟩

name: segment_split_xor
statement:
private lemma segment_split_xor (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩) then 1 else 0) +
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩) then 1 else 0) =
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, b⟩) then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h_split := segment_split_rayIntersects r a b pt h_pt
  have h_not_both := ray_not_both_sub_segments r a b pt h_pt h_avoids
  by_cases h1 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ <;>
  by_cases h2 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩ <;>
  simp_all

name: insertInEdge_count_preserves
statement:
private lemma insertInEdge_count_preserves (p1 p2 pt first : Vector2D) (r : Ray)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk p1 p2).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet)
    (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    cyclicCount r first (insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (v :: vs)) =
    cyclicCount r first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertInEdge]; split
    · rename_i h; obtain ⟨hv, hf⟩ := h; subst hv; subst hf
      simp only [cyclicCount]
      exact segment_split_xor r v first pt h_pt h_avoids
    · rfl
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [insertInEdge]; split
    · rename_i h; obtain ⟨hv, hw⟩ := h; subst hv; subst hw
      simp only [cyclicCount]
      have := segment_split_xor r v w pt h_pt h_avoids
      omega
    · show cyclicCount r first (v :: insertInEdge p1 p2 pt first (w :: rest)) =
           cyclicCount r first (v :: w :: rest)
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertInEdge_cons p1 p2 pt first w rest
      rw [htail]; simp only [cyclicCount]; congr 1; rw [← htail]; exact ih w

name: mem_of_insertInEdge
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx
    simp only [insertInEdge]; split <;> exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
  | cons w rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · simp only [insertInEdge]; split <;> exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · simp only [insertInEdge]; split
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx')
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w hx')

name: avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary
statement:
private lemma avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary (poly : Polygon) (p : Vector2D) :
    (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ↔ p ∉ poly.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polygon.toBoundarySet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, pointAvoidsSegment]
  exact ⟨fun h hn => let ⟨seg, hs, hp⟩ := hn; h seg hs hp,
         fun h seg hs hp => h ⟨seg, hs, hp⟩⟩

name: vertex_has_successor
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil => simp at hx; subst hx; exact ⟨first, by simp⟩
  | cons w rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact ⟨w, (List.mem_cons_self _ _)⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih w hx'
      exact ⟨z, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz⟩

name: vertex_on_some_segment
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := vertex_has_successor v v (w :: vs) x hx
  refine ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ?_, ⟨0, le_refl _, le_of_lt one_pos, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists]
  exact ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩

name: exists_ray_avoiding_vertices'
proof:
:= by
  have : Infinite ℚ := Infinite.of_injective (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℚ)) Nat.cast_injective
  let badSlopes : Finset ℚ := (verts.filterMap fun v =>
    if v.x > p.x then some ((v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x)) else none).toFinset
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finset.exists_not_mem badSlopes
  have h_nonzero : (⟨1, q⟩ : Vector2D) ≠ ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
    intro h; exact absurd (congrArg Vector2D.x h) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨⟨p, ⟨1, q⟩, h_nonzero⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hv_ray, hv_vert⟩ := hv
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv_vert
  obtain ⟨t, ht_nonneg, hvx, hvy⟩ := hv_ray
  simp only [mul_one] at hvx
  have hne : v ≠ p := h_not_vert v hv_vert
  have ht_eq : t = v.x - p.x := by linarith
  by_cases h_gt : v.x > p.x
  · have h_slope_mem : (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) ∈ badSlopes := by
      simp only [badSlopes, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
      exact ⟨v, hv_vert, by simp [if_pos h_gt]⟩
    have hvmy : v.y - p.y = t * q := by linarith
    rw [ht_eq] at hvmy
    have hvx_ne : v.x - p.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith : v.x - p.x > 0)
    have hq_eq : q = (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hvx_ne, mul_comm]; linarith
    exact hq (hq_eq ▸ h_slope_mem)
  · push_neg at h_gt
    by_cases h_eq : v.x = p.x
    · have ht_zero : t = 0 := by linarith
      have hvy_eq : v.y = p.y := by
        have := hvy; rw [ht_zero] at this; simp at this; exact this
      exact hne (by cases v; cases p; simp_all)
    · linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne h_gt h_eq]

name: pt_mem_insertInEdge_aux
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp at h; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    simp [insertInEdge]
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | h_rest
    · simp [insertInEdge]
    · simp only [insertInEdge]
      split
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w h_rest)

name: pt_mem_insertInEdge
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists] at h_seg
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab_zip, hab_eq⟩ := h_seg
  have hp1 : a = p1 := congrArg LineSegment.p1 hab_eq
  have hp2 : b = p2 := congrArg LineSegment.p2 hab_eq
  rw [← hp1, ← hp2]
  exact pt_mem_insertInEdge_aux a b pt v v (w :: vs) hab_zip

name: refinement_interior_eq
statement:
theorem refinement_interior_eq
    (poly : Polygon) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ poly.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    (polygonRefinement poly seg pt).interior =
    poly.interior
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | [_] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    set poly' := Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs) with hpoly'_def
    set refined := polygonRefinement poly' seg pt with hrefdef
    show refined.interior = poly'.interior
    have h_boundary_eq := refinement_boundary_eq
      poly' seg pt h_seg h_pt
    have href_eq : refined = ⟨insertInEdge seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v (v :: w :: vs)⟩ := by
      simp [hrefdef, polygonRefinement, hpoly'_def]
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertInEdge_form seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v v w vs
    
    have h_seg_eq : (⟨seg.p1, seg.p2⟩ : LineSegment) = seg := by cases seg; rfl
    have h_seg' : (⟨seg.p1, seg.p2⟩ : LineSegment) ∈ poly'.segments := h_seg_eq ▸ h_seg
    
    have h_count_eq : ∀ r : Ray, pt ∉ r.toSet →
        intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r refined =
        intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly' := by
      intro r h_avoids_pt
      rw [href_eq, hform, count_eq_cyclicCount r v w' vs',
          count_eq_cyclicCount r v w vs]
      conv_lhs => rw [← hform]
      exact insertInEdge_count_preserves seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v r h_pt h_avoids_pt v (w :: vs)
    
    have h_vertices_sub : ∀ x, x ∈ poly'.vertices → x ∈ refined.vertices := by
      intro x hx; rw [href_eq]; simp
      exact mem_of_insertInEdge seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v v (w :: vs) x hx
    
    have h_pt_mem : pt ∈ refined.vertices := by
      rw [href_eq]; simp
      exact pt_mem_insertInEdge seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v w vs h_seg
    
    have h_ref_len : refined.vertices.length ≥ 2 := by
      rw [href_eq, hform]; simp [List.length_cons]
    
    have h_poly_len : poly'.vertices.length ≥ 2 := by
      simp [hpoly'_def, List.length_cons]
    
    have h_avoids_transfer : ∀ r : Ray, rayAvoidsVertices r refined → rayAvoidsVertices r poly' := by
      intro r hr
      rw [rayAvoidsVertices, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hr ⊢
      intro x hx
      exact hr x ⟨hx.1, by
        simp only [Polygon.toVertices, mem_setOf_eq] at hx ⊢
        exact h_vertices_sub x hx.2⟩
    
    have h_avoids_pt : ∀ r : Ray, rayAvoidsVertices r refined → pt ∉ r.toSet := by
      intro r hr hpt_r
      rw [rayAvoidsVertices, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hr
      exact hr pt ⟨hpt_r, by
        simp only [Polygon.toVertices, mem_setOf_eq]; exact h_pt_mem⟩
    
    ext p
    simp only [Polygon.interior, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · 
      intro ⟨h_avoids_segs_ref, h_forall_ref⟩
      
      have h_avoids_segs : ∀ seg_i ∈ poly'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg_i := by
        rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs_ref ⊢
        rwa [h_boundary_eq] at h_avoids_segs_ref
      refine ⟨h_avoids_segs, ?_⟩
      
      
      
      have h_p_not_ref_vert : ∀ x ∈ refined.vertices, x ≠ p := by
        intro x hx hxp; subst hxp
        rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs_ref
        rw [href_eq] at hx h_avoids_segs_ref
        simp at hx
        rw [hform] at hx
        have ⟨seg_x, hseg_x, hp_on⟩ := vertex_on_some_segment v w' vs' x hx
        rw [← hform] at hseg_x
        exact h_avoids_segs_ref ⟨seg_x, hseg_x, hp_on⟩
      obtain ⟨r, hr_origin, hr_avoids_verts⟩ := exists_ray_avoiding_vertices' p refined.vertices h_p_not_ref_vert
      
      have hr_avoids_ref : rayAvoidsVertices r refined := by
        rwa [rayAvoidsVertices, Polygon.toVertices]
      
      have hr_avoids_poly := h_avoids_transfer r hr_avoids_ref
      
      have hr_count := h_count_eq r (h_avoids_pt r hr_avoids_ref)
      
      have hr_parity_ref := h_forall_ref r hr_origin hr_avoids_ref
      
      have hr_parity_poly : intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly' % 2 = 1 := by
        omega
      
      intro r2 hr2_origin hr2_avoids_poly
      have h_same_origin : sameOrigin r r2 := by simp [sameOrigin, hr_origin, hr2_origin]
      have h_seg_avoids : ∀ seg_i ∈ poly'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment r.origin seg_i := by
        rwa [hr_origin]
      exact (intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsVertices r r2 poly'
        h_same_origin hr_avoids_poly hr2_avoids_poly h_seg_avoids).symm ▸ hr_parity_poly
    · 
      intro ⟨h_avoids_segs, h_forall_poly⟩
      
      have h_avoids_segs_ref : ∀ seg_i ∈ refined.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg_i := by
        rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs ⊢
        rwa [← h_boundary_eq] at h_avoids_segs
      refine ⟨h_avoids_segs_ref, ?_⟩
      
      intro r hr_origin hr_avoids_ref
      
      have hr_avoids_poly := h_avoids_transfer r hr_avoids_ref
      
      have hr_avoids_pt_r := h_avoids_pt r hr_avoids_ref
      
      have hr_count := h_count_eq r hr_avoids_pt_r
      
      have hr_parity_poly := h_forall_poly r hr_origin hr_avoids_poly
      
      omega

name: insertPtInAllEdges_head
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_head (pt first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    ∃ tail, insertPtInAllEdges pt first (v :: vs) = v :: tail
proof:
:= by
  cases vs with
  | nil => simp [insertPtInAllEdges]; split <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | cons w rest => simp [insertPtInAllEdges]; split <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: insertPtInAllEdges_form
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_form (pt first v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    ∃ w' vs', insertPtInAllEdges pt first (v :: w :: vs) = v :: w' :: vs'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
  · exact ⟨pt, insertPtInAllEdges pt first (w :: vs), rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w vs
    exact ⟨w, tail, by rw [htail]⟩

name: insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_boundary
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_boundary (pt first : Vector2D)
    (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    cyclicBoundary first (insertPtInAllEdges pt first (v :: vs)) =
    cyclicBoundary first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
    · rename_i h; simp only [cyclicBoundary]; exact segment_split _ _ pt h
    · rfl
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
    · rename_i h
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      conv_lhs => rw [htail]
      simp only [cyclicBoundary]
      rw [← Set.union_assoc, segment_split _ _ pt h]
      congr 1; rw [← htail]; exact ih w
    · show cyclicBoundary first (v :: insertPtInAllEdges pt first (w :: rest)) =
           cyclicBoundary first (v :: w :: rest)
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      rw [htail]; simp only [cyclicBoundary]; congr 1; rw [← htail]; exact ih w

name: refinePointAllSegs_boundary_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => rfl
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    show (Polygon.mk (insertPtInAllEdges pt v (v :: w :: vs))).toBoundarySet =
         (Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs)).toBoundarySet
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_form pt v v w vs
    rw [hform, toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary v w' vs',
        toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary v w vs]
    conv_lhs => rw [← hform]
    exact insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_boundary pt v v (w :: vs)

name: mem_of_insertPtInAllEdges
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split <;> exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
  | cons w rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split <;> exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w hx'))
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w hx')

name: pt_mem_insertPtInAllEdges
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [cyclicBoundary] at h
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges, if_pos h]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [cyclicBoundary, Set.mem_union] at h
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]
    rcases h with h_edge | h_rest
    · rw [if_pos h_edge]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · split
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w h_rest))
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih w h_rest)

name: insertPtInAllEdges_count_preserves
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_count_preserves (pt first : Vector2D) (r : Ray)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet)
    (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    cyclicCount r first (insertPtInAllEdges pt first (v :: vs)) =
    cyclicCount r first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
    · rename_i h; simp only [cyclicCount]
      exact segment_split_xor r v first pt h h_avoids
    · rfl
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]; split
    · rename_i h; simp only [cyclicCount]
      have hsplit := segment_split_xor r v w pt h h_avoids
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      rw [htail]; simp only [cyclicCount]; rw [← htail, ih w]; omega
    · show cyclicCount r first (v :: insertPtInAllEdges pt first (w :: rest)) =
           cyclicCount r first (v :: w :: rest)
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      rw [htail]; simp only [cyclicCount]; congr 1; rw [← htail]; exact ih w

name: interior_eq_of_same_boundary_and_count
statement:
private lemma interior_eq_of_same_boundary_and_count
    (poly refined : Polygon) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_boundary_eq : refined.toBoundarySet = poly.toBoundarySet)
    (h_vert_sub : ∀ x, x ∈ poly.vertices → x ∈ refined.vertices)
    (h_pt_mem : pt ∈ refined.vertices)
    (h_ref_len : refined.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h_poly_len : poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h_count_eq : ∀ r : Ray, pt ∉ r.toSet →
        intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r refined =
        intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly) :
    refined.interior = poly.interior
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨ref_verts⟩ := refined
  obtain ⟨poly_verts⟩ := poly
  match hpv : poly_verts with
  | [] => simp at h_poly_len
  | [_] => simp at h_poly_len
  | pv :: pw :: pvs =>
    match hrv : ref_verts with
    | [] => simp at h_ref_len
    | [_] => simp at h_ref_len
    | rv :: rw :: rvs =>
      set poly' := Polygon.mk (pv :: pw :: pvs)
      set refined' := Polygon.mk (rv :: rw :: rvs)
      
      have h_avoids_transfer : ∀ r : Ray, rayAvoidsVertices r refined' → rayAvoidsVertices r poly' := by
        intro r hr
        rw [rayAvoidsVertices, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hr ⊢
        intro x hx
        exact hr x ⟨hx.1, by
          simp only [Polygon.toVertices, mem_setOf_eq] at hx ⊢
          exact h_vert_sub x hx.2⟩
      
      have h_avoids_pt : ∀ r : Ray, rayAvoidsVertices r refined' → pt ∉ r.toSet := by
        intro r hr hpt_r
        rw [rayAvoidsVertices, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hr
        exact hr pt ⟨hpt_r, by
          simp only [Polygon.toVertices, mem_setOf_eq]; exact h_pt_mem⟩
      ext p
      simp only [Polygon.interior, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      constructor
      · 
        intro ⟨h_avoids_segs_ref, h_forall_ref⟩
        have h_avoids_segs : ∀ seg_i ∈ poly'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg_i := by
          rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs_ref ⊢
          rwa [h_boundary_eq] at h_avoids_segs_ref
        refine ⟨h_avoids_segs, ?_⟩
        have h_p_not_ref_vert : ∀ x ∈ refined'.vertices, x ≠ p := by
          intro x hx hxp; subst hxp
          rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs_ref
          have ⟨seg_x, hseg_x, hp_on⟩ := vertex_on_some_segment rv rw rvs x hx
          exact h_avoids_segs_ref ⟨seg_x, hseg_x, hp_on⟩
        obtain ⟨r, hr_origin, hr_avoids_verts⟩ := exists_ray_avoiding_vertices' p refined'.vertices h_p_not_ref_vert
        have hr_avoids_ref : rayAvoidsVertices r refined' := by
          rwa [rayAvoidsVertices, Polygon.toVertices]
        have hr_avoids_poly := h_avoids_transfer r hr_avoids_ref
        have hr_count := h_count_eq r (h_avoids_pt r hr_avoids_ref)
        have hr_parity_ref := h_forall_ref r hr_origin hr_avoids_ref
        have hr_parity_poly : intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly' % 2 = 1 := by omega
        intro r2 hr2_origin hr2_avoids_poly
        have h_same_origin : sameOrigin r r2 := by simp [sameOrigin, hr_origin, hr2_origin]
        have h_seg_avoids : ∀ seg_i ∈ poly'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment r.origin seg_i := by rwa [hr_origin]
        exact (intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsVertices r r2 poly'
          h_same_origin hr_avoids_poly hr2_avoids_poly h_seg_avoids).symm ▸ hr_parity_poly
      · 
        intro ⟨h_avoids_segs, h_forall_poly⟩
        have h_avoids_segs_ref : ∀ seg_i ∈ refined'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg_i := by
          rw [avoids_segments_iff_not_boundary] at h_avoids_segs ⊢
          rwa [← h_boundary_eq] at h_avoids_segs
        refine ⟨h_avoids_segs_ref, ?_⟩
        intro r hr_origin hr_avoids_ref
        have hr_avoids_poly := h_avoids_transfer r hr_avoids_ref
        have hr_avoids_pt_r := h_avoids_pt r hr_avoids_ref
        have hr_count := h_count_eq r hr_avoids_pt_r
        have hr_parity_poly := h_forall_poly r hr_origin hr_avoids_poly
        omega

name: refinePointAllSegs_interior_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => rfl
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    set poly' := Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs) with hpoly'_def
    set refined := refinePointAllSegs poly' pt with hrefdef
    show refined.interior = poly'.interior
    have h_boundary_eq := refinePointAllSegs_boundary_eq poly' pt h_bdy
    have href_eq : refined = ⟨insertPtInAllEdges pt v (v :: w :: vs)⟩ := by
      simp [hrefdef, refinePointAllSegs, hpoly'_def]
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_form pt v v w vs
    
    have h_bdy_cyclic : pt ∈ cyclicBoundary v (v :: w :: vs) :=
      (toBoundarySet_eq_cyclicBoundary v w vs) ▸ h_bdy
    apply interior_eq_of_same_boundary_and_count poly' refined pt h_boundary_eq
    · 
      intro x hx; rw [href_eq]; simp
      exact mem_of_insertPtInAllEdges pt v v (w :: vs) x hx
    · 
      rw [href_eq]; simp
      exact pt_mem_insertPtInAllEdges pt v v (w :: vs) h_bdy_cyclic
    · 
      rw [href_eq, hform]; simp [List.length_cons]
    · 
      simp [hpoly'_def, List.length_cons]
    · 
      intro r h_avoids_pt
      rw [href_eq, hform, count_eq_cyclicCount r v w' vs',
          count_eq_cyclicCount r v w vs]
      conv_lhs => rw [← hform]
      exact insertPtInAllEdges_count_preserves pt v r h_avoids_pt v (w :: vs)

name: insertPtInAllEdges_pt_endpoint
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_pt_endpoint (pt first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D) :
    ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (insertPtInAllEdges pt first (v :: vs))
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]
    split
    · 
      exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr rfl, fun _ => Or.inl rfl⟩
    · 
      rename_i h; exact fun h' => absurd h' h
  | cons w rest ih =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]
    split
    · 
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      show ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: pt :: insertPtInAllEdges pt first (w :: rest))
      rw [htail]
      exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr rfl, fun _ => Or.inl rfl, by rw [← htail]; exact ih w⟩
    · 
      rename_i h_not
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt first w rest
      show ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: insertPtInAllEdges pt first (w :: rest))
      rw [htail]
      exact ⟨fun h_mem => absurd h_mem h_not, by rw [← htail]; exact ih w⟩

name: ptAtEdgeEndpoints_imp_zip
statement:
private lemma ptAtEdgeEndpoints_imp_zip (pt first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D)
    (h : ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: vs)) :
    ∀ (a b : Vector2D), (a, b) ∈ List.zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [first]) →
    pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet → pt = a ∨ pt = b
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    intro a b h_zip h_pt
    simp [List.zip] at h_zip; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h_zip
    exact h h_pt
  | cons w rest ih =>
    intro a b h_zip h_pt
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at h_zip
    rcases h_zip with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | h_rest
    · exact h.1 h_pt
    · exact ih w h.2 a b h_rest h_pt

name: ptAtEdgeEndpoints_iff_forall_seg
statement:
private lemma ptAtEdgeEndpoints_iff_forall_seg (pt v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D)
    (h : ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt v (v :: w :: vs)) :
    ∀ seg ∈ (Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs)).segments,
    pt ∈ seg.toSet → pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  intro seg h_seg h_pt
  simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists] at h_seg
  obtain ⟨a, b, h_zip, h_eq⟩ := h_seg; subst h_eq
  exact ptAtEdgeEndpoints_imp_zip pt v v (w :: vs) h a b h_zip h_pt

name: refinePointAllSegs_pt_endpoint
statement:
private lemma refinePointAllSegs_pt_endpoint (poly : Polygon) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_bdy : pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet) :
    ∀ seg ∈ (refinePointAllSegs poly pt).segments,
    pt ∈ seg.toSet → pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => simp [refinePointAllSegs, Polygon.segments]
  | [_] => simp [refinePointAllSegs, Polygon.segments]
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    simp only [refinePointAllSegs]
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_form pt v v w vs
    rw [hform]
    exact ptAtEdgeEndpoints_iff_forall_seg pt v w' vs'
      (by rw [← hform]; exact insertPtInAllEdges_pt_endpoint pt v v (w :: vs))

name: vec_ext
statement: private lemma vec_ext {a b : Vector2D} (hx : a.x = b.x) (hy : a.y = b.y) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a; cases b; simp_all

name: mem_sub_seg_left
statement:
private lemma mem_sub_seg_left (a b c : Vector2D)
    (hc : c ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) (ha : a ∈ (LineSegment.mk c b).toSet) : a = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hcx, hcy⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hax, hay⟩ := ha
  simp at hcx hcy hax hay
  have key_x : (a.x - b.x) * (t + s - t * s) = 0 := by nlinarith
  have key_y : (a.y - b.y) * (t + s - t * s) = 0 := by nlinarith
  by_cases h : t + s - t * s = 0
  · have ht_zero : t = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hs_zero : s = 0 := by nlinarith
    rw [hs_zero] at hcx hcy; simp at hcx hcy
    exact vec_ext hcx.symm hcy.symm
  · have hab_x : a.x = b.x := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key_x with h1 | h2; linarith; exact absurd h2 h
    have hab_y : a.y = b.y := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key_y with h1 | h2; linarith; exact absurd h2 h
    exact vec_ext (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)

name: mem_sub_seg_right
statement:
private lemma mem_sub_seg_right (a b c : Vector2D)
    (hc : c ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) (hb : b ∈ (LineSegment.mk a c).toSet) : b = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hcx, hcy⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hbx, hby⟩ := hb
  simp at hcx hcy hbx hby
  have key_x : (a.x - b.x) * (1 - t * s) = 0 := by nlinarith
  have key_y : (a.y - b.y) * (1 - t * s) = 0 := by nlinarith
  by_cases h : 1 - t * s = 0
  · have hts : t * s = 1 := by linarith
    have ht1' : t = 1 := by nlinarith
    have hs1' : s = 1 := by nlinarith
    subst ht1'; subst hs1'; simp at hcx hcy
    
    exact vec_ext (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · have hab_x : a.x = b.x := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key_x with h1 | h2; linarith; exact absurd h2 h
    have hab_y : a.y = b.y := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key_y with h1 | h2; linarith; exact absurd h2 h
    exact vec_ext (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)

name: insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_endpoint
statement:
private lemma insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_endpoint (pt pt' first : Vector2D)
    (v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D)
    (h : ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: vs)) :
    ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (insertPtInAllEdges pt' first (v :: vs))
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]
    split
    · rename_i h_in
      refine ⟨fun h_mem => ?_, fun h_mem => ?_⟩
      · have h_sub : (LineSegment.mk v pt').toSet ⊆ (LineSegment.mk v first).toSet := by
          intro q hq; exact (segment_split v first pt' h_in) ▸ Set.mem_union_left _ hq
        cases h (h_sub h_mem) with
        | inl hpv => exact Or.inl hpv
        | inr hpf =>
          rw [hpf] at h_mem
          exact Or.inr (hpf.trans (mem_sub_seg_right v first pt' h_in h_mem))
      · have h_sub : (LineSegment.mk pt' first).toSet ⊆ (LineSegment.mk v first).toSet := by
          intro q hq; exact (segment_split v first pt' h_in) ▸ Set.mem_union_right _ hq
        cases h (h_sub h_mem) with
        | inl hpv =>
          rw [hpv] at h_mem
          exact Or.inl ((mem_sub_seg_left v first pt' h_in h_mem).symm.trans hpv.symm).symm
        | inr hpf => exact Or.inr hpf
    · exact h
  | cons w rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨h_edge, h_rest⟩ := h
    simp only [insertPtInAllEdges]
    split
    · rename_i h_in
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt' first w rest
      show ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: pt' :: insertPtInAllEdges pt' first (w :: rest))
      rw [htail]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h_mem
        have h_sub : (LineSegment.mk v pt').toSet ⊆ (LineSegment.mk v w).toSet := by
          intro q hq; exact (segment_split v w pt' h_in) ▸ Set.mem_union_left _ hq
        cases h_edge (h_sub h_mem) with
        | inl hpv => exact Or.inl hpv
        | inr hpw =>
          rw [hpw] at h_mem
          exact Or.inr (hpw.trans (mem_sub_seg_right v w pt' h_in h_mem))
      · intro h_mem
        have h_sub : (LineSegment.mk pt' w).toSet ⊆ (LineSegment.mk v w).toSet := by
          intro q hq; exact (segment_split v w pt' h_in) ▸ Set.mem_union_right _ hq
        cases h_edge (h_sub h_mem) with
        | inl hpv =>
          rw [hpv] at h_mem
          exact Or.inl ((mem_sub_seg_left v w pt' h_in h_mem).symm.trans hpv.symm).symm
        | inr hpw => exact Or.inr hpw
      · rw [← htail]; exact ih w h_rest
    · obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_head pt' first w rest
      show ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: insertPtInAllEdges pt' first (w :: rest))
      rw [htail]
      exact ⟨h_edge, by rw [← htail]; exact ih w h_rest⟩

name: zip_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints
statement:
private lemma zip_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints (pt first v : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D)
    (h : ∀ (a b : Vector2D), (a, b) ∈ List.zip (v :: vs) (vs ++ [first]) →
         pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet → pt = a ∨ pt = b) :
    ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt first (v :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing v with
  | nil => exact h v first (by simp [List.zip])
  | cons w rest ih =>
    exact ⟨h v w ((List.mem_cons_self _ _)),
           ih w (fun a b hab => h a b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hab))⟩

name: forall_seg_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints
statement:
private lemma forall_seg_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints (pt v w : Vector2D) (vs : List Vector2D)
    (h : ∀ seg ∈ (Polygon.mk (v :: w :: vs)).segments,
         pt ∈ seg.toSet → pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2) :
    ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt v (v :: w :: vs)
proof:
:= by
  apply zip_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints
  intro a b h_zip h_pt
  exact h ⟨a, b⟩ (by simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists]; exact ⟨a, b, h_zip, rfl⟩) h_pt

name: refinePointAllSegs_preserves_endpoint
statement:
private lemma refinePointAllSegs_preserves_endpoint (poly : Polygon) (pt pt' : Vector2D)
    (h_bdy : pt' ∈ poly.toBoundarySet)
    (h : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pt ∈ seg.toSet → pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2) :
    ∀ seg ∈ (refinePointAllSegs poly pt').segments,
    pt ∈ seg.toSet → pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => simp [refinePointAllSegs, Polygon.segments]
  | [_] => simp [refinePointAllSegs, Polygon.segments]
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    simp only [refinePointAllSegs]
    obtain ⟨w', vs', hform⟩ := insertPtInAllEdges_form pt' v v w vs
    have h_endpoints := forall_seg_to_ptAtEdgeEndpoints pt v w vs h
    have h_preserved := insertPtInAllEdges_preserves_endpoint pt pt' v v (w :: vs) h_endpoints
    rw [hform]
    exact ptAtEdgeEndpoints_iff_forall_seg pt v w' vs'
      (by rw [← hform]; exact h_preserved)

name: refineWithPoints_boundary_eq
statement:
private lemma refineWithPoints_boundary_eq :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet),
    (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).toBoundarySet = poly.toBoundarySet
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all =>
    (refineWithPoints_boundary_eq _ rest _).trans
      (refinePointAllSegs_boundary_eq poly pt (h_all pt (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))

private lemma refineWithPoints_interior_eq :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet),
    (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).interior = poly.interior
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all =>
    (refineWithPoints_interior_eq _ rest _).trans
      (refinePointAllSegs_interior_eq poly pt (h_all pt (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))

/-! ### Endpoint preservation lemmas -/

/
private lemma refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet)
    (q : Vector2D)
    (_ : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, q ∈ seg.toSet → q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2),
    ∀ seg ∈ (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).segments,
    q ∈ seg.toSet → q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2
  | _, [], _, _, h => h
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all, q, h =>
    refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint _ rest _ q
      (refinePointAllSegs_preserves_endpoint poly q pt
        (h_all pt (List.mem_cons_self _ _)) h)

/
private lemma refineWithPoints_pts_endpoint :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet)
    (q : Vector2D) (_ : q ∈ pts)
    (seg : LineSegment) (_ : seg ∈ (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).segments)
    (_ : q ∈ seg.toSet),
    q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2
  | _, [], _, _, hq, _, _, _ => nomatch hq
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all, q, hq, seg, hseg, hon => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with rfl | hq_rest
    · exact refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint _ rest _ q
        (refinePointAllSegs_pt_endpoint poly q (h_all q (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))
        seg hseg hon
    · exact refineWithPoints_pts_endpoint _ rest _ q hq_rest seg hseg hon

/
    refine the first polygon by inserting all boundary intersection points
    as new vertices. The resulting polygon has the same boundary and interior. -/
def polygonRefinementWrt
    (poly1 poly2 : Polygon)
    (h_fin : Set.Finite (poly1.toBoundarySet ∩ poly2.toBoundarySet)) : Polygon
proof:
:=
  refineWithPoints poly1 h_fin.toFinset.toList (fun pt h_mem => by
    have h1 : pt ∈ h_fin.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem
    exact (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mp h1).1)

name: refineWithPoints_interior_eq
statement:
private lemma refineWithPoints_interior_eq :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet),
    (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).interior = poly.interior
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all =>
    (refineWithPoints_interior_eq _ rest _).trans
      (refinePointAllSegs_interior_eq poly pt (h_all pt (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))

/-! ### Endpoint preservation lemmas -/

/
private lemma refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet)
    (q : Vector2D)
    (_ : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, q ∈ seg.toSet → q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2),
    ∀ seg ∈ (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).segments,
    q ∈ seg.toSet → q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2
  | _, [], _, _, h => h
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all, q, h =>
    refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint _ rest _ q
      (refinePointAllSegs_preserves_endpoint poly q pt
        (h_all pt (List.mem_cons_self _ _)) h)

/
private lemma refineWithPoints_pts_endpoint :
    ∀ (poly : Polygon) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ poly.toBoundarySet)
    (q : Vector2D) (_ : q ∈ pts)
    (seg : LineSegment) (_ : seg ∈ (refineWithPoints poly pts h_all).segments)
    (_ : q ∈ seg.toSet),
    q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2
  | _, [], _, _, hq, _, _, _ => nomatch hq
  | poly, pt :: rest, h_all, q, hq, seg, hseg, hon => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with rfl | hq_rest
    · exact refineWithPoints_preserves_endpoint _ rest _ q
        (refinePointAllSegs_pt_endpoint poly q (h_all q (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))
        seg hseg hon
    · exact refineWithPoints_pts_endpoint _ rest _ q hq_rest seg hseg hon

    have h1 : pt ∈ h_fin.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem
    exact (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mp h1).1)

    (poly1 poly2 : Polygon)

    (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ (polygonRefinementWrt poly1 poly2 h_fin).segments) :
    seg.toSet ∩ poly2.toBoundarySet ⊆ ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Set Vector2D)
proof:
:= by
  intro q ⟨hq_seg, hq_bdy⟩
  
  have h_bdy_eq := refinementWrt_boundary_eq poly1 poly2 h_fin
  have hq_poly1 : q ∈ poly1.toBoundarySet := h_bdy_eq ▸ ⟨seg, h_seg, hq_seg⟩

    Finset.mem_toList.mpr (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨hq_poly1, hq_bdy⟩)
  
  have h_all : ∀ pt ∈ h_fin.toFinset.toList, pt ∈ poly1.toBoundarySet :=
    fun pt h_mem => (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem)).1
  exact refineWithPoints_pts_endpoint poly1 h_fin.toFinset.toList h_all q hq_list seg h_seg hq_seg

theorem polygonRefinement_vertices_length
    (poly : Polygon) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)

    poly.vertices.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vertices⟩ := poly
  match vertices with
  | [] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | [_] => simp [Polygon.segments] at h_seg
  | v :: w :: vs =>
    show (insertInEdge seg.p1 seg.p2 pt v (v :: w :: vs)).length = (v :: w :: vs).length + 1
    
    simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists] at h_seg
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab_zip, hab_eq⟩ := h_seg
    have hp1 : a = seg.p1 := congrArg LineSegment.p1 hab_eq
    have hp2 : b = seg.p2 := congrArg LineSegment.p2 hab_eq
    rw [← hp1, ← hp2]
    exact insertInEdge_length_aux a b pt v v (w :: vs) hab_zip

    ·

    ·

      · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_self _ _)

    ·
