name: canonSeg_idem
statement: private theorem canonSeg_idem (σ : LineSegment) : canonSeg (canonSeg σ) = canonSeg σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonSeg
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i h
    push_neg at h
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := h
    have hcond : σ.p2.x < σ.p1.x ∨ (σ.p2.x = σ.p1.x ∧ σ.p2.y ≤ σ.p1.y) := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl h'
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h', le_of_lt (hy h'.symm)⟩
    show (if (σ.p2.x < σ.p1.x ∨ σ.p2.x = σ.p1.x ∧ σ.p2.y ≤ σ.p1.y) then
            (⟨σ.p2, σ.p1⟩ : LineSegment) else ⟨σ.p1, σ.p2⟩) = ⟨σ.p2, σ.p1⟩
    rw [if_pos hcond]

name: canonSeg_toEM
statement:
private theorem canonSeg_toEM (σ : LineSegment) :
    (canonSeg σ).toEndpointsMultiset = σ.toEndpointsMultiset
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonSeg
  split
  · rfl
  · show ({σ.p2, σ.p1} : Multiset Vector2D) = {σ.p1, σ.p2}
    exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _

name: canonSeg_eq_of_toEM_eq
proof:
:= by
  
  have hmem1 : s.p1 ∈ ({x.p1, x.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
    have h := hem
    unfold LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset at h
    rw [← h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
  have hmem2 : s.p2 ∈ ({x.p1, x.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
    have h := hem
    unfold LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset at h
    rw [← h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem (Multiset.mem_singleton_self _)
  have hs1 : s.p1 = x.p1 ∨ s.p1 = x.p2 := by
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hmem1 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp h)
  have hs2 : s.p2 = x.p1 ∨ s.p2 = x.p2 := by
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hmem2 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp h)
  
  have hmemx1 : x.p1 ∈ ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
    have h := hem
    unfold LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset at h
    rw [h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
  have hmemx2 : x.p2 ∈ ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
    have h := hem
    unfold LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset at h
    rw [h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem (Multiset.mem_singleton_self _)
  have hx1 : x.p1 = s.p1 ∨ x.p1 = s.p2 := by
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hmemx1 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp h)
  have hx2 : x.p2 = s.p1 ∨ x.p2 = s.p2 := by
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hmemx2 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp h)
  
  have hcase : (s.p1 = x.p1 ∧ s.p2 = x.p2) ∨ (s.p1 = x.p2 ∧ s.p2 = x.p1) := by
    rcases hs1 with ha | ha <;> rcases hs2 with hb | hb
    · 
      have hxe : x.p2 = x.p1 := by
        rcases hx2 with h | h
        · rw [h, ha]
        · rw [h, hb]
      exact Or.inl ⟨ha, by rw [hb, hxe]⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · 
      have hxe : x.p1 = x.p2 := by
        rcases hx1 with h | h
        · rw [h, ha]
        · rw [h, hb]
      exact Or.inr ⟨ha, by rw [hb, hxe]⟩
  rcases hcase with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e1, e2⟩
  · have : s = x := by cases s; cases x; simp_all
    rw [this]
  · 
    have hs_eq : s = (⟨x.p2, x.p1⟩ : LineSegment) := by cases s; cases x; simp_all
    rw [hs_eq]
    unfold canonSeg
    by_cases hxc : x.p1.x < x.p2.x ∨ x.p1.x = x.p2.x ∧ x.p1.y ≤ x.p2.y
    · 
      rw [if_pos hxc]
      by_cases hsc : x.p2.x < x.p1.x ∨ x.p2.x = x.p1.x ∧ x.p2.y ≤ x.p1.y
      · 
        have hxeq : x.p1 = x.p2 := by
          rcases hxc with h1 | ⟨h1x, h1y⟩ <;> rcases hsc with h2 | ⟨h2x, h2y⟩
          · exact absurd h1 (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt h2))
          · exact absurd h1 (not_lt.mpr (le_of_eq h2x))
          · exact absurd h2 (not_lt.mpr (le_of_eq h1x))
          · exact Vector2D.ext h1x (le_antisymm h1y h2y)
        rw [if_pos hsc]
        show (⟨x.p2, x.p1⟩ : LineSegment) = x
        cases x; simp_all
      · rw [if_neg hsc]
    · 
      rw [if_neg hxc]
      push_neg at hxc
      obtain ⟨hxx, hxy⟩ := hxc
      have hsc : x.p2.x < x.p1.x ∨ x.p2.x = x.p1.x ∧ x.p2.y ≤ x.p1.y := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hxx with h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨h, le_of_lt (hxy h.symm)⟩
      rw [if_pos hsc]

name: flatMap_if_perm
statement:
private theorem flatMap_if_perm (l : List LineSegment) (P : LineSegment → Bool) :
    (l.flatMap (fun σ => if P σ then [σ] else [σ, σ])).Perm
      ((l.filter (fun σ => P σ)) ++
        (l.filter (fun σ => ! P σ)).flatMap (fun σ => [σ, σ]))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.filter_cons, List.filter_cons]
    by_cases h : P a = true
    · rw [if_pos h, h]
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
      
      exact (List.perm_cons a).mpr ih
    · rw [if_neg h]
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at h
      rw [h]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Bool.not_false, if_true, List.flatMap_cons]
      
      refine (List.Perm.append_left [a, a] ih).trans ?_
      rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc]
      exact List.Perm.append_right _ List.perm_append_comm

name: isSharedBool_iff_midpoint_mem_boundary
proof:
:= by
  unfold isSharedBool
  rw [List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_on⟩
    exact ⟨s, hs_mem, (pointOnSegmentBool_iff (segmentMidpoint σ) s.p1 s.p2
      (h2_nondeg s hs_mem)).mp hs_on⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_on⟩
    exact ⟨s, hs_mem,
      pointOnSegmentBool_of_mem_toSet s (segmentMidpoint σ) (h2_nondeg s hs_mem) hs_on⟩

name: isSharedBool_eq_of_arr_canon
statement:
private theorem isSharedBool_eq_of_arr_canon
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (σ0 : LineSegment)
    (hσ0 : σ0 ∈ (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg)
            (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg)).segments) :
    isSharedBool (canonSeg σ0) m2 =
      decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg)
        (canonSeg σ0))
proof:
:= by
  set G1 := m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg with hG1
  set G2 := m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg with hG2
  have hG2_bdy : G2.toBoundarySet = m2.toBoundarySet :=
    Multipolygon.toEvenGraph_toBoundarySet_eq m2 h2_len h2_nondeg
  
  have hmid : segmentMidpoint (canonSeg σ0) = segmentMidpoint σ0 := segmentMidpoint_canonSeg σ0
  have hσ0nd : σ0.p1 ≠ σ0.p2 := (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments_nondegenerate σ0 hσ0
  
  obtain ⟨hmid_on, hmid_ne1, hmid_ne2⟩ := segmentMidpoint_mem_open_interior σ0 hσ0nd
  
  have hshared_iff : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 (canonSeg σ0) ↔
      σ0.toSet ⊆ G2.toBoundarySet := by
    unfold EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared
    rw [EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.canonSeg_toSet]
  
  have hbool : isSharedBool (canonSeg σ0) m2 =
      decide (segmentMidpoint σ0 ∈ m2.toBoundarySet) := by
    rw [show isSharedBool (canonSeg σ0) m2
          = decide (segmentMidpoint (canonSeg σ0) ∈ m2.toBoundarySet) from ?_, hmid]
    · by_cases h : segmentMidpoint (canonSeg σ0) ∈ m2.toBoundarySet
      · rw [decide_eq_true h,
          (isSharedBool_iff_midpoint_mem_boundary (canonSeg σ0) m2 h2_nondeg).mpr h]
      · rw [decide_eq_false h]
        rcases hb : isSharedBool (canonSeg σ0) m2 with _ | _
        · rfl
        · exact absurd ((isSharedBool_iff_midpoint_mem_boundary (canonSeg σ0) m2 h2_nondeg).mp hb) h
  rw [hbool]
  
  rcases EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr_dichotomy G1 G2 σ0 hσ0 with h_trans | h_shared
  · 
    have hmid_not_bdy : segmentMidpoint σ0 ∉ m2.toBoundarySet := by
      intro hbd
      rw [← hG2_bdy] at hbd
      have := h_trans ⟨hmid_on, hbd⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at this
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact hmid_ne1 h
      · exact hmid_ne2 h
    have hsh_false : ¬ EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 (canonSeg σ0) := by
      intro hsh
      rw [hshared_iff, hG2_bdy] at hsh
      exact hmid_not_bdy (hsh hmid_on)
    rw [decide_eq_false hmid_not_bdy, decide_eq_false hsh_false]
  · 
    have hmid_bdy : segmentMidpoint σ0 ∈ m2.toBoundarySet := by
      rw [← hG2_bdy]; exact h_shared hmid_on
    have hsh : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 (canonSeg σ0) := by
      rw [hshared_iff]; exact h_shared
    rw [decide_eq_true hmid_bdy, decide_eq_true hsh]

name: canon_mem_arr_eq_canonSeg
statement:
private theorem canon_mem_arr_eq_canonSeg
    (G1 G2 : EvenGraph) (x : LineSegment) (hxc : canonSeg x = x)
    (hxem : x.toEndpointsMultiset ∈
        (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :
    ∃ σ0 ∈ (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments, x = canonSeg σ0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0_mem, hσ0_em⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxem
  refine ⟨σ0, hσ0_mem, ?_⟩
  
  have h := canonSeg_eq_of_toEM_eq σ0 x hσ0_em
  rw [hxc] at h
  exact h.symm

name: mem_map_canonSeg_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
    
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hs_eq, canonSeg_idem]
    · rw [← hs_eq, canonSeg_toEM]
      exact List.mem_map_of_mem _ hs_mem
  · rintro ⟨hxcanon, hxem⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_em⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxem
    
    have hcanon_eq : canonSeg s = canonSeg x := canonSeg_eq_of_toEM_eq s x hs_em
    rw [hxcanon] at hcanon_eq
    rw [← hcanon_eq]
    exact List.mem_map_of_mem _ hs_mem

name: sharedSelected_eq_filter
statement:
private theorem sharedSelected_eq_filter (G1 G2 : EvenGraph) :
    EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected G1 G2 =
      ((((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments.map canonSeg).dedup).filter
        (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ))).filter
        (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected
  rw [List.filter_filter]
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro σ _
  
  by_cases hQ : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ <;>
    by_cases hP : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ <;>
    simp [hP, hQ]

name: phantomDoubled_eq_filter
statement:
private theorem phantomDoubled_eq_filter (G1 G2 : EvenGraph) :
    EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled G1 G2 =
      (((((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments.map canonSeg).dedup).filter
        (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ))).filter
        (fun σ => ! decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))).flatMap
        (fun σ => [σ, σ])
proof:
:= by
  unfold EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled
  rw [List.filter_filter]
  congr 1
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro σ _
  by_cases hQ : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ <;>
    by_cases hP : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ <;>
    simp [hP, hQ]

name: sharedContribution_perm
statement:
theorem sharedContribution_perm
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    List.Perm
      (MultipolygonIntersectionAlgorithmImpl.sharedContribution m1 m2)
      (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected
          (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg) (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg) ++
        EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled
          (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg) (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg))
proof:
:= by
  set G1 := m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg with hG1
  set G2 := m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg with hG2
  
  set Dimpl : List LineSegment :=
    (dedupList ((refinedSegments' m1 m2).map canonSegImpl)).filter
      (fun σ => isSharedBool σ m2) with hDimpl
  set Dgen : List LineSegment :=
    (((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments.map canonSeg).dedup).filter
      (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ)) with hDgen
  
  have h_perm_em : List.Perm
      ((refinedSegments' m1 m2).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :=
    refinedSegments'_perm_arr m1 m2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg
  
  
  have hDimpl_nodup : Dimpl.Nodup := (dedupList_nodup _).filter _
  have hDgen_nodup : Dgen.Nodup := (List.nodup_dedup _).filter _
  
  
  have hmap_eq : (refinedSegments' m1 m2).map canonSegImpl =
      (refinedSegments' m1 m2).map canonSeg := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro σ _; exact canonSegImpl_eq_canonSeg σ
  
  have hmem_same : ∀ x, x ∈ Dimpl ↔ x ∈ Dgen := by
    intro x
    rw [hDimpl, hDgen, List.mem_filter, List.mem_filter]
    
    rw [dedupList_mem_iff, hmap_eq, mem_map_canonSeg_iff, List.mem_dedup, mem_map_canonSeg_iff]
    
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hxc, hxem_ref⟩, hshb⟩
      have hxem_arr := h_perm_em.mem_iff.mp hxem_ref
      
      obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0_mem, hx_eq⟩ := canon_mem_arr_eq_canonSeg G1 G2 x hxc hxem_arr
      refine ⟨⟨hxc, hxem_arr⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hx_eq] at hshb ⊢
      rw [← isSharedBool_eq_of_arr_canon m1 m2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg σ0 hσ0_mem]
      exact hshb
    · rintro ⟨⟨hxc, hxem_arr⟩, hshd⟩
      have hxem_ref := h_perm_em.mem_iff.mpr hxem_arr
      obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0_mem, hx_eq⟩ := canon_mem_arr_eq_canonSeg G1 G2 x hxc hxem_arr
      refine ⟨⟨hxc, hxem_ref⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hx_eq] at hshd ⊢
      rw [isSharedBool_eq_of_arr_canon m1 m2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg σ0 hσ0_mem]
      exact hshd
  have hB : Dimpl.Perm Dgen := perm_of_nodup_of_mem_iff hDimpl_nodup hDgen_nodup hmem_same
  
  
  have hC : ∀ σ ∈ Dimpl, onInterBoundaryBool σ m1 m2 =
      decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ) := by
    intro σ hσ
    
    have hσ_gen : σ ∈ Dgen := (hmem_same σ).mp hσ
    rw [hDgen, List.mem_filter, List.mem_dedup] at hσ_gen
    obtain ⟨hσ_in_map, hσ_shared_dec⟩ := hσ_gen
    obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0_mem, hσ0_canon⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hσ_in_map
    have hshared : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 σ0 := by
      have : EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared G2 (canonSeg σ0) := by
        rw [hσ0_canon]; exact of_decide_eq_true hσ_shared_dec
      unfold EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.IsShared at this ⊢
      rwa [EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.canonSeg_toSet] at this
    rw [← hσ0_canon]
    exact onInterBoundaryBool_eq m1 m2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg σ0 hσ0_mem hshared
  
  
  show (Dimpl.flatMap (fun σ => if onInterBoundaryBool σ m1 m2 then [σ] else [σ, σ])).Perm
    (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected G1 G2 ++
      EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled G1 G2)
  
  refine (flatMap_if_perm Dimpl (fun σ => onInterBoundaryBool σ m1 m2)).trans ?_
  
  have hfilt_true : Dimpl.filter (fun σ => onInterBoundaryBool σ m1 m2) =
      Dimpl.filter (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ)) := by
    apply List.filter_congr; intro σ hσ; exact hC σ hσ
  have hfilt_false : Dimpl.filter (fun σ => ! onInterBoundaryBool σ m1 m2) =
      Dimpl.filter (fun σ => ! decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ)) := by
    apply List.filter_congr; intro σ hσ; rw [hC σ hσ]
  rw [hfilt_true, hfilt_false]
  
  have hp_true : (Dimpl.filter
      (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))).Perm
    (Dgen.filter (fun σ => decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))) :=
    hB.filter _
  have hp_false : (Dimpl.filter
      (fun σ => ! decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))).Perm
    (Dgen.filter (fun σ => ! decide (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.onInterBoundary G1 G2 σ))) :=
    hB.filter _
  refine (List.Perm.append hp_true (hp_false.flatMap_right _)).trans ?_
  
  rw [← sharedSelected_eq_filter G1 G2, ← phantomDoubled_eq_filter G1 G2]

name: intersectionGraphSegments'_perm_interGraph
statement:
theorem intersectionGraphSegments'_perm_interGraph
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    List.Perm
      ((MultipolygonIntersectionAlgorithmImpl.intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph
        (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg) (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg)).segments.map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
proof:
:= by
  set G1 := m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg with hG1
  set G2 := m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg with hG2
  
  have ht1 : List.Perm
      ((selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m1 m2) m2).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((_root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments
        G2.interior).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :=
    selectInsideOther_refinedSegments'_perm_selectSegmentsInside_arr m1 m2
      h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg
  
  have ht2 : List.Perm
      ((selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m2 m1) m1).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((_root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G2 G1).segments
        G1.interior).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :=
    selectInsideOther_refinedSegments'_perm_selectSegmentsInside_arr m2 m1
      h2_len h1_len h2_nondeg h1_nondeg
  
  have hsh : List.Perm
      ((sharedContribution m1 m2).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected G1 G2 ++
        EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled G1 G2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :=
    (sharedContribution_perm m1 m2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg).map _
  
  rw [EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph_segments G1 G2]
  show ((selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m1 m2) m2 ++
      selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m2 m1) m1) ++ sharedContribution m1 m2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~
      (((_root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments
          G2.interior ++
        _root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G2 G1).segments
          G1.interior) ++
        EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.sharedSelected G1 G2) ++
        EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.phantomDoubled G1 G2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset
  
  simp only [List.map_append]
  
  
  rw [List.map_append] at hsh
  
  have htrans : ((selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m1 m2) m2).map
      LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ++
      (selectInsideOther (refinedSegments' m2 m1) m1).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset).Perm
    ((_root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G1 G2).segments
        G2.interior).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ++
      (_root_.selectSegmentsInside (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.arr G2 G1).segments
        G1.interior).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := ht1.append ht2
  
  have hfull := htrans.append hsh
  refine hfull.trans ?_
  
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  exact List.Perm.refl _

name: multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_polys_valid
statement:
theorem multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_polys_valid
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    ∀ poly ∈ (multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).polygons,
      poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨h_even, _⟩ := EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph_isEven_and_interior_eq
    (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg) (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg)
  set Gint : EvenGraph :=
    ⟨EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg)
      (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg), h_even⟩
  
  have h_construction : (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~
      Gint.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
    intersectionGraphSegments'_perm_interGraph m1 m2 h1_len h2_len
      h1_nondeg h2_nondeg
  
  have h_nondeg : ∀ s ∈ intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2, s.p1 ≠ s.p2 := by
    intro s hs h_deg
    have hs_in_image : s.toEndpointsMultiset ∈
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
      List.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
    have hs_in_gint : s.toEndpointsMultiset ∈
        Gint.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
      h_construction.mem_iff.mp hs_in_image
    obtain ⟨s', hs'_mem, hs'_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hs_in_gint
    have hs'_nondeg : s'.p1 ≠ s'.p2 := Gint.segments_nondegenerate s' hs'_mem
    have h_s'_nodup : s'.toEndpointsMultiset.Nodup :=
      EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.pair_nodup_iff.mpr hs'_nondeg
    have h_s_nodup : s.toEndpointsMultiset.Nodup := hs'_eq ▸ h_s'_nodup
    exact (EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.pair_nodup_iff.mp h_s_nodup) h_deg
  
  have h_inc_eq_general : ∀ (L : List LineSegment) (v : Vector2D),
      EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount L v =
      (L.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset).countP (fun m => decide (v ∈ m)) := by
    intro L v
    unfold EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount
    rw [List.countP_map]
    congr 1
    funext s
    show decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) = decide (v ∈ s.toEndpointsMultiset)
    show decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) =
      decide (v ∈ ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D))
    rw [show ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) = (s.p1 ::ₘ {s.p2}) from rfl]
    simp only [Multiset.mem_cons, Multiset.mem_singleton]
    have h_eq : (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) ↔ (v = s.p1 ∨ v = s.p2) := by
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · left; exact h.symm
        · right; exact h.symm
      · rintro (h | h)
        · left; exact h.symm
        · right; exact h.symm
    rw [show (decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v)) = decide (v = s.p1 ∨ v = s.p2) from
      decide_eq_decide.mpr h_eq]
  have h_even_intersection : ∀ v, Even
      (EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) v) := by
    intro v
    rw [h_inc_eq_general]
    rw [h_construction.countP_eq]
    rw [← h_inc_eq_general]
    exact h_even v
  
  have h_eq_decomp : (multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).polygons =
      EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.decomposeListFuel
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).length
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) := rfl
  rw [h_eq_decomp]
  exact EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.decomposeListFuel_polys_valid
    (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).length
    (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) (Nat.le_refl _) h_nondeg h_even_intersection

name: combine_attach_segments
statement:
private lemma combine_attach_segments
    (polys : List Polygon)
    (h_polys_valid : ∀ poly ∈ polys,
        poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    (EvenGraph.combine (polys.attach.map
      (fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => p.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid p hp).1
        (h_polys_valid p hp).2))).segments = polys.flatMap Polygon.segments
proof:
:= by
  rw [EvenGraph.combine_segments]
  
  
  
  
  show (polys.attach.map (fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => p.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid p hp).1
        (h_polys_valid p hp).2)).flatMap (·.segments) =
       polys.flatMap Polygon.segments
  rw [List.flatMap_map]
  show (polys.attach.flatMap (fun (x : {p // p ∈ polys}) =>
        (x.val.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).1
          (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).2).segments)) =
       polys.flatMap Polygon.segments
  
  rw [show (fun (x : {p // p ∈ polys}) =>
        (x.val.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).1
          (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).2).segments) =
        (fun (x : {p // p ∈ polys}) => x.val.segments) from rfl]
  
  show polys.attach.flatMap (fun (x : {p // p ∈ polys}) => x.val.segments) =
       polys.flatMap Polygon.segments
  clear h_polys_valid
  induction polys with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p rest ih =>
    simp only [List.attach_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_map, ih]

name: multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_combine_equiv
statement:
theorem multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_combine_equiv
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h_even : (EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg)
        (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg)).IsEven)
    (h_polys_valid : ∀ poly ∈ (multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).polygons,
        poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    (EvenGraph.combine ((multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).polygons.attach.map
      (fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => p.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid p hp).1
        (h_polys_valid p hp).2))).Equiv
    ⟨EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg)
      (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg), h_even⟩
proof:
:= by
  show _ ~ _
  rw [combine_attach_segments _ h_polys_valid]
  
  
  
  show ((decomposeSegments (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2)).flatMap
        Polygon.segments).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~ _
  
  set Gint : EvenGraph :=
    ⟨EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph (m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg)
      (m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg), h_even⟩
  have h_construction : (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~
      Gint.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
    intersectionGraphSegments'_perm_interGraph m1 m2 h1_len h2_len
      h1_nondeg h2_nondeg
  
  have h_nondeg : ∀ s ∈ intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2, s.p1 ≠ s.p2 := by
    intro s hs h_deg
    have hs_in_image : s.toEndpointsMultiset ∈
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
      List.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
    have hs_in_gint : s.toEndpointsMultiset ∈
        Gint.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset :=
      h_construction.mem_iff.mp hs_in_image
    obtain ⟨s', hs'_mem, hs'_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hs_in_gint
    have hs'_nondeg : s'.p1 ≠ s'.p2 := Gint.segments_nondegenerate s' hs'_mem
    have h_s'_nodup : s'.toEndpointsMultiset.Nodup :=
      EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.pair_nodup_iff.mpr hs'_nondeg
    have h_s_nodup : s.toEndpointsMultiset.Nodup := hs'_eq ▸ h_s'_nodup
    exact (EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.pair_nodup_iff.mp h_s_nodup) h_deg
  
  
  have h_inc_eq_general : ∀ (L : List LineSegment) (v : Vector2D),
      EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount L v =
      (L.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset).countP (fun m => decide (v ∈ m)) := by
    intro L v
    unfold EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount
    rw [List.countP_map]
    congr 1
    funext s
    show decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) = decide (v ∈ s.toEndpointsMultiset)
    show decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) =
      decide (v ∈ ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D))
    rw [show ({s.p1, s.p2} : Multiset Vector2D) = (s.p1 ::ₘ {s.p2}) from rfl]
    simp only [Multiset.mem_cons, Multiset.mem_singleton]
    have h_eq : (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v) ↔ (v = s.p1 ∨ v = s.p2) := by
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · left; exact h.symm
        · right; exact h.symm
      · rintro (h | h)
        · left; exact h.symm
        · right; exact h.symm
    rw [show (decide (s.p1 = v ∨ s.p2 = v)) = decide (v = s.p1 ∨ v = s.p2) from
      decide_eq_decide.mpr h_eq]
  have h_even_intersection : ∀ v, Even
      (EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.incCount (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) v) := by
    intro v
    rw [h_inc_eq_general]
    rw [h_construction.countP_eq]
    rw [← h_inc_eq_general]
    exact h_even v
  
  have h_decomp_perm := EvenGraphDecompositionProofs.decomposeListFuel_perm
    (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).length
    (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) (Nat.le_refl _) h_nondeg h_even_intersection
  
  have h_eq_decomp : decomposeSegments (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) =
      EvenGraphDecompositionImpl.decomposeListFuel
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2).length
        (intersectionGraphSegments' m1 m2) := rfl
  rw [h_eq_decomp]
  exact (h_decomp_perm.symm).trans h_construction

name: multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_correct
statement:
theorem multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_correct
    (m1 m2 : Multipolygon)
    (h1_len : ∀ poly ∈ m1.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : ∀ poly ∈ m2.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ m2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2) :
    m1.interior ∩ m2.interior =
      (multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).interior
proof:
:= by
  set G1 : EvenGraph := m1.toEvenGraph h1_len h1_nondeg with hG1_def
  set G2 : EvenGraph := m2.toEvenGraph h2_len h2_nondeg with hG2_def
  have hi1 : G1.interior = m1.interior :=
    Multipolygon.toEvenGraph_interior_eq m1 h1_len h1_nondeg
  have hi2 : G2.interior = m2.interior :=
    Multipolygon.toEvenGraph_interior_eq m2 h2_len h2_nondeg
  obtain ⟨h_even, h_interior_eq⟩ :=
    EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph_isEven_and_interior_eq G1 G2
  set Gint : EvenGraph :=
    ⟨EvenGraphIntersectionGenProofs.interGraph G1 G2, h_even⟩ with hGint_def
  have hGint_int : Gint.interior = m1.interior ∩ m2.interior := by
    rw [h_interior_eq, hi1, hi2]
  
  have h_polys_valid : ∀ poly ∈ (multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2).polygons,
      poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 :=
    multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_polys_valid m1 m2 h1_len h2_len
      h1_nondeg h2_nondeg
  
  set mout : Multipolygon := multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm m1 m2 with hmout_def
  have hmout_len : ∀ poly ∈ mout.polygons, poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 :=
    fun poly hp => (h_polys_valid poly hp).1
  have hmout_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ mout.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := by
    intro seg hseg
    obtain ⟨poly, hpoly, hps⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hseg
    exact (h_polys_valid poly hpoly).2 seg hps
  
  set polys := mout.polygons with hpolys_def
  set polyGraphs := polys.attach.map (fun ⟨p, hp⟩ =>
    p.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid p hp).1 (h_polys_valid p hp).2) with hpolyGraphs_def
  
  have h_total_equiv : (EvenGraph.combine polyGraphs).Equiv Gint :=
    multipolygonIntersectionAlgorithm_combine_equiv m1 m2 h1_len h2_len
      h1_nondeg h2_nondeg h_even h_polys_valid
  have h_combine_int : (EvenGraph.combine polyGraphs).interior =
      m1.interior ∩ m2.interior := by
    rw [h_total_equiv.interior_eq, hGint_int]
  
  have h_map_int : polyGraphs.map EvenGraph.interior = polys.map Polygon.interior := by
    show (polys.attach.map (fun (x : {p // p ∈ polys}) =>
        x.val.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).1
          (h_polys_valid x.val x.property).2)).map EvenGraph.interior =
      polys.map Polygon.interior
    rw [List.map_map]
    have hpolys_eq : polys = polys.attach.map Subtype.val := by simp
    conv_rhs => rw [hpolys_eq, List.map_map]
    refine List.map_congr_left ?_
    rintro ⟨p, hp⟩ _
    show (p.toEvenGraph _ _).interior = p.interior
    exact (Polygon.toEvenGraph_interior_eq p (h_polys_valid p hp).1
      (h_polys_valid p hp).2)
  
  have h_combine_bd_set : (EvenGraph.combine polyGraphs).toBoundarySet =
      mout.toBoundarySet := by
    rw [EvenGraph.combine_toBoundarySet]
    ext p
    
    
    show (p ∈ ⋃ G ∈ polyGraphs, G.toBoundarySet) ↔
         (∃ seg ∈ mout.segments, p ∈ seg.toSet)
    show _ ↔ (∃ seg ∈ polys.flatMap Polygon.segments, p ∈ seg.toSet)
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop, List.mem_flatMap]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨G', hG'_mem, hp_G'⟩
      simp only [hpolyGraphs_def, List.mem_map, List.mem_attach, true_and,
        Subtype.exists] at hG'_mem
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hq_eq⟩ := hG'_mem
      subst hq_eq
      rw [Polygon.toEvenGraph_boundary_eq] at hp_G'
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg_q, hp_seg⟩ := hp_G'
      exact ⟨seg, ⟨q, hq, hseg_q⟩, hp_seg⟩
    · rintro ⟨seg, ⟨q, hq, hseg_q⟩, hp_seg⟩
      refine ⟨q.toEvenGraph (h_polys_valid q hq).1 (h_polys_valid q hq).2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [hpolyGraphs_def, List.mem_map, List.mem_attach, true_and,
          Subtype.exists]
        exact ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      · rw [Polygon.toEvenGraph_boundary_eq q (h_polys_valid q hq).1
          (h_polys_valid q hq).2]
        exact ⟨seg, hseg_q, hp_seg⟩
  
  
  rw [Multipolygon.interior_eq_symmDiffAll_sdiff_boundary mout hmout_len hmout_nondeg,
      ← h_combine_int, EvenGraph.combine_interior_eq_symmDiff_sdiff_boundary,
      h_combine_bd_set, h_map_int]

name: segment_split
statement:
theorem segment_split (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet =
    (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hsx, hsy⟩ := h_pt
  ext p; simp only [LineSegment.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩ | ⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩)
    · exact ⟨u * s, mul_nonneg hu0 hs0, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
    · exact ⟨s + u * (1 - s), by nlinarith, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
  · intro ⟨t, ht0, ht1, htx, hty⟩
    by_cases hts : t ≤ s
    · by_cases hs_zero : s = 0
      · have ht_zero : t = 0 := le_antisymm (hs_zero ▸ hts) ht0
        left
        exact ⟨0, le_refl 0, zero_le_one, by simp [htx, ht_zero], by simp [hty, ht_zero]⟩
      · left
        have hs_pos : (0 : ℚ) < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_zero)
        exact ⟨t / s, div_nonneg ht0 (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ hts (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩
    · push_neg at hts
      by_cases hs1' : s = 1
      · linarith
      · right
        have h1s_pos : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - s := by linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hs1']
        exact ⟨(t - s) / (1 - s),
               div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hts)) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ (by linarith) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩

name: mem_replaceSegment
statement:
lemma mem_replaceSegment (segs : List LineSegment) (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (s : LineSegment) (h : s ∈ replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2) :
    s = seg1 ∨ s = seg2 ∨ s ∈ segs
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp [replaceSegment] at h
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [replaceSegment] at h
    split_ifs at h with heq
    · simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl | hmem
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hmem)))
    · simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with rfl | hmem
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)))
      · rcases ih hmem with h1 | h2 | h3
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h3)))

name: replaceSegment_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma replaceSegment_of_mem_ne (segs : List LineSegment) (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (s : LineSegment) (h_mem : s ∈ segs) (h_ne : s ≠ seg) :
    s ∈ replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at h_mem
    simp only [replaceSegment]
    split_ifs with heq
    · rcases h_mem with rfl | hmem
      · exact absurd heq h_ne
      · simp only [List.mem_cons]
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr hmem)
    · simp only [List.mem_cons]
      rcases h_mem with rfl | hmem
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (ih hmem)

name: seg1_mem_replaceSegment
statement:
lemma seg1_mem_replaceSegment (segs : List LineSegment) (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (h_mem : seg ∈ segs) : seg1 ∈ replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [replaceSegment]
    split_ifs with heq
    · simp [List.mem_cons]
    · simp only [List.mem_cons] at h_mem ⊢
      rcases h_mem with rfl | hmem
      · exact absurd rfl heq
      · exact Or.inr (ih hmem)

name: seg2_mem_replaceSegment
statement:
lemma seg2_mem_replaceSegment (segs : List LineSegment) (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (h_mem : seg ∈ segs) : seg2 ∈ replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [replaceSegment]
    split_ifs with heq
    · simp [List.mem_cons]
    · simp only [List.mem_cons] at h_mem ⊢
      rcases h_mem with rfl | hmem
      · exact absurd rfl heq
      · exact Or.inr (ih hmem)

name: replaceSegment_countP_relate
statement:
lemma replaceSegment_countP_relate (segs : List LineSegment) (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (h_mem : seg ∈ segs) (p : LineSegment → Bool) :
    (replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2).countP p + (if p seg then 1 else 0) =
    segs.countP p + (if p seg1 then 1 else 0) + (if p seg2 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at h_mem
    unfold replaceSegment
    by_cases heq : hd = seg
    · subst heq
      simp only [List.countP_cons]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    · rw [if_neg heq]
      have h_tl : seg ∈ tl := h_mem.resolve_left (fun h => heq h.symm)
      simp only [List.countP_cons]
      have ih' := ih h_tl
      cases hp : p hd <;> simp at ih' ⊢ <;> omega

name: replaceSegment_boundary_eq
statement:
lemma replaceSegment_boundary_eq (segs : List LineSegment)
    (seg seg1 seg2 : LineSegment)
    (h_mem : seg ∈ segs) (h_split : seg1.toSet ∪ seg2.toSet = seg.toSet) :
    { p | ∃ s ∈ replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2, p ∈ s.toSet } =
    { p | ∃ s ∈ segs, p ∈ s.toSet }
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs_mem, hp⟩
    rcases mem_replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2 s hs_mem with rfl | rfl | hs_orig
    · exact ⟨seg, h_mem, h_split ▸ Set.mem_union_left _ hp⟩
    · exact ⟨seg, h_mem, h_split ▸ Set.mem_union_right _ hp⟩
    · exact ⟨s, hs_orig, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs_mem, hp⟩
    by_cases h_eq : s = seg
    · rw [h_eq] at hp
      have hp' : p ∈ seg1.toSet ∪ seg2.toSet := h_split ▸ hp
      rcases hp' with hp1 | hp2
      · exact ⟨seg1, seg1_mem_replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2 h_mem, hp1⟩
      · exact ⟨seg2, seg2_mem_replaceSegment segs seg seg1 seg2 h_mem, hp2⟩
    · exact ⟨s, replaceSegment_of_mem_ne segs seg seg1 seg2 s hs_mem h_eq, hp⟩

name: segment_split_rayIntersects
statement:
lemma segment_split_rayIntersects (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, b⟩ ↔
    (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∨ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h_union := segment_split a b pt h_pt
  constructor
  · intro ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩
    have : q ∈ (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet :=
      h_union ▸ hq_seg
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩ | ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩)
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ Set.mem_union_left _ hq_seg⟩
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ Set.mem_union_right _ hq_seg⟩

name: ray_not_both_sub_segments
statement:
lemma ray_not_both_sub_segments (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    ¬(rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∧ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨⟨q1, hq1_ray, hq1_seg⟩, ⟨q2, hq2_ray, hq2_seg⟩⟩
  apply h_avoids
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1_0, ht1_1, hq1x, hq1y⟩ := hq1_seg
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2_0, ht2_1, hq2x, hq2y⟩ := hq2_seg
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hptx, hpty⟩ := h_pt
  obtain ⟨tr1, htr1_0, hq1x_r, hq1y_r⟩ := hq1_ray
  obtain ⟨tr2, htr2_0, hq2x_r, hq2y_r⟩ := hq2_ray
  dsimp only at hq1x hq1y hq2x hq2y hptx hpty
  by_cases ht1_eq_1 : t1 = 1
  · subst ht1_eq_1; simp at hq1x hq1y
    exact ⟨tr1, htr1_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  by_cases ht2_eq_0 : t2 = 0
  · subst ht2_eq_0; simp at hq2x hq2y
    exact ⟨tr2, htr2_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have ht1_lt_1 : t1 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1_1 ht1_eq_1
  have ht2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < t2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht2_0 (Ne.symm ht2_eq_0)
  set D := s * (1 - t1) + t2 * (1 - s) with hD_def
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    rw [hD_def]
    by_cases hs_eq_0 : s = 0
    · simp [hs_eq_0]; linarith
    · have : s > 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_eq_0)
      nlinarith
  have hD_ne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD_pos
  set u := s * (1 - t1) / D with hu_def
  have hu_0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
  have hu_1 : u ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hu_def]; exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by rw [hD_def]; nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
  have hcomb_x : pt.x * D = ((1 - u) * q1.x + u * q2.x) * D := by
    rw [hq1x, hq2x, hptx, hu_def]; field_simp; rw [hD_def]; ring
  have hcomb_y : pt.y * D = ((1 - u) * q1.y + u * q2.y) * D := by
    rw [hq1y, hq2y, hpty, hu_def]; field_simp; rw [hD_def]; ring
  have hcomb_x' : pt.x = (1 - u) * q1.x + u * q2.x :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hD_ne hcomb_x
  have hcomb_y' : pt.y = (1 - u) * q1.y + u * q2.y :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hD_ne hcomb_y
  exact ⟨(1 - u) * tr1 + u * tr2, by nlinarith,
         by rw [hcomb_x', hq1x_r, hq2x_r]; ring,
         by rw [hcomb_y', hq1y_r, hq2y_r]; ring⟩

name: segment_split_xor
statement:
lemma segment_split_xor (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩) then 1 else 0) +
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩) then 1 else 0) =
    (if decide (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, b⟩) then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h_split := segment_split_rayIntersects r a b pt h_pt
  have h_not_both := ray_not_both_sub_segments r a b pt h_pt h_avoids
  by_cases h1 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ <;>
  by_cases h2 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩ <;>
  simp_all

name: replaceSegment_crossing_eq
statement:
lemma replaceSegment_crossing_eq (r : Ray) (segs : List LineSegment)
    (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_mem : seg ∈ segs)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    (replaceSegment segs seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩).countP
      (fun s => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r s)) =
    segs.countP (fun s => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r s))
proof:
:= by
  have hcrel := replaceSegment_countP_relate segs seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩
    h_mem (fun s => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r s))
  have hxor := segment_split_xor r seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt h_avoids
  have h_eta : (⟨seg.p1, seg.p2⟩ : LineSegment) = seg := by
    cases seg; rfl
  rw [h_eta] at hxor
  simp only at hcrel hxor
  omega

name: exists_ray_avoiding_list
statement:
lemma exists_ray_avoiding_list (p : Vector2D) (verts : List Vector2D)
    (h_not_vert : ∀ v ∈ verts, v ≠ p) :
    ∃ r : Ray, r.origin = p ∧ r.toSet ∩ { q | q ∈ verts } = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have : Infinite ℚ := Infinite.of_injective (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℚ)) Nat.cast_injective
  let badSlopes : Finset ℚ := (verts.filterMap fun v =>
    if v.x > p.x then some ((v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x)) else none).toFinset
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finset.exists_not_mem badSlopes
  have h_nonzero : (⟨1, q⟩ : Vector2D) ≠ ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
    intro h; exact absurd (congrArg Vector2D.x h) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨⟨p, ⟨1, q⟩, h_nonzero⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hv_ray, hv_vert⟩ := hv
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv_vert
  obtain ⟨t, ht_nonneg, hvx, hvy⟩ := hv_ray
  simp only [mul_one] at hvx
  have hne : v ≠ p := h_not_vert v hv_vert
  have ht_eq : t = v.x - p.x := by linarith
  by_cases h_gt : v.x > p.x
  · have h_slope_mem : (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) ∈ badSlopes := by
      simp only [badSlopes, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
      exact ⟨v, hv_vert, by simp [if_pos h_gt]⟩
    have hvmy : v.y - p.y = t * q := by linarith
    rw [ht_eq] at hvmy
    have hvx_ne : v.x - p.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith : v.x - p.x > 0)
    have hq_eq : q = (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hvx_ne, mul_comm]; linarith
    exact hq (hq_eq ▸ h_slope_mem)
  · push_neg at h_gt
    by_cases h_eq : v.x = p.x
    · have ht_zero : t = 0 := by linarith
      have hvy_eq : v.y = p.y := by
        have := hvy; rw [ht_zero] at this; simp at this; exact this
      exact hne (by cases v; cases p; simp_all)
    · linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne h_gt h_eq]

name: graphRefinement_segments_eq
statement:
theorem graphRefinement_segments_eq
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet)
    (h_ne1 : pt ≠ seg.p1) (h_ne2 : pt ≠ seg.p2) :
    (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).segments =
    replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphRefinement
  rw [dif_neg (by push_neg; exact ⟨h_ne1, h_ne2⟩)]

name: graphRefinement_mem_toVertices
statement:
lemma graphRefinement_mem_toVertices
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) (v : Vector2D) :
    v ∈ (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).toVertices ↔
    v = pt ∨ v ∈ G.toVertices
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff] at hv
    obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, h_ep⟩ := hv
    unfold graphRefinement at hs_mem
    split_ifs at hs_mem with h_branch
    · exact Or.inr ((EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff G v).mpr ⟨s, hs_mem, h_ep⟩)
    · rcases mem_replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ s hs_mem with
        rfl | rfl | hs_orig
      · simp only at h_ep
        rcases h_ep with h_p1 | h_p2
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [← h_p1]
          exact G.p1_mem_toVertices h_seg
        · exact Or.inl h_p2.symm
      · simp only at h_ep
        rcases h_ep with h_p1 | h_p2
        · exact Or.inl h_p1.symm
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [← h_p2]
          exact G.p2_mem_toVertices h_seg
      · exact Or.inr ((EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff G v).mpr ⟨s, hs_orig, h_ep⟩)
  · rintro (rfl | hv)
    · rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff]
      unfold graphRefinement
      split_ifs with h_branch
      · rcases h_branch with rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨seg, h_seg, Or.inl rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨seg, h_seg, Or.inr rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨seg.p1, v⟩,
          seg1_mem_replaceSegment G.segments seg _ _ h_seg, Or.inr rfl⟩
    · rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff] at hv
      obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, h_ep⟩ := hv
      rw [EvenGraph.mem_toVertices_iff]
      unfold graphRefinement
      split_ifs with h_branch
      · exact ⟨s, hs_mem, h_ep⟩
      · by_cases h_eq : s = seg
        · subst h_eq
          rcases h_ep with h_p1 | h_p2
          · exact ⟨⟨s.p1, pt⟩, seg1_mem_replaceSegment G.segments s _ _ hs_mem, Or.inl h_p1⟩
          · exact ⟨⟨pt, s.p2⟩, seg2_mem_replaceSegment G.segments s _ _ hs_mem, Or.inr h_p2⟩
        · exact ⟨s, replaceSegment_of_mem_ne G.segments seg _ _ s hs_mem h_eq, h_ep⟩

name: graphRefinement_toVertexSet_eq
statement:
lemma graphRefinement_toVertexSet_eq
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).toVertexSet =
    insert pt G.toVertexSet
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
             graphRefinement_mem_toVertices G seg pt h_seg h_pt v]

name: refinement_boundary_eq
statement:
theorem refinement_boundary_eq
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).toBoundarySet =
    G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  simp only [graphRefinement]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · simp only [Graph.toBoundarySet]
    exact replaceSegment_boundary_eq G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩
      h_seg (segment_split seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt)

name: refinement_interior_eq
statement:
theorem refinement_interior_eq
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).interior =
    G.interior
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2
  · have : graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt = G := by
      simp only [graphRefinement, dif_pos h]
    rw [this]
  · push_neg at h
    set G' := graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt with hG'_def
    have hG'_segs : G'.segments = replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ := by
      simp only [hG'_def, graphRefinement,
                 dif_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2⟩)]
    have h_vset : G'.toVertexSet = insert pt G.toVertexSet :=
      graphRefinement_toVertexSet_eq G seg pt h_seg h_pt
    have h_bdy_eq : G'.toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet :=
      refinement_boundary_eq G seg pt h_seg h_pt
    have h_avoid_iff : ∀ p', (∀ s ∈ G'.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p' s) ↔
        (∀ s ∈ G.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p' s) := by
      intro p'
      simp only [pointAvoidsSegment]
      constructor
      · intro h_new s hs hp
        have : p' ∈ G.toBoundarySet := ⟨s, hs, hp⟩
        rw [← h_bdy_eq] at this
        obtain ⟨s', hs', hp'⟩ := this
        exact h_new s' hs' hp'
      · intro h_old s hs hp
        have : p' ∈ G'.toBoundarySet := ⟨s, hs, hp⟩
        rw [h_bdy_eq] at this
        obtain ⟨s', hs', hp'⟩ := this
        exact h_old s' hs' hp'
    have h_avoids_G'_to_G : ∀ r, rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G' → rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G := by
      intro r h_avoids
      rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset] at h_avoids
      rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at h_avoids
      intro v ⟨hv_ray, hv_mem⟩
      exact h_avoids v ⟨hv_ray, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hv_mem⟩
    have h_avoids_G'_pt : ∀ r, rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G' → pt ∉ r.toSet := by
      intro r h_avoids h_mem
      rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset] at h_avoids
      exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp h_avoids pt ⟨h_mem, Set.mem_insert pt _⟩
    have h_crossing_eq : ∀ r, pt ∉ r.toSet →
        intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G' = intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G := by
      intro r h_r_pt
      simp only [intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber, hG'_segs]
      exact replaceSegment_crossing_eq r G.segments seg pt h_seg h_pt h_r_pt
    ext p'
    simp only [EvenGraph.interior, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨h_avoid, h_cross⟩
      rw [h_avoid_iff] at h_avoid
      refine ⟨h_avoid, fun r hr h_avoids_G => ?_⟩
      by_cases h_r_pt : pt ∈ r.toSet
      · have h_p_on_r : p' ∈ r.toSet := by
          simp only [Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
          exact ⟨0, le_refl 0, by rw [hr]; ring, by rw [hr]; ring⟩
        have h_p_ne_pt : pt ≠ p' := by
          intro heq
          exact (h_avoid seg h_seg) (heq ▸ h_pt)
        have h_p_not_vert : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, v ≠ p' := by
          intro v hv heq
          exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp h_avoids_G p'
            ⟨h_p_on_r, heq ▸ hv⟩
        have h_p_not_vert' : ∀ v ∈ (pt :: G.toVertices), v ≠ p' := by
          intro v hv
          simp only [List.mem_cons] at hv
          rcases hv with rfl | hv
          · exact h_p_ne_pt
          · exact h_p_not_vert v hv
        obtain ⟨r', hr'_origin, hr'_avoids⟩ :=
          exists_ray_avoiding_list p' (pt :: G.toVertices) h_p_not_vert'
        have hr'_avoids_G' : rayAvoidsGraphVertices r' G' := by
          rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
          intro v ⟨hv_ray, hv_mem⟩
          rcases hv_mem with rfl | hv_mem
          · exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hr'_avoids v
              ⟨hv_ray, (List.mem_cons_self _ _)⟩
          · exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hr'_avoids v
              ⟨hv_ray, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv_mem⟩
        have h_cross_G' := h_cross r' hr'_origin hr'_avoids_G'
        have h_r'_pt := h_avoids_G'_pt r' hr'_avoids_G'
        rw [h_crossing_eq r' h_r'_pt] at h_cross_G'
        have hr'_avoids_G := h_avoids_G'_to_G r' hr'_avoids_G'
        have h_same_origin : sameOrigin r r' := by
          simp only [sameOrigin]; rw [hr, hr'_origin]
        have h_avoids_segs : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, pointAvoidsSegment r.origin s := by
          rw [hr]; exact h_avoid
        rw [intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsGraphVertices
          r r' G h_same_origin h_avoids_G hr'_avoids_G h_avoids_segs]
        exact h_cross_G'
      · have h_avoids_G' : rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G' := by
          rw [rayAvoidsGraphVertices, h_vset, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
          intro v ⟨hv_ray, hv_mem⟩
          rcases hv_mem with rfl | hv_mem
          · exact h_r_pt hv_ray
          · exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp h_avoids_G v ⟨hv_ray, hv_mem⟩
        have h_cross_G' := h_cross r hr h_avoids_G'
        rw [h_crossing_eq r h_r_pt] at h_cross_G'
        exact h_cross_G'
    · intro ⟨h_avoid, h_cross⟩
      rw [h_avoid_iff]
      refine ⟨h_avoid, fun r hr h_avoids_G' => ?_⟩
      have h_r_pt := h_avoids_G'_pt r h_avoids_G'
      have h_avoids_G := h_avoids_G'_to_G r h_avoids_G'
      rw [h_crossing_eq r h_r_pt]
      exact h_cross r hr h_avoids_G

name: sub_segment_far_endpoint_not_mem
statement:
lemma sub_segment_far_endpoint_not_mem (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_ne_a : pt ≠ a) (h_ne_b : pt ≠ b) (h_ab : a ≠ b) :
    b ∉ (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hptx, hpty⟩ := h_pt
  have hs_ne0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs; simp [hs] at hptx hpty
    exact h_ne_a (Vector2D.ext hptx hpty)
  have hs_ne1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro hs; simp [hs] at hptx hpty
    exact h_ne_b (Vector2D.ext hptx hpty)
  have hs_pos : (0 : ℚ) < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_ne0)
  have hs_lt1 : s < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hs_ne1
  intro ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hbx, hby⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  have hbx_eq : b.x * (1 - t * s) = a.x * (1 - t * s) := by
    have := hbx; rw [hptx] at this; nlinarith [mul_comm t s]
  have hby_eq : b.y * (1 - t * s) = a.y * (1 - t * s) := by
    have := hby; rw [hpty] at this; nlinarith [mul_comm t s]
  have hts : t * s < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hts_ne : (1 - t * s) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hbx_a : b.x = a.x := mul_right_cancel₀ hts_ne (by linarith)
  have hby_a : b.y = a.y := mul_right_cancel₀ hts_ne (by linarith)
  exact h_ab (Vector2D.ext hbx_a.symm hby_a.symm)

name: sub_segment_near_endpoint_not_mem
statement:
lemma sub_segment_near_endpoint_not_mem (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_ne_a : pt ≠ a) (h_ne_b : pt ≠ b) (h_ab : a ≠ b) :
    a ∉ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hptx, hpty⟩ := h_pt
  have hs_ne0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs; simp [hs] at hptx hpty
    exact h_ne_a (Vector2D.ext hptx hpty)
  have hs_ne1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro hs; simp [hs] at hptx hpty
    exact h_ne_b (Vector2D.ext hptx hpty)
  have hs_pos : (0 : ℚ) < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_ne0)
  have hs_lt1 : s < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hs_ne1
  intro ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hax, hay⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hax_eq : a.x * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s)) = b.x * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s)) := by
    have := hax; rw [hptx] at this; nlinarith [mul_comm t s, mul_comm (1 - t) (1 - s)]
  have hay_eq : a.y * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s)) = b.y * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s)) := by
    have := hay; rw [hpty] at this; nlinarith [mul_comm t s, mul_comm (1 - t) (1 - s)]
  have hfactor_pos : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s) := by nlinarith
  have hfactor_ne : (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - s)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hfactor_pos
  have hax_b : a.x = b.x := mul_right_cancel₀ hfactor_ne (by linarith)
  have hay_b : a.y = b.y := mul_right_cancel₀ hfactor_ne (by linarith)
  exact h_ab (Vector2D.ext hax_b hay_b)

name: graphRefinement_preserves_endpoint
statement:
lemma graphRefinement_preserves_endpoint
    (G : EvenGraph) (seg : LineSegment) (pt q : Vector2D)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments) (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet)
    (h_q_ep : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, q ∈ s.toSet → q = s.p1 ∨ q = s.p2) :
    ∀ s ∈ (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).segments,
      q ∈ s.toSet → q = s.p1 ∨ q = s.p2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [graphRefinement]
  split_ifs with h_ep
  · 
    exact h_q_ep
  · 
    push_neg at h_ep
    obtain ⟨h_ne1, h_ne2⟩ := h_ep
    have h_nd : seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := G.segments_nondegenerate seg h_seg
    intro s hs h_q_s
    rcases mem_replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ s hs with rfl | rfl | hs_orig
    · 
      
      have h_q_seg : q ∈ seg.toSet := by
        have := segment_split seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt
        rw [← this]
        exact Set.mem_union_left _ h_q_s
      rcases h_q_ep seg h_seg h_q_seg with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · 
        exfalso
        exact sub_segment_far_endpoint_not_mem seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt h_ne1 h_ne2 h_nd h_q_s
    · 
      have h_q_seg : q ∈ seg.toSet := by
        have := segment_split seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt
        rw [← this]
        exact Set.mem_union_right _ h_q_s
      rcases h_q_ep seg h_seg h_q_seg with rfl | rfl
      · 
        exfalso
        exact sub_segment_near_endpoint_not_mem seg.p1 seg.p2 pt h_pt h_ne1 h_ne2 h_nd h_q_s
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    · 
      exact h_q_ep s hs_orig h_q_s

name: strictPtCount_decreases
statement:
lemma strictPtCount_decreases (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D)
    (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_find : G.segments.find? (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) = some seg)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) :
    strictPtCount (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt) pt <
    strictPtCount G pt
proof:
:= by
  simp only [strictPtCount]
  set p : LineSegment → Bool := fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)
  have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
  have h_strict : ¬(pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2) := by
    intro h
    simp only [p, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred
    simp [decide_eq_true_eq.mpr h] at h_pred
  simp only [graphRefinement, dif_neg h_strict]
  have hcrel := replaceSegment_countP_relate G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ h_seg p
  have hp_seg : p seg = true := by
    simp only [p, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨h_pt, by simp [decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr h_strict]⟩
  have hp_seg1 : p ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ = false := by simp [p]
  have hp_seg2 : p ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ = false := by simp [p]
  simp [hp_seg, hp_seg1, hp_seg2] at hcrel
  omega

name: refineAllPt_segments_unique_seg
statement:
theorem refineAllPt_segments_unique_seg
    (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ G.segments)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet)
    (h_pt_ne_p1 : pt ≠ seg.p1)
    (h_pt_ne_p2 : pt ≠ seg.p2)
    (h_unique : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, pt ∈ s.toSet → ¬(pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2) → s = seg)
    (h_count_one : G.segments.countP
        (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) = 1) :
    (refineAllPt G pt).segments =
      replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩
proof:
:= by
  
  set p : LineSegment → Bool :=
    fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2) with hp_def
  
  have h_p_seg : p seg = true := by
    simp only [p, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true',
               decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    refine ⟨h_pt, ?_⟩
    push_neg
    exact ⟨h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩
  
  have h_pred_eq : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, p s = true → s = seg := by
    intro s hs hps
    simp only [p, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true',
               decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hps
    exact h_unique s hs hps.1 hps.2
  
  have h_strictPtCount : strictPtCount G pt = 1 := h_count_one
  
  have h_find : G.segments.find? p = some seg := by
    have h_isSome : (G.segments.find? p).isSome :=
      List.find?_isSome.mpr ⟨seg, h_seg, h_p_seg⟩
    rcases h_eq : G.segments.find? p with _ | s
    · rw [h_eq] at h_isSome; simp at h_isSome
    · have h_s_mem : s ∈ G.segments := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_eq
      have h_p_s : p s = true := List.find?_some h_eq
      rw [h_pred_eq s h_s_mem h_p_s]
  
  set G' := graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt with hG'_def
  
  have h_G'_segs : G'.segments =
      replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ :=
    graphRefinement_segments_eq G seg pt h_seg h_pt h_pt_ne_p1 h_pt_ne_p2
  
  unfold refineAllPt
  rw [h_strictPtCount]
  
  show (refineAllPtBounded 1 G pt).segments = _
  unfold refineAllPtBounded
  
  split
  · 
    rename_i h_none
    rw [h_find] at h_none
    exact absurd h_none (Option.some_ne_none seg)
  · 
    rename_i seg' h_find'
    
    have h_seg'_eq : seg' = seg := by
      rw [h_find] at h_find'
      exact ((Option.some.injEq _ _).mp h_find').symm
    
    subst h_seg'_eq
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    exact h_G'_segs

name: splitFlatMapFn_no_split
statement:
lemma splitFlatMapFn_no_split (pt : Vector2D) (segs : List LineSegment)
    (h_all : ∀ s ∈ segs, ¬ (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2)) :
    segs.flatMap (splitFlatMapFn pt) =
    segs.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    have h_hd := h_all hd (by simp)
    have h_tl : ∀ s ∈ tl, ¬ (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) :=
      fun s hs => h_all s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
    have h_hd_eq : splitFlatMapFn pt hd = [hd.toEndpointsMultiset] := by
      unfold splitFlatMapFn; rw [if_neg h_hd]
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_cons, h_hd_eq, List.singleton_append]
    rw [ih h_tl]

name: splitFlatMapFn_left_half
statement:
lemma splitFlatMapFn_left_half (pt p1 : Vector2D) :
    splitFlatMapFn pt ⟨p1, pt⟩ =
    [(⟨p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset]
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitFlatMapFn
  have h : ¬ (pt ∈ (⟨p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).toSet ∧
              pt ≠ (⟨p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).p1 ∧
              pt ≠ (⟨p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).p2) := by
    intro ⟨_, _, h⟩
    exact h rfl
  rw [if_neg h]

name: splitFlatMapFn_right_half
statement:
lemma splitFlatMapFn_right_half (pt p2 : Vector2D) :
    splitFlatMapFn pt ⟨pt, p2⟩ =
    [(⟨pt, p2⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset]
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitFlatMapFn
  have h : ¬ (pt ∈ (⟨pt, p2⟩ : LineSegment).toSet ∧
              pt ≠ (⟨pt, p2⟩ : LineSegment).p1 ∧
              pt ≠ (⟨pt, p2⟩ : LineSegment).p2) := by
    intro ⟨_, h, _⟩
    exact h rfl
  rw [if_neg h]

name: splitFlatMapFn_seg_pos
statement:
lemma splitFlatMapFn_seg_pos (pt : Vector2D) (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) (h_ne1 : pt ≠ seg.p1) (h_ne2 : pt ≠ seg.p2) :
    splitFlatMapFn pt seg =
    [(⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset,
     (⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset]
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitFlatMapFn
  rw [if_pos ⟨h_pt, h_ne1, h_ne2⟩]

name: replaceSegment_flatMap_eq
statement:
lemma replaceSegment_flatMap_eq (segs : List LineSegment) (seg : LineSegment)
    (pt : Vector2D) (h_mem : seg ∈ segs)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet) (h_ne1 : pt ≠ seg.p1) (h_ne2 : pt ≠ seg.p2) :
    (replaceSegment segs seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩).flatMap (splitFlatMapFn pt) =
    segs.flatMap (splitFlatMapFn pt)
proof:
:= by
  induction segs with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [replaceSegment]
    by_cases heq : hd = seg
    · subst heq
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
      rw [splitFlatMapFn_left_half, splitFlatMapFn_right_half,
          splitFlatMapFn_seg_pos pt hd h_pt h_ne1 h_ne2]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg heq]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at h_mem
      have h_tl : seg ∈ tl := h_mem.resolve_left (fun h => heq h.symm)
      rw [ih h_tl]

name: refineAllPtBounded_segments_perm
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_segments_perm
    (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_n : strictPtCount G pt ≤ n) :
    List.Perm
      ((refineAllPtBounded n G pt).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      (G.segments.flatMap (splitFlatMapFn pt))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    
    have h0 : strictPtCount G pt = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h_n
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    
    have h_all : ∀ s ∈ G.segments,
        ¬ (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) := by
      intro s hs ⟨h_in, h_ne1, h_ne2⟩
      have hc : (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) s = true := by
        have h_not_or : ¬(pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2) := by push_neg; exact ⟨h_ne1, h_ne2⟩
        simp [decide_eq_true_eq.mpr h_in, decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr h_not_or]
      have hpos : 0 < strictPtCount G pt := by
        simp only [strictPtCount]; exact List.countP_pos_iff.mpr ⟨s, hs, hc⟩
      omega
    rw [splitFlatMapFn_no_split pt G.segments h_all]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · 
      rename_i h_none
      have h_all : ∀ s ∈ G.segments,
          ¬ (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) := by
        intro s hs ⟨h_in, h_ne1, h_ne2⟩
        rw [List.find?_eq_none] at h_none
        have h_not_or : ¬(pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2) := by push_neg; exact ⟨h_ne1, h_ne2⟩
        have hc : (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) s = true := by
          simp [decide_eq_true_eq.mpr h_in, decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr h_not_or]
        exact absurd hc (h_none s hs)
      rw [splitFlatMapFn_no_split pt G.segments h_all]
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      have h_strict : ¬(pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2) := by
        have := h_pred
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true',
                   decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
        exact this.2
      push_neg at h_strict
      obtain ⟨h_ne1, h_ne2⟩ := h_strict
      
      set G' := graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt with hG'_def
      have h_dec := strictPtCount_decreases G pt seg h_find h_seg h_pt
      have h_n' : strictPtCount G' pt ≤ n :=
        Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h_dec h_n)
      have h_ih := ih G' h_n'
      
      have h_G'_segs : G'.segments =
          replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ :=
        graphRefinement_segments_eq G seg pt h_seg h_pt h_ne1 h_ne2
      
      have h_eq := replaceSegment_flatMap_eq G.segments seg pt h_seg h_pt h_ne1 h_ne2
      rw [h_G'_segs] at h_ih
      rw [h_eq] at h_ih
      exact h_ih

name: refineAllPt_segments_perm
statement:
theorem refineAllPt_segments_perm (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    List.Perm
      ((refineAllPt G pt).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      (G.segments.flatMap (fun s =>
        if (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) then
          [(⟨s.p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset,
           (⟨pt, s.p2⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset]
        else
          [s.toEndpointsMultiset]))
proof:
:= by
  have h := refineAllPtBounded_segments_perm (strictPtCount G pt) G pt (le_refl _)
  unfold refineAllPt
  unfold splitFlatMapFn at h
  exact h

name: refineAllPtBounded_boundary_eq
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_boundary_eq (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero => simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · rfl
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      rw [ih, refinement_boundary_eq]

name: refineAllPtBounded_interior_eq
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_interior_eq (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).interior = G.interior
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero => simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · rfl
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      rw [ih, refinement_interior_eq]

name: refineAllPtBounded_pt_endpoint
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_pt_endpoint (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_n : strictPtCount G pt ≤ n) :
    ∀ s ∈ (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).segments, pt ∈ s.toSet → pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    intro s hs h_pt_s
    by_contra h_not_ep
    have h0 : strictPtCount G pt = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h_n
    have hc : (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) s = true := by
      simp [decide_eq_true_eq.mpr h_pt_s, decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr h_not_ep]
    have hpos : 0 < strictPtCount G pt := by
      simp only [strictPtCount]; exact List.countP_pos_iff.mpr ⟨s, hs, hc⟩
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · 
      rename_i h_none
      intro s hs h_pt_s
      by_contra h_not_ep
      have hc : (fun s => decide (pt ∈ s.toSet) && !decide (pt = s.p1 ∨ pt = s.p2)) s = true := by
        simp [decide_eq_true_eq.mpr h_pt_s, decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr h_not_ep]
      rw [List.find?_eq_none] at h_none
      exact absurd hc (h_none s hs)
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      have h_dec := strictPtCount_decreases G pt seg h_find h_seg h_pt
      have h_n' : strictPtCount (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt) pt ≤ n :=
        Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h_dec h_n)
      exact ih _ h_n'

name: refineAllPtBounded_preserves_endpoint
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_preserves_endpoint (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt q : Vector2D)
    (h_q_ep : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, q ∈ s.toSet → q = s.p1 ∨ q = s.p2) :
    ∀ s ∈ (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).segments, q ∈ s.toSet → q = s.p1 ∨ q = s.p2
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero => simpa only [refineAllPtBounded]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · exact h_q_ep
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      exact ih _ (graphRefinement_preserves_endpoint G seg pt q h_seg h_pt h_q_ep)

name: refineAllPtBounded_segment_form
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_segment_form (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    ∀ s' ∈ (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).segments,
      ∃ s ∈ G.segments,
        s' = s ∨
        (s' = ⟨s.p1, pt⟩ ∧ pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) ∨
        (s' = ⟨pt, s.p2⟩ ∧ pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    intro s' hs'
    exact ⟨s', hs', Or.inl rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s' hs'
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded] at hs'
    split at hs'
    · 
      exact ⟨s', hs', Or.inl rfl⟩
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg_mem := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
      have h_pt_in : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred
        exact h_pred.1
      have h_pt_strict : ¬(pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2) := by
        have := h_pred
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true',
                   decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
        exact this.2
      push_neg at h_pt_strict
      obtain ⟨h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩ := h_pt_strict
      
      obtain ⟨s_1, h_s_1_in, h_s_1_form⟩ :=
        ih (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg_mem h_pt_in) s' hs'
      
      have h_s_1_in_replace :
          s_1 ∈ replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ := by
        unfold graphRefinement at h_s_1_in
        rw [dif_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩)] at h_s_1_in
        exact h_s_1_in
      rcases mem_replaceSegment G.segments seg ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ s_1 h_s_1_in_replace
        with h_s_1_eq | h_s_1_eq | h_s_1_orig
      · 
        refine ⟨seg, h_seg_mem, ?_⟩
        rcases h_s_1_form with h_eq |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩ |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩
        · 
          right; left
          refine ⟨h_eq.trans h_s_1_eq, h_pt_in, h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩
        · 
          exfalso
          apply h_pt_ne_s_1_p2
          rw [h_s_1_eq]
        · 
          exfalso
          apply h_pt_ne_s_1_p2
          rw [h_s_1_eq]
      · 
        refine ⟨seg, h_seg_mem, ?_⟩
        rcases h_s_1_form with h_eq |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩ |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩
        · 
          right; right
          refine ⟨h_eq.trans h_s_1_eq, h_pt_in, h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩
        · 
          exfalso
          apply h_pt_ne_s_1_p1
          rw [h_s_1_eq]
        · 
          exfalso
          apply h_pt_ne_s_1_p1
          rw [h_s_1_eq]
      · 
        refine ⟨s_1, h_s_1_orig, ?_⟩
        rcases h_s_1_form with h_eq |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩ |
            ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩
        · exact Or.inl h_eq
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s_1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p1, h_pt_ne_s_1_p2⟩)

name: refineGraphWithPoints_boundary_eq
statement:
lemma refineGraphWithPoints_boundary_eq :
    ∀ (G : EvenGraph) (pts : List Vector2D)
      (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet),
    (refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | G, pt :: rest, h_all => by

    have h_bdy_step : (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet
proof:

      refineAllPt_boundary_eq G pt
