name: refineGraphWithPoints_pts_endpoint
statement:
lemma refineGraphWithPoints_pts_endpoint :
    ∀ (G : EvenGraph) (pts : List Vector2D)
      (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet)
      (q : Vector2D) (_ : q ∈ pts)
      (seg : LineSegment) (_ : seg ∈ (refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).segments)
      (_ : q ∈ seg.toSet),
    q = seg.p1 ∨ q = seg.p2
  | _, [], _, _, hq, _, _, _ => nomatch hq
  | G, pt :: rest, h_all, q, hq, seg, hseg, hon => by
    simp only [refineGraphWithPoints] at hseg
    have h_bdy_step : (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:=
      refineAllPt_boundary_eq G pt
    have h_all' : ∀ q' ∈ rest, q' ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet := by
      intro q' hq'; rw [h_bdy_step]; exact h_all q' (List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr hq'))
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
    rcases hq with h_eq | hq_rest
    · 
      rw [h_eq]
      exact refineGraphWithPoints_preserves_endpoint
        (refineAllPt G pt) rest h_all' pt
        (refineAllPt_pt_endpoint G pt) seg hseg (h_eq ▸ hon)
    · 
      exact refineGraphWithPoints_pts_endpoint (refineAllPt G pt) rest h_all'
        q hq_rest seg hseg hon

name: iterativeSplit_swap_perm
statement:
lemma iterativeSplit_swap_perm (s : LineSegment) (pts : List Vector2D) :
    List.Perm
      ((iterativeSplit s pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((iterativeSplit ⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
proof:
:= by
  induction pts generalizing s with
  | nil =>
    simp only [iterativeSplit, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    
    have : LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset s =
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment) := by
      simp only [LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset]
      exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
    rw [this]
  | cons pt rest ih =>
    simp only [iterativeSplit]
    
    
    
    have h_toSet_eq : (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).toSet = s.toSet := by
      cases s with
      | mk a b => exact EvenGraphProofs.lineSegment_toSet_swap b a
    by_cases h : pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2
    · 
      have h' : pt ∈ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).toSet ∧
                  pt ≠ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).p1 ∧
                  pt ≠ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).p2 := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h_toSet_eq]; exact h.1
        · exact h.2.2
        · exact h.2.1
      rw [if_pos h, if_pos h']
      
      
      
      have ih1 := ih (⟨s.p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment)
      have ih2 := ih (⟨pt, s.p2⟩ : LineSegment)
      simp only at ih1 ih2
      
      
      rw [List.map_append, List.map_append]
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      exact (ih1.append ih2).trans (List.perm_append_comm)
    · 
      have h' : ¬ (pt ∈ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).toSet ∧
                  pt ≠ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).p1 ∧
                  pt ≠ (⟨s.p2, s.p1⟩ : LineSegment).p2) := by
        intro hh
        apply h
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← h_toSet_eq]; exact hh.1
        · exact hh.2.2
        · exact hh.2.1
      rw [if_neg h, if_neg h']
      exact ih s

name: iterativeSplit_perm_of_toEM_eq
statement:
lemma iterativeSplit_perm_of_toEM_eq (s s' : LineSegment) (pts : List Vector2D)
    (h : s.toEndpointsMultiset = s'.toEndpointsMultiset) :
    List.Perm
      ((iterativeSplit s pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((iterativeSplit s' pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
proof:
:= by
  
  cases s with
  | mk a b =>
  cases s' with
  | mk c d =>
  simp only [LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset] at h
  have ha_cases : a = c ∨ a = d := by
    have ha : a ∈ ({c, d} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
      rw [← h]; exact Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp ha with hc | hd
    · exact Or.inl hc
    · exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hd)
  rcases ha_cases with ha_eq | ha_eq
  · subst ha_eq
    
    have h_eq : ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) = {d} := by
      have step :
          Multiset.erase ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) a =
          Multiset.erase ({a, d} : Multiset Vector2D) a := by rw [h]
      have l1 : ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      have l2 : ({a, d} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({d} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      rw [l1, l2, Multiset.erase_cons_head, Multiset.erase_cons_head] at step
      exact step
    have hbd : b = d := by
      have : b ∈ ({d} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
        rw [← h_eq]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mp this
    subst hbd
    exact List.Perm.refl _
  · subst ha_eq
    
    
    have h_swap : ({c, a} : Multiset Vector2D) = ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) :=
      Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
    rw [h_swap] at h
    have h_eq : ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) = {c} := by
      have step :
          Multiset.erase ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) a =
          Multiset.erase ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) a := by rw [h]
      have l1 : ({a, b} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({b} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      have l2 : ({a, c} : Multiset Vector2D) = a ::ₘ ({c} : Multiset Vector2D) := rfl
      rw [l1, l2, Multiset.erase_cons_head, Multiset.erase_cons_head] at step
      exact step
    have hbc : b = c := by
      have : b ∈ ({c} : Multiset Vector2D) := by
        rw [← h_eq]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mp this
    subst hbc
    
    exact iterativeSplit_swap_perm ⟨a, b⟩ pts

name: iterativeSplit_append
statement:
theorem iterativeSplit_append (seg : LineSegment) (l1 l2 : List Vector2D) :
    iterativeSplit seg (l1 ++ l2) =
    (iterativeSplit seg l1).flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s l2)
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 generalizing seg with
  | nil =>
    
    
    simp only [List.nil_append, iterativeSplit, List.flatMap_cons,
      List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
  | cons pt rest ih =>
    
    by_cases hpt : pt ∈ seg.toSet ∧ pt ≠ seg.p1 ∧ pt ≠ seg.p2
    · have hLHS : iterativeSplit seg ((pt :: rest) ++ l2) =
          iterativeSplit ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ (rest ++ l2) ++
            iterativeSplit ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ (rest ++ l2) := by
        show iterativeSplit seg (pt :: (rest ++ l2)) = _
        show (if _ then _ else _) = _
        rw [if_pos hpt]
      have hRHS_step : iterativeSplit seg (pt :: rest) =
          iterativeSplit ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩ rest ++ iterativeSplit ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩ rest := by
        show (if _ then _ else _) = _
        rw [if_pos hpt]
      rw [hLHS, hRHS_step]
      rw [ih ⟨seg.p1, pt⟩, ih ⟨pt, seg.p2⟩]
      rw [List.flatMap_append]
    · have hLHS : iterativeSplit seg ((pt :: rest) ++ l2) =
          iterativeSplit seg (rest ++ l2) := by
        show iterativeSplit seg (pt :: (rest ++ l2)) = _
        show (if _ then _ else _) = _
        rw [if_neg hpt]
      have hRHS_step : iterativeSplit seg (pt :: rest) = iterativeSplit seg rest := by
        show (if _ then _ else _) = _
        rw [if_neg hpt]
      rw [hLHS, hRHS_step]
      exact ih seg

name: flatMap_iterativeSplit_perm_of_perm_toEM
statement:
lemma flatMap_iterativeSplit_perm_of_perm_toEM
    (pts : List Vector2D) :
    ∀ (L1 L2 : List LineSegment),
      List.Perm (L1.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
                (L2.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) →
      List.Perm
        ((L1.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
        ((L2.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
proof:
:= by
  intro L1
  induction L1 with
  | nil =>
    intro L2 h_perm
    
    simp only [List.map_nil] at h_perm
    have hL2 : L2.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset = [] :=
      (List.Perm.nil_eq h_perm).symm
    have hL2' : L2 = [] := by
      cases L2 with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ _ => exact absurd hL2 (by simp)
    subst hL2'
    exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons s L1' ih =>
    intro L2 h_perm
    
    simp only [List.map_cons] at h_perm
    have hmem : s.toEndpointsMultiset ∈ L2.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset := by
      have := h_perm.mem_iff (a := s.toEndpointsMultiset)
      exact this.mp (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    obtain ⟨s', hs'_mem, hs'_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
    
    obtain ⟨L2a, L2b, hL2_eq⟩ := List.append_of_mem hs'_mem
    subst hL2_eq
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_perm' : List.Perm (L1'.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
        ((L2a ++ L2b).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
      
      
      have h_full : List.Perm
          (s.toEndpointsMultiset :: L1'.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
          ((L2a ++ s' :: L2b).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := h_perm
      rw [List.map_append, List.map_cons, ← hs'_eq] at h_full
      
      
      have h_middle : List.Perm
          (L2a.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ++
            (s'.toEndpointsMultiset :: L2b.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset))
          (s'.toEndpointsMultiset ::
            (L2a.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ++
              L2b.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)) := by
        exact List.perm_middle
      have h_combined := h_full.trans h_middle
      
      have := List.Perm.cons_inv h_combined
      rw [List.map_append]
      exact this
    have h_ih := ih (L2a ++ L2b) h_perm'
    
    
    
    
    
    show List.Perm
      (((s :: L1').flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      (((L2a ++ s' :: L2b).flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_append]
    rw [List.map_append, List.map_append, List.map_append]
    
    
    
    have h_swap_split : List.Perm
        ((iterativeSplit s pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
        ((iterativeSplit s' pts).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) :=
      iterativeSplit_perm_of_toEM_eq s s' pts hs'_eq.symm
    
    have h_ih' : List.Perm
        ((L1'.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
        (((L2a.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)) ++
          (L2b.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts))).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
      have := h_ih
      simp only [List.flatMap_append] at this
      exact this
    rw [List.map_append] at h_ih'
    
    
    
    
    
    
    refine (h_swap_split.append h_ih').trans ?_
    
    
    
    
    
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc]
    
    
    exact (List.perm_append_comm).append_right _

name: refineGraphWithPoints_segments_perm
statement:
theorem refineGraphWithPoints_segments_perm
    (G : EvenGraph) (pts : List Vector2D) (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet) :
    List.Perm
      ((refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((G.segments.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s pts)).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
proof:
:= by
  induction pts generalizing G with
  | nil =>
    rw [refineGraphWithPoints_nil]
    
    have h_eq : G.segments.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s ([] : List Vector2D)) =
        G.segments := by
      have : (fun s : LineSegment => iterativeSplit s ([] : List Vector2D)) =
          (fun s => [s]) := by
        funext s; rfl
      rw [this]
      induction G.segments with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a t ih => simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.singleton_append, List.cons.injEq, true_and]; exact ih
    rw [h_eq]
  | cons pt rest ih =>
    have h_all' : ∀ q ∈ rest, q ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet := by
      intro q hq
      rw [refineAllPt_boundary_eq]
      exact h_all q (List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr hq))
    rw [refineGraphWithPoints_cons]
    have h_ih := ih (refineAllPt G pt) h_all'
    
    
    refine h_ih.trans ?_
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_single :=
      refineAllPt_segments_perm G pt
    
    
    
    
    let singleStep : LineSegment → List LineSegment := fun s =>
      if pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2 then
        [⟨s.p1, pt⟩, ⟨pt, s.p2⟩]
      else
        [s]
    
    have h_singleStep_map :
        (G.segments.flatMap singleStep).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset =
        G.segments.flatMap (fun s =>
          if (pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2) then
            [(⟨s.p1, pt⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset,
             (⟨pt, s.p2⟩ : LineSegment).toEndpointsMultiset]
          else
            [s.toEndpointsMultiset]) := by
      rw [List.map_flatMap]
      congr 1
      funext s
      by_cases h : pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2
      · simp only [singleStep, if_pos h, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
      · simp only [singleStep, if_neg h, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    
    have h_single' : List.Perm
        ((refineAllPt G pt).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
        ((G.segments.flatMap singleStep).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
      rw [h_singleStep_map]
      exact h_single
    
    have h_lift := flatMap_iterativeSplit_perm_of_perm_toEM rest _ _ h_single'
    refine h_lift.trans ?_
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_eq_lists :
        G.segments.flatMap (fun s => (singleStep s).flatMap (fun s' => iterativeSplit s' rest)) =
        G.segments.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s (pt :: rest)) := by
      congr 1
      funext s
      by_cases h : pt ∈ s.toSet ∧ pt ≠ s.p1 ∧ pt ≠ s.p2
      · simp only [singleStep, if_pos h, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil,
          iterativeSplit]
      · simp only [singleStep, if_neg h, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil,
          iterativeSplit]
    rw [List.flatMap_assoc]
    rw [h_eq_lists]

name: refineAllPtBounded_toVertexSet_subset
statement:
lemma refineAllPtBounded_toVertexSet_subset (n : ℕ) (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    (refineAllPtBounded n G pt).toVertexSet ⊆ insert pt G.toVertexSet
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    exact Set.subset_insert _ _
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [refineAllPtBounded]
    split
    · exact Set.subset_insert _ _
    · rename_i seg h_find
      have h_seg := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h_find
      have h_pred := List.find?_some h_find
      have h_pt : pt ∈ seg.toSet := by
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_pred; exact h_pred.1
      have h_step :=
        graphRefinement_toVertexSet_eq G seg pt h_seg h_pt
      have h_ih := ih (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt)
      intro v hv
      have h_mem : v ∈ insert pt (graphRefinement G seg pt h_seg h_pt).toVertexSet :=
        h_ih hv
      rw [Set.mem_insert_iff] at h_mem
      rcases h_mem with h_eq | h_in
      · exact h_eq ▸ Set.mem_insert _ _
      · rw [h_step] at h_in
        rcases h_in with h_eq2 | h_orig
        · exact h_eq2 ▸ Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ h_orig

name: refineAllPt_toVertexSet_subset
statement:
lemma refineAllPt_toVertexSet_subset (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D) :
    (refineAllPt G pt).toVertexSet ⊆ insert pt G.toVertexSet
proof:
:=
  refineAllPtBounded_toVertexSet_subset _ G pt

name: refineGraphWithPoints_toVertexSet_subset
statement:
lemma refineGraphWithPoints_toVertexSet_subset :
    ∀ (G : EvenGraph) (pts : List Vector2D)
      (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet),
    (refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).toVertexSet ⊆ G.toVertexSet ∪ { p | p ∈ pts }
  | _, [], _ => by
    simp only [refineGraphWithPoints]
    intro v hv
    exact Or.inl hv
  | G, pt :: rest, h_all => by
    simp only [refineGraphWithPoints]
    have h_bdy_step : (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet = G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:=
      refineAllPt_boundary_eq G pt
    have h_all' : ∀ q ∈ rest, q ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).toBoundarySet := by
      intro q hq; rw [h_bdy_step]; exact h_all q (List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr hq))
    have h_ih := refineGraphWithPoints_toVertexSet_subset (refineAllPt G pt) rest h_all'
    intro v hv
    rcases h_ih hv with h_step | h_rest
    · 
      rcases refineAllPt_toVertexSet_subset G pt h_step with h_eq | h_orig
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl h_eq))
      · exact Or.inl h_orig
    · 
      exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr h_rest))

name: refineAllPt_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices
statement:
lemma refineAllPt_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices (G : EvenGraph) (pt : Vector2D)
    (h_G : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, ∀ seg ∈ G.segments,
      seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet) :
    ∀ v ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).toVertices, ∀ seg ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).segments,
      seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv_vert seg h_seg h_p1_ne h_p2_ne h_v_in
  
  have h_v_set : v ∈ (refineAllPt G pt).toVertexSet := hv_vert
  have h_v_insert : v ∈ insert pt G.toVertexSet :=
    refineAllPt_toVertexSet_subset G pt h_v_set
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h_form⟩ := refineAllPt_segment_form G pt seg h_seg
  have h_s_nondeg : s.p1 ≠ s.p2 := G.segments_nondegenerate s hs
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp h_v_insert with h_v_pt | h_v_G
  · 
    have h_pt_in : pt ∈ seg.toSet := h_v_pt ▸ h_v_in
    have h_pt_ep : pt = seg.p1 ∨ pt = seg.p2 :=
      refineAllPt_pt_endpoint G pt seg h_seg h_pt_in
    rcases h_pt_ep with h | h
    · exact h_p1_ne (h.symm.trans h_v_pt.symm)
    · exact h_p2_ne (h.symm.trans h_v_pt.symm)
  · 
    have h_v_in_G : v ∈ G.toVertices := h_v_G
    rcases h_form with h_eq | ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s, h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩ |
        ⟨h_eq, h_pt_in_s, h_pt_ne_p1, h_pt_ne_p2⟩
    · 
      have h_p1_ne' : s.p1 ≠ v := by rw [← h_eq]; exact h_p1_ne
      have h_p2_ne' : s.p2 ≠ v := by rw [← h_eq]; exact h_p2_ne
      have h_v_in_s : v ∈ s.toSet := by rw [← h_eq]; exact h_v_in
      exact h_G v h_v_in_G s hs h_p1_ne' h_p2_ne' h_v_in_s
    · 
      have h_v_in_seg : v ∈ (LineSegment.mk s.p1 pt).toSet := by rw [← h_eq]; exact h_v_in
      have h_v_in_s : v ∈ s.toSet := subseg_p1_subset s pt h_pt_in_s h_v_in_seg
      
      have h_s_p1_ne : s.p1 ≠ v := by
        intro h; apply h_p1_ne; rw [h_eq]; exact h
      
      by_cases h_v_eq_p2 : v = s.p2
      · 
        have h_p2_in_seg : s.p2 ∈ (LineSegment.mk s.p1 pt).toSet := h_v_eq_p2 ▸ h_v_in_seg
        exact sub_segment_far_endpoint_not_mem s.p1 s.p2 pt h_pt_in_s
          h_pt_ne_p1 h_pt_ne_p2 h_s_nondeg h_p2_in_seg
      · 
        have h_s_p2_ne : s.p2 ≠ v := fun h => h_v_eq_p2 h.symm
        exact h_G v h_v_in_G s hs h_s_p1_ne h_s_p2_ne h_v_in_s
    · 
      have h_v_in_seg : v ∈ (LineSegment.mk pt s.p2).toSet := by rw [← h_eq]; exact h_v_in
      have h_v_in_s : v ∈ s.toSet := subseg_p2_subset s pt h_pt_in_s h_v_in_seg
      have h_s_p2_ne : s.p2 ≠ v := by
        intro h; apply h_p2_ne; rw [h_eq]; exact h
      by_cases h_v_eq_p1 : v = s.p1
      · 
        have h_p1_in_seg : s.p1 ∈ (LineSegment.mk pt s.p2).toSet := h_v_eq_p1 ▸ h_v_in_seg
        exact sub_segment_near_endpoint_not_mem s.p1 s.p2 pt h_pt_in_s
          h_pt_ne_p1 h_pt_ne_p2 h_s_nondeg h_p1_in_seg
      · have h_s_p1_ne : s.p1 ≠ v := fun h => h_v_eq_p1 h.symm
        exact h_G v h_v_in_G s hs h_s_p1_ne h_s_p2_ne h_v_in_s

name: refineGraphWithPoints_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices
statement:
lemma refineGraphWithPoints_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices :
    ∀ (G : EvenGraph) (pts : List Vector2D)
      (h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet),
    (∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, ∀ seg ∈ G.segments,
      seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet) →
    ∀ v ∈ (refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).toVertices,
      ∀ seg ∈ (refineGraphWithPoints G pts h_all).segments,
        seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet
  | _, [], _, h => h
  | G, pt :: rest, h_all, h => by
    simp only [refineGraphWithPoints]
    apply refineGraphWithPoints_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices
    exact refineAllPt_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices G pt h

/
    some segment of `G`. -/
def selfSegmentInteriorVertices (G : EvenGraph) : Set Vector2D

name: selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite
statement:
theorem selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite (G : EvenGraph) :
    Set.Finite (selfSegmentInteriorVertices G)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Finite.subset (s := G.toVertexSet) ?_ ?_
  · 
    apply Set.Finite.ofFinset G.toVertices.toFinset
    intro x
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Graph.toVertexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  · intro v hv
    exact hv.1

statement:

    selfSegmentInteriorVertices G ⊆ G.toBoundarySet
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨_, s, hs, h_on, _, _⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨s, hs, h_on⟩

statement:

statement:

name: refinementSelf_no_segment_interior_vertices
statement:
theorem refinementSelf_no_segment_interior_vertices (G : EvenGraph) :
    ∀ v ∈ (graphRefinementSelf G).toVertices,
      ∀ seg ∈ (graphRefinementSelf G).segments,
        seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv_vert seg h_seg h_p1_ne h_p2_ne h_v_in
  set h_fin := selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite G with h_fin_def
  set pts := h_fin.toFinset.toList with h_pts_def
  set G' := graphRefinementSelf G with hG'_def
  have h_all : ∀ pt ∈ pts, pt ∈ G.toBoundarySet := fun pt h_mem => by
    have h1 : pt ∈ h_fin.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem
    exact selfSegmentInteriorVertices_subset_boundary G (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mp h1)
  have h_pts_eq : pts = h_fin.toFinset.toList := rfl
  
  by_cases h_v_pts : v ∈ pts
  · 
    have h_ep : v = seg.p1 ∨ v = seg.p2 :=
      refineGraphWithPoints_pts_endpoint G pts h_all v h_v_pts seg h_seg h_v_in
    rcases h_ep with h | h
    · exact h_p1_ne h.symm
    · exact h_p2_ne h.symm
  · 
    have h_v_vset : v ∈ G.toVertexSet := by
      have h_v_in_G' : v ∈ G'.toVertexSet := hv_vert
      have h_subset := refineGraphWithPoints_toVertexSet_subset G pts h_all
      rcases h_subset h_v_in_G' with h | h_in_pts
      · exact h
      · 
        exact absurd h_in_pts h_v_pts
    
    have h_v_not_tj : v ∉ selfSegmentInteriorVertices G := by
      intro h_tj
      apply h_v_pts
      rw [h_pts_def]
      exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr h_tj)
    
    have h_v_ep_G : ∀ s ∈ G.segments, v ∈ s.toSet → v = s.p1 ∨ v = s.p2 := by
      intro s hs h_v_s
      by_contra h_not_ep
      push_neg at h_not_ep
      apply h_v_not_tj
      exact ⟨h_v_vset, s, hs, h_v_s, h_not_ep.1, h_not_ep.2⟩
    
    have h_v_ep_G' :=
      refineGraphWithPoints_preserves_endpoint G pts h_all v h_v_ep_G seg h_seg h_v_in
    rcases h_v_ep_G' with h | h
    · exact h_p1_ne h.symm
    · exact h_p2_ne h.symm

statement:

    G1.toBoundarySet
proof:
:=

name: refinementWrt_seg_inter_boundary_subset
statement:
theorem refinementWrt_seg_inter_boundary_subset
    (G1 G2 : EvenGraph)
    (h_fin : Set.Finite (G1.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet))
    (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_seg : seg ∈ (graphRefinementWrt G1 G2 h_fin).segments) :
    seg.toSet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet ⊆ ({seg.p1, seg.p2} : Set Vector2D)
proof:
:= by
  intro q ⟨hq_seg, hq_bdy⟩
  have h_bdy_eq := refinementWrt_boundary_eq G1 G2 h_fin
  have hq_G1 : q ∈ G1.toBoundarySet := h_bdy_eq ▸ ⟨seg, h_seg, hq_seg⟩
  have hq_list : q ∈ h_fin.toFinset.toList :=
    Finset.mem_toList.mpr (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨hq_G1, hq_bdy⟩)
  have h_all : ∀ pt ∈ h_fin.toFinset.toList, pt ∈ G1.toBoundarySet :=
    fun pt h_mem => (h_fin.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem)).1
  exact refineGraphWithPoints_pts_endpoint G1 h_fin.toFinset.toList h_all q hq_list seg h_seg hq_seg

name: graphRefinementWrt_preserves_no_segment_interior_vertices
statement:

name: refinementSelfAndWrt_no_segment_interior_vertices
statement:

        seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet
proof:

    (graphRefinementSelf G1) G2 _
    (refinementSelf_no_segment_interior_vertices G1)

name: graphRefinementSelfAndWrt_segments_perm
statement:
theorem graphRefinementSelfAndWrt_segments_perm
    (G1 G2 : EvenGraph)
    (h_fin12 : Set.Finite (G1.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet)) :
    let selfPts : List Vector2D
proof:
:=
      (selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite G1).toFinset.toList
    let wrtPts : List Vector2D :=
      (h_fin12.toFinset).toList
    List.Perm
      ((graphRefinementSelfAndWrt G1 G2 h_fin12).segments.map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((G1.segments.flatMap
        (fun s => iterativeSplit s (selfPts ++ wrtPts))).map
          LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
  
  
  
  set selfPts : List Vector2D :=
    (selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite G1).toFinset.toList with hselfPts_def
  set h_fin_self := selfSegmentInteriorVertices_finite G1 with h_fin_self_def
  
  have h_self_eq : graphRefinementSelf G1 =
      refineGraphWithPoints G1 selfPts (fun pt h_mem => by
        have h1 : pt ∈ h_fin_self.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem
        exact selfSegmentInteriorVertices_subset_boundary G1
          (h_fin_self.mem_toFinset.mp h1)) := rfl
  set G1' := graphRefinementSelf G1 with hG1'_def
  have hG1'_bnd : G1'.toBoundarySet = G1.toBoundarySet :=
    refinementSelf_boundary_eq G1
  set wrtPts : List Vector2D := h_fin12.toFinset.toList with hwrtPts_def
  
  have h_fin12' : Set.Finite (G1'.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet) := by
    rw [hG1'_bnd]; exact h_fin12
  
  
  
  
  
  have h1 : List.Perm
      ((graphRefinementSelfAndWrt G1 G2 h_fin12).segments.map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((G1'.segments.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s wrtPts)).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
    
    
    
    have h_set_eq : G1'.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet = G1.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet := by
      rw [hG1'_bnd]
    
    
    
    have h_all_wrt : ∀ pt ∈ wrtPts, pt ∈ G1'.toBoundarySet := by
      intro pt hpt
      rw [hwrtPts_def] at hpt
      have hpt' : pt ∈ h_fin12.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp hpt
      have hpt_inter : pt ∈ G1.toBoundarySet ∩ G2.toBoundarySet := h_fin12.mem_toFinset.mp hpt'
      rw [hG1'_bnd]; exact hpt_inter.1
    
    
    have h_finset_eq : h_fin12.toFinset = h_fin12'.toFinset := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro x
      rw [h_fin12.mem_toFinset, h_fin12'.mem_toFinset, h_set_eq]
    have h_def_eq :
        (graphRefinementSelfAndWrt G1 G2 h_fin12).segments =
        (refineGraphWithPoints G1' wrtPts h_all_wrt).segments := by
      show (graphRefinementWrt G1' G2 h_fin12').segments = _
      show (refineGraphWithPoints G1' h_fin12'.toFinset.toList _).segments =
        (refineGraphWithPoints G1' wrtPts h_all_wrt).segments
      
      
      have hL : h_fin12'.toFinset.toList = wrtPts := by
        rw [hwrtPts_def, ← h_finset_eq]
      
      revert h_all_wrt
      rw [← hL]
      intro h_all_wrt
      rfl
    rw [h_def_eq]
    exact refineGraphWithPoints_segments_perm G1' wrtPts h_all_wrt
  refine h1.trans ?_
  
  
  have h2 : List.Perm
      (G1'.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset)
      ((G1.segments.flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s selfPts)).map
        LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset) := by
    
    have h_all_self : ∀ pt ∈ selfPts, pt ∈ G1.toBoundarySet := fun pt h_mem => by
      have h1 : pt ∈ h_fin_self.toFinset := Finset.mem_toList.mp h_mem
      exact selfSegmentInteriorVertices_subset_boundary G1
        (h_fin_self.mem_toFinset.mp h1)
    have h_def_self : G1'.segments = (refineGraphWithPoints G1 selfPts h_all_self).segments := rfl
    rw [h_def_self]
    exact refineGraphWithPoints_segments_perm G1 selfPts h_all_self
  
  have h_lift := flatMap_iterativeSplit_perm_of_perm_toEM wrtPts _ _ h2
  refine h_lift.trans ?_
  
  
  
  rw [List.flatMap_assoc]
  
  
  have h_eq : ∀ s : LineSegment,
      (iterativeSplit s selfPts).flatMap (fun s' => iterativeSplit s' wrtPts) =
      iterativeSplit s (selfPts ++ wrtPts) := by
    intro s
    rw [iterativeSplit_append]
  have h_funext :
      (fun (x : LineSegment) =>
        (iterativeSplit x selfPts).flatMap (fun s => iterativeSplit s wrtPts)) =
      (fun (s : LineSegment) => iterativeSplit s (selfPts ++ wrtPts)) := by
    funext s
    exact h_eq s
  rw [h_funext]

name: list_sum_nat_eq_zero_iff_all_zero
statement:
private lemma list_sum_nat_eq_zero_iff_all_zero (l : List ℕ) :
    l.sum = 0 ↔ ∀ n ∈ l, n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih => simp [List.sum_cons, ih]

name: polyRaysExcess_zero_iff
statement:
private lemma polyRaysExcess_zero_iff (poly : Polygon) (rs : List Ray) :
    polyRaysExcess poly rs = 0 ↔ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, segRaysCount seg rs ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold polyRaysExcess
  rw [list_sum_nat_eq_zero_iff_all_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h seg hseg
    have := h (segRaysCount seg rs - 1) (List.mem_map_of_mem _ hseg)
    omega
  · intro h n hn
    rw [List.mem_map] at hn
    obtain ⟨seg, hseg, rfl⟩ := hn
    have := h seg hseg
    omega

name: toSet_eq_of_pos_scalar_dir
statement:
private lemma toSet_eq_of_pos_scalar_dir (r1 r2 : Ray)
    (h_origin : r1.origin = r2.origin)
    (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hdx : r1.direction.x = c * r2.direction.x)
    (hdy : r1.direction.y = c * r2.direction.y) :
    r1.toSet = r2.toSet
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsx, hsy⟩
    refine ⟨s * c, mul_nonneg hs hc.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsx, h_origin, hdx]; ring
    · rw [hsy, h_origin, hdy]; ring
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsx, hsy⟩
    refine ⟨s / c, div_nonneg hs hc.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsx, ← h_origin, hdx]; field_simp; ring
    · rw [hsy, ← h_origin, hdy]; field_simp; ring

name: common_point_origin_or_eq
statement:
private lemma common_point_origin_or_eq (r1 r2 : Ray)
    (h_origin : sameOrigin r1 r2)
    (p : Vector2D) (hp1 : p ∈ r1.toSet) (hp2 : p ∈ r2.toSet) :
    p = r1.origin ∨ r1.toSet = r2.toSet
proof:
:= by
  unfold sameOrigin at h_origin
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1_nn, hx1, hy1⟩ := hp1
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2_nn, hx2, hy2⟩ := hp2
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht1_nn with rfl | ht1_pos
  · left; simp at hx1 hy1
    ext
    · exact hx1
    · exact hy1
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht2_nn with rfl | ht2_pos
  · left; simp at hx2 hy2
    rw [← h_origin] at hx2 hy2
    ext
    · exact hx2
    · exact hy2
  right
  have h_eq_x : t1 * r1.direction.x = t2 * r2.direction.x := by
    have heq : r1.origin.x + t1 * r1.direction.x = r2.origin.x + t2 * r2.direction.x := by
      rw [← hx1, ← hx2]
    rw [h_origin] at heq; linarith
  have h_eq_y : t1 * r1.direction.y = t2 * r2.direction.y := by
    have heq : r1.origin.y + t1 * r1.direction.y = r2.origin.y + t2 * r2.direction.y := by
      rw [← hy1, ← hy2]
    rw [h_origin] at heq; linarith
  have ht1_ne : t1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht1_pos
  have hdx : r1.direction.x = (t2 / t1) * r2.direction.x := by
    field_simp; linarith
  have hdy : r1.direction.y = (t2 / t1) * r2.direction.y := by
    field_simp; linarith
  exact toSet_eq_of_pos_scalar_dir r1 r2 h_origin (t2 / t1)
    (div_pos ht2_pos ht1_pos) hdx hdy

name: distinct_common_point_is_origin
statement:
private lemma distinct_common_point_is_origin (r1 r2 : Ray)
    (h_origin : sameOrigin r1 r2)
    (h_ne : r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet)
    (p : Vector2D) (hp1 : p ∈ r1.toSet) (hp2 : p ∈ r2.toSet) :
    p = r1.origin
proof:
:=
  (common_point_origin_or_eq r1 r2 h_origin p hp1 hp2).resolve_right h_ne

name: exists_rat_in_open_ioo
statement:
private lemma exists_rat_in_open_ioo (a b : ℚ) (h_lt : a < b) (bad : Finset ℚ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, a < q ∧ q < b ∧ q ∉ bad
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℚ := fun n => a + (b - a) / (n + 2 : ℚ)
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by linarith
  have hba_ne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hba
  have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only [f] at hxy
    have h1 : (x + 2 : ℚ) > 0 := by positivity
    have h2 : (y + 2 : ℚ) > 0 := by positivity
    have h1_ne : (x + 2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1
    have h2_ne : (y + 2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2
    have h_eq : (b - a) / (x + 2 : ℚ) = (b - a) / (y + 2 : ℚ) := by linarith
    rw [div_eq_div_iff h1_ne h2_ne] at h_eq
    have hxy_eq : (x + 2 : ℚ) = (y + 2 : ℚ) := (mul_left_cancel₀ hba_ne h_eq).symm
    have : (x : ℚ) = (y : ℚ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hf_in : ∀ n, a < f n ∧ f n < b := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [f]
      have : (0 : ℚ) < (b - a) / (n + 2 : ℚ) := div_pos hba (by positivity)
      linarith
    · simp only [f]
      have h_pos : (0 : ℚ) < (n + 2 : ℚ) := by positivity
      have h1_lt : (1 : ℚ) < (n + 2 : ℚ) := by
        have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (n : ℚ) := by positivity
        linarith
      have h_div : (b - a) / (n + 2 : ℚ) < b - a := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ h_pos]
        nlinarith
      linarith
  let candidates : Finset ℕ := Finset.range (bad.card + 1)
  let img : Finset ℚ := candidates.image f
  have h_card : img.card = bad.card + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hf_inj, Finset.card_range]
  have h_exists : ∃ q ∈ img, q ∉ bad := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have h_sub : img ⊆ bad := h
    have : img.card ≤ bad.card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
    omega
  obtain ⟨q, hq_mem, hq_bad⟩ := h_exists
  obtain ⟨n, _, hn_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq_mem
  refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, hq_bad⟩
  · exact hn_eq ▸ (hf_in n).1
  · exact hn_eq ▸ (hf_in n).2

name: not_on_triA
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triA, Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hr]
  rintro ⟨t, ht, hx, hy⟩
  have hx' : t * r.direction.x = 1 := by linarith
  have hy' : t * r.direction.y = qA := by linarith
  by_cases h_dx_pos : r.direction.x > 0
  · apply h_not_bad
    refine ⟨h_dx_pos, ?_⟩
    linear_combination r.direction.y * hx' - r.direction.x * hy'
  · push_neg at h_dx_pos
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_dx_pos with h_zero | h_neg
    · rw [h_zero] at hx'; linarith
    · have h1 : t * r.direction.x ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht h_neg.le
      linarith

name: not_on_triB
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triB, Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hr]
  rintro ⟨t, ht, hx, hy⟩
  have hx' : t * r.direction.x = -1 := by linarith
  have hy' : t * r.direction.y = 1 + qB := by linarith
  by_cases h_dx_neg : r.direction.x < 0
  · apply h_not_bad
    refine ⟨h_dx_neg, ?_⟩
    linear_combination r.direction.y * hx' - r.direction.x * hy'
  · push_neg at h_dx_neg
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_dx_neg with h_zero | h_pos
    · rw [← h_zero] at hx'; linarith
    · have : 0 ≤ t * r.direction.x := mul_nonneg ht h_pos.le
      linarith

name: not_on_triC
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triC, Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hr]

    refine ⟨h_dx_neg, ?_⟩

    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_dx_neg with h_zero | h_pos
    · rw [← h_zero] at hx'; linarith
    · have : 0 ≤ t * r.direction.x := mul_nonneg ht h_pos.le
      linarith

name: triA_avoids_rays
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  apply not_on_triA o qA r (h_origin r hr)
  intro ⟨hdx, hqA_eq⟩
  apply h_qA
  simp only [badQsA, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  simp [if_pos hdx]
  have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdx
  field_simp
  linarith

name: ray_hits_seg_at
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_seg_at (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment) (t s : ℚ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (hx : r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x = (1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x)
    (hy : r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y = (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r seg
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨t, ht, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hx, hy⟩

name: ray_hits_AB_of_dxpos
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_AB_of_dxpos (o : Vector2D) (qA qB : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (_hqB1 : qB ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (hdxpos : r.direction.x > 0) (hslope : qA * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩
proof:
:= by
  
  set α := 2 * r.direction.y + r.direction.x * (1 + qB - qA) with hα_def
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
    have : 1 + qB - qA ≥ 3/4 := by linarith
    have h1 : r.direction.x * (1 + qB - qA) > 0 := mul_pos hdxpos (by linarith)
    have h2 : 2 * r.direction.y ≥ 2 * (qA * r.direction.x) := by linarith
    have h3 : qA * r.direction.x ≥ 0 := mul_nonneg hqA0 hdxpos.le
    linarith
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
  set t := (1 + qA + qB) / α with ht_def
  set s := (1 - t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by
    have : 0 ≤ 1 + qA + qB := by linarith
    exact div_nonneg this hα_pos.le
  have ht_dx_le_1 : t * r.direction.x ≤ 1 := by
    
    
    
    
    
    
    rw [ht_def]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hα_pos]
    rw [hα_def]
    nlinarith [hslope]
  have ht_dx_ge_m1 : -1 ≤ t * r.direction.x :=
    le_trans (by linarith) (mul_nonneg ht_nn hdxpos.le)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
  · 
    simp only [triA, triB]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    ring
  · 
    simp only [triA, triB]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    
    
    
    
    
    field_simp
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have ht_mul : t * α = 1 + qA + qB := by
      rw [ht_def]; field_simp
    linear_combination ht_mul

name: ray_hits_CA_of_dxpos
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_CA_of_dxpos (o : Vector2D) (qA qC : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (_hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (hdxpos : r.direction.x > 0) (hslope : r.direction.y < qA * r.direction.x) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩
proof:
:= by
  set α := r.direction.x * (1 + qA - qC) - 2 * r.direction.y with hα_def
  have h_qsum : qA + qC ≤ 1/2 := by linarith
  have h_qsum_lt_1 : qA + qC < 1 := by linarith
  have h_1pqAqC : 1 + qA - qC ≥ 3/4 := by linarith
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
    have h1 : 0 < r.direction.x * (1 - qA - qC) := mul_pos hdxpos (by linarith)
    
    
    nlinarith [h1, hslope, hdxpos]
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
  set t := (1 - qA - qC) / α with ht_def
  set s := (1 + t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by
    have : 0 ≤ 1 - qA - qC := by linarith
    exact div_nonneg this hα_pos.le
  have h_tdx_nn : 0 ≤ t * r.direction.x := mul_nonneg ht_nn hdxpos.le
  have ht_dx_le_1 : t * r.direction.x ≤ 1 := by
    rw [ht_def]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hα_pos]
    rw [hα_def]
    nlinarith [hslope]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
  · simp only [triA, triC]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    ring
  · simp only [triA, triC]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    field_simp
    have ht_mul : t * α = 1 - qA - qC := by
      rw [ht_def]; field_simp
    linear_combination -ht_mul

name: ray_hits_AB_of_dxneg
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_AB_of_dxneg (o : Vector2D) (qA qB : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (_hqB1 : qB ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (hdxneg : r.direction.x < 0)
    (hslope : r.direction.y > -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩
proof:
:= by
  set α := 2 * r.direction.y + r.direction.x * (1 + qB - qA) with hα_def
  have h_1pqBqA : 1 + qB - qA ≥ 3/4 := by linarith
  have h_1pqAqB_nn : 0 ≤ 1 + qA + qB := by linarith
  
  have hα_lb : α > -r.direction.x * (1 + qA + qB) := by
    have h1 : 2 * r.direction.y > -2 * (1 + qB) * r.direction.x := by linarith
    nlinarith [h1, hdxneg]
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
    have : 0 ≤ -r.direction.x * (1 + qA + qB) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    linarith
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
  set t := (1 + qA + qB) / α with ht_def
  set s := (1 - t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by
    exact div_nonneg h_1pqAqB_nn hα_pos.le
  have h_tdx_nonpos : t * r.direction.x ≤ 0 := by
    have hdx_nonpos : r.direction.x ≤ 0 := le_of_lt hdxneg
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht_nn hdx_nonpos
  have ht_dx_ge_m1 : -1 ≤ t * r.direction.x := by
    
    
    rw [ht_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hα_pos]
    nlinarith [hα_lb]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
  · simp only [triA, triB]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    ring
  · simp only [triA, triB]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    field_simp
    have ht_mul : t * α = 1 + qA + qB := by
      rw [ht_def]; field_simp
    linear_combination ht_mul

name: ray_hits_CA_of_dxneg
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_CA_of_dxneg (o : Vector2D) (qA qC : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (_hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (hdxneg : r.direction.x < 0)
    (hslope : r.direction.y < (1 - qC) * r.direction.x) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩
proof:
:= by
  set α := r.direction.x * (1 + qA - qC) - 2 * r.direction.y with hα_def
  have h_qsum_lt_1 : qA + qC < 1 := by linarith
  have h_1_sub_qAqC_pos : 0 < 1 - qA - qC := by linarith
  have h_1pqAqC_pos : 0 < 1 + qA - qC := by linarith
  
  have hα_lb : α > -r.direction.x * (1 - qA - qC) := by
    have h1 : -2 * r.direction.y > -2 * ((1 - qC) * r.direction.x) := by linarith
    nlinarith [h1, hdxneg]
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ -r.direction.x * (1 - qA - qC) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    linarith
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
  set t := (1 - qA - qC) / α with ht_def
  set s := (1 + t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg h_1_sub_qAqC_pos.le hα_pos.le
  have h_tdx_nonpos : t * r.direction.x ≤ 0 := by
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht_nn (le_of_lt hdxneg)
  have ht_dx_ge_m1 : -1 ≤ t * r.direction.x := by
    rw [ht_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hα_pos]
    nlinarith [hα_lb]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs_def]; linarith
  apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
  · simp only [triA, triC]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    ring
  · simp only [triA, triC]
    rw [hr, hs_def]
    field_simp
    have ht_mul : t * α = 1 - qA - qC := by
      rw [ht_def]; field_simp
    linear_combination -ht_mul

name: ray_hits_BC_of_dxneg
statement:
private lemma ray_hits_BC_of_dxneg (o : Vector2D) (qB qC : ℚ)
    (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (_hqB1 : qB ≤ 1/4) (_hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (hdxneg : r.direction.x < 0)
    (h_lo : (1 - qC) * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y)
    (h_hi : r.direction.y ≤ -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hdxneg
  
  
  
  set β := 2 + qB - qC with hβ_def
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := by rw [hβ_def]; linarith
  have hβ_ne : β ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hβ_pos
  have hdx_neg_pos : 0 < -r.direction.x := by linarith
  have hdx_neg_ne : -r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdx_neg_pos
  
  
  
  set t := 1 / (-r.direction.x) with ht_def
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by
    rw [ht_def]; exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hdx_neg_pos.le
  have h_tdx : t * r.direction.x = -1 := by
    rw [ht_def]; field_simp
  have h_tdy_eq2 : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) = r.direction.y := by
    rw [ht_def]; field_simp
  set s := ((1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) + (-r.direction.y)) / (β * (-r.direction.x)) with hs_def
  have hβdx_pos : 0 < β * (-r.direction.x) := mul_pos hβ_pos hdx_neg_pos
  have hβdx_ne : β * (-r.direction.x) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hβdx_pos
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs_def]
    apply div_nonneg _ hβdx_pos.le
    
    have : r.direction.y ≤ -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x := h_hi
    have h2 : (1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) = -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x := by ring
    linarith
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs_def, div_le_one hβdx_pos]
    
    
    
    have h_lo_r : (1 - qC) * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y := h_lo
    nlinarith [h_lo_r, hdxneg]
  apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
  · simp only [triB, triC]
    rw [hr]
    rw [h_tdx]
    ring
  · simp only [triB, triC]
    rw [hr]
    
    
    
    have hsβ_mul : s * β * (-r.direction.x) = (1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) + (-r.direction.y) := by
      rw [hs_def]; field_simp; ring
    have h_tdy_val : t * r.direction.y = 1 + qB - s * β := by
      have h_eq_mul : ((1 + qB - s * β) - t * r.direction.y) * (-r.direction.x) = 0 := by
        have hrew : ((1 + qB - s * β) - t * r.direction.y) * (-r.direction.x) =
            ((1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) - s * β * (-r.direction.x))
              - t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) := by ring
        rw [hrew, hsβ_mul, h_tdy_eq2]
        ring
      have : (1 + qB - s * β) - t * r.direction.y = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq_mul with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hdx_neg_ne
      linarith
    rw [hβ_def] at h_tdy_val
    linear_combination h_tdy_val

name: rayHitsAB_implies
statement:
private lemma rayHitsAB_implies (o : Vector2D) (qA qB : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_hit : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩) :
    qA * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y ∧
      r.direction.y ≥ -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨t, ht_nn, hpx_r, hpy_r⟩, ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hpx_s, hpy_s⟩⟩ := h_hit
  
  simp only [triA, triB] at hpx_s hpy_s
  rw [hpx_r, hr] at hpx_s
  rw [hpy_r, hr] at hpy_s
  have hx_eq : t * r.direction.x = 1 - 2 * s := by linarith
  have hy_eq : t * r.direction.y = qA + s * (1 + qB - qA) := by linarith
  
  
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht_nn with ht_zero | ht_pos
    · exfalso
      rw [← ht_zero] at hx_eq hy_eq
      have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [hs_half] at hy_eq
      
      
      nlinarith
    · exact ht_pos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h_mul : t * (r.direction.y - qA * r.direction.x) = s * (1 + qA + qB) := by
      have : t * r.direction.y - qA * (t * r.direction.x) = s * (1 + qA + qB) := by
        rw [hx_eq, hy_eq]; ring
      linarith [this]
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ s * (1 + qA + qB) :=
      mul_nonneg hs0 (by linarith)
    have h_lhs_nn : 0 ≤ t * (r.direction.y - qA * r.direction.x) := by
      rw [h_mul]; exact h_rhs_nn
    have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ r.direction.y - qA * r.direction.x :=
      nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_lhs_nn ht_pos
    linarith
  · 
    have h_mul : t * (r.direction.y + (1 + qB) * r.direction.x) =
        (1 + qA + qB) * (1 - s) := by
      have : t * r.direction.y + (1 + qB) * (t * r.direction.x) =
          (1 + qA + qB) * (1 - s) := by
        rw [hx_eq, hy_eq]; ring
      linarith [this]
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (1 + qA + qB) * (1 - s) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_lhs_nn : 0 ≤ t * (r.direction.y + (1 + qB) * r.direction.x) := by
      rw [h_mul]; exact h_rhs_nn
    have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ r.direction.y + (1 + qB) * r.direction.x :=
      nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_lhs_nn ht_pos
    linarith

name: rayHitsBC_implies
statement:
private lemma rayHitsBC_implies (o : Vector2D) (qB qC : ℚ)
    (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (_hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_hit : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩) :
    r.direction.x < 0 ∧
      (1 - qC) * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y ∧
      r.direction.y ≤ -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨t, ht_nn, hpx_r, hpy_r⟩, ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hpx_s, hpy_s⟩⟩ := h_hit
  simp only [triB, triC] at hpx_s hpy_s
  rw [hpx_r, hr] at hpx_s
  rw [hpy_r, hr] at hpy_s
  
  have hx_eq : t * r.direction.x = -1 := by linarith
  have hy_eq : t * r.direction.y = (1 + qB) - s * (2 + qB - qC) := by linarith
  
  have hdx_neg : r.direction.x < 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have : 0 ≤ t * r.direction.x := mul_nonneg ht_nn h
    linarith
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht_nn with ht_zero | ht_pos
    · exfalso; rw [← ht_zero] at hx_eq; linarith
    · exact ht_pos
  
  
  have h_coef_pos : 0 < 2 + qB - qC := by linarith
  have hy_lo : -1 + qC ≤ t * r.direction.y := by
    rw [hy_eq]
    have : s * (2 + qB - qC) ≤ 1 * (2 + qB - qC) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs1 h_coef_pos.le
    linarith
  have hy_hi : t * r.direction.y ≤ 1 + qB := by
    rw [hy_eq]
    have : 0 * (2 + qB - qC) ≤ s * (2 + qB - qC) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs0 h_coef_pos.le
    linarith
  
  have hmdx_pos : 0 < -r.direction.x := by linarith
  have h_t_mdx : t * (-r.direction.x) = 1 := by
    have : t * (-r.direction.x) = -(t * r.direction.x) := by ring
    rw [this, hx_eq]; ring
  refine ⟨hdx_neg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    
    
    
    have h1 : (-1 + qC) * (-r.direction.x) ≤ t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy_lo hmdx_pos.le
    have h2 : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) = r.direction.y := by
      have : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) = r.direction.y * (t * (-r.direction.x)) := by
        ring
      rw [this, h_t_mdx]; ring
    have h3 : (-1 + qC) * (-r.direction.x) = (1 - qC) * r.direction.x := by ring
    linarith
  · 
    
    
    have h1 : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) ≤ (1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy_hi hmdx_pos.le
    have h2 : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) = r.direction.y := by
      have : t * r.direction.y * (-r.direction.x) = r.direction.y * (t * (-r.direction.x)) := by
        ring
      rw [this, h_t_mdx]; ring
    have h3 : (1 + qB) * (-r.direction.x) = -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x := by ring
    linarith

name: rayHitsCA_implies
statement:
private lemma rayHitsCA_implies (o : Vector2D) (qA qC : ℚ)
    (_hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (_hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4) (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_hit : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩) :
    r.direction.y ≤ qA * r.direction.x ∧
      r.direction.y ≤ (1 - qC) * r.direction.x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨t, ht_nn, hpx_r, hpy_r⟩, ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hpx_s, hpy_s⟩⟩ := h_hit
  simp only [triC, triA] at hpx_s hpy_s
  rw [hpx_r, hr] at hpx_s
  rw [hpy_r, hr] at hpy_s
  
  have hx_eq : t * r.direction.x = 2 * s - 1 := by linarith
  have hy_eq : t * r.direction.y = (-1 + qC) + s * (1 + qA - qC) := by linarith
  
  
  
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht_nn with ht_zero | ht_pos
    · exfalso
      rw [← ht_zero] at hx_eq hy_eq
      have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [hs_half] at hy_eq
      nlinarith
    · exact ht_pos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h_mul : t * (qA * r.direction.x - r.direction.y) =
        (1 - qA - qC) * (1 - s) := by
      have : qA * (t * r.direction.x) - t * r.direction.y =
          (1 - qA - qC) * (1 - s) := by
        rw [hx_eq, hy_eq]; ring
      linarith [this]
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (1 - qA - qC) * (1 - s) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_lhs_nn : 0 ≤ t * (qA * r.direction.x - r.direction.y) := by
      rw [h_mul]; exact h_rhs_nn
    have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ qA * r.direction.x - r.direction.y :=
      nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_lhs_nn ht_pos
    linarith
  · 
    have h_mul : t * ((1 - qC) * r.direction.x - r.direction.y) =
        (1 - qA - qC) * s := by
      have : (1 - qC) * (t * r.direction.x) - t * r.direction.y =
          (1 - qA - qC) * s := by
        rw [hx_eq, hy_eq]; ring
      linarith [this]
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (1 - qA - qC) * s :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hs0
    have h_lhs_nn : 0 ≤ t * ((1 - qC) * r.direction.x - r.direction.y) := by
      rw [h_mul]; exact h_rhs_nn
    have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ (1 - qC) * r.direction.x - r.direction.y :=
      nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_lhs_nn ht_pos
    linarith

name: not_both_AB_BC
statement:
private lemma not_both_AB_BC (o : Vector2D) (qA qB qC : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_B_avoid : triB o qB ∉ r.toSet)
    (h_AB : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩)
    (h_BC : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h_AB2⟩ := rayHitsAB_implies o qA qB hqA0 hqB0 r hr h_AB
  obtain ⟨hdx_neg, _, h_BC2⟩ := rayHitsBC_implies o qB qC hqB0 hqC0 hqC1 r hr h_BC
  
  have h_eq : r.direction.y = -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x := by linarith
  
  apply h_B_avoid
  have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hdx_neg
  have hmdx_pos : 0 < -r.direction.x := by linarith
  refine ⟨1 / (-r.direction.x), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hmdx_pos.le
  · simp only [triB]
    rw [hr]
    have h_tdx : 1 / (-r.direction.x) * r.direction.x = -1 := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  · simp only [triB]
    rw [hr, h_eq]
    have h_tdx : 1 / (-r.direction.x) * (-(1 + qB) * r.direction.x) = 1 + qB := by
      field_simp; ring
    linarith

name: not_both_BC_CA
statement:
private lemma not_both_BC_CA (o : Vector2D) (qA qB qC : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC)
    (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_C_avoid : triC o qC ∉ r.toSet)
    (h_BC : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩)
    (h_CA : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdx_neg, h_BC_lo, _⟩ := rayHitsBC_implies o qB qC hqB0 hqC0 hqC1 r hr h_BC
  obtain ⟨_, h_CA_hi⟩ := rayHitsCA_implies o qA qC hqA0 hqC0 hqC1 hqA1 r hr h_CA
  
  have h_eq : r.direction.y = (1 - qC) * r.direction.x := by linarith
  apply h_C_avoid
  have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hdx_neg
  have hmdx_pos : 0 < -r.direction.x := by linarith
  refine ⟨1 / (-r.direction.x), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hmdx_pos.le
  · simp only [triC]
    rw [hr]
    have h_tdx : 1 / (-r.direction.x) * r.direction.x = -1 := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  · simp only [triC]
    rw [hr, h_eq]
    have h_tdy : 1 / (-r.direction.x) * ((1 - qC) * r.direction.x) = -(1 - qC) := by
      field_simp; ring
    linarith

name: not_both_AB_CA
statement:
private lemma not_both_AB_CA (o : Vector2D) (qA qB qC : ℚ)
    (hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA) (hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB) (hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC)
    (hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4) (hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4)
    (r : Ray) (hr : r.origin = o)
    (h_A_avoid : triA o qA ∉ r.toSet)
    (h_AB : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩)
    (h_CA : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h_AB1, h_AB2⟩ := rayHitsAB_implies o qA qB hqA0 hqB0 r hr h_AB
  obtain ⟨h_CA1, _⟩ := rayHitsCA_implies o qA qC hqA0 hqC0 hqC1 hqA1 r hr h_CA
  
  have h_eq : r.direction.y = qA * r.direction.x := by linarith
  
  rcases lt_trichotomy r.direction.x 0 with hdx_neg | hdx_zero | hdx_pos
  · 
    
    have h_pos : 0 < -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x := by nlinarith
    have h_dy_pos : 0 < r.direction.y := by linarith
    have h_dy_nonpos : r.direction.y ≤ 0 := by
      rw [h_eq]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hqA0 hdx_neg.le
    linarith
  · 
    have h_dy_zero : r.direction.y = 0 := by rw [h_eq, hdx_zero]; ring
    apply r.direction_nonzero
    ext
    · exact hdx_zero
    · exact h_dy_zero
  · 
    apply h_A_avoid
    have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdx_pos
    refine ⟨1 / r.direction.x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hdx_pos.le
    · simp only [triA]
      rw [hr]
      have h_tdx : 1 / r.direction.x * r.direction.x = 1 := by field_simp
      linarith
    · simp only [triA]
      rw [hr, h_eq]
      have h_tdy : 1 / r.direction.x * (qA * r.direction.x) = qA := by field_simp
      linarith

name: exists_initial_triangle
statement:
private lemma exists_initial_triangle
    (rs : List Ray) (o : Vector2D)
    (h_origin : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.origin = o) :
    ∃ poly : Polygon,
      poly.vertices.length = 3 ∧
      (∀ v ∈ poly.toVertices, ∀ r ∈ rs, v ∉ r.toSet) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, ∃ seg ∈ poly.segments, rayIntersectsSegment r seg) ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, o ∉ seg.toSet) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ seg1 ∈ poly.segments, ∀ seg2 ∈ poly.segments,
         rayIntersectsSegment r seg1 → rayIntersectsSegment r seg2 → seg1 = seg2) ∧
      poly.segments.Nodup ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, ∀ t : ℚ,
         ¬ (o.x = (1-t)*seg.p1.x + t*seg.p2.x ∧
            o.y = (1-t)*seg.p1.y + t*seg.p2.y))
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_lt : (0 : ℚ) < 1/4 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨qA, hqA_pos, hqA_lt, hqA_good⟩ :=
    exists_rat_in_open_ioo 0 (1/4) h_lt (badQsA rs)
  obtain ⟨qB, hqB_pos, hqB_lt, hqB_good⟩ :=
    exists_rat_in_open_ioo 0 (1/4) h_lt (badQsB rs)
  obtain ⟨qC, hqC_pos, hqC_lt, hqC_good⟩ :=
    exists_rat_in_open_ioo 0 (1/4) h_lt (badQsC rs)
  have hqA0 : 0 ≤ qA := le_of_lt hqA_pos
  have hqA1 : qA ≤ 1/4 := le_of_lt hqA_lt
  have hqB0 : 0 ≤ qB := le_of_lt hqB_pos
  have hqB1 : qB ≤ 1/4 := le_of_lt hqB_lt
  have hqC0 : 0 ≤ qC := le_of_lt hqC_pos
  have hqC1 : qC ≤ 1/4 := le_of_lt hqC_lt
  
  refine ⟨⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rfl
  · 
    intro v hv r hr
    simp only [Polygon.toVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_cons, (List.not_mem_nil _),
      or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact triA_avoids_rays o qA rs h_origin hqA_good r hr
    · exact triB_avoids_rays o qB rs h_origin hqB_good r hr
    · exact triC_avoids_rays o qC rs h_origin hqC_good r hr
  · 
    intro r hr
    have hr_origin := h_origin r hr
    
    have hsegs : (⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩ : Polygon).segments =
        [⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩] := by
      simp [Polygon.segments, List.zip]
    rw [hsegs]
    
    by_cases hdxpos : r.direction.x > 0
    · 
      by_cases hslope : qA * r.direction.x ≤ r.direction.y
      · 
        refine ⟨⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp
        · exact ray_hits_AB_of_dxpos o qA qB hqA0 hqA1 hqB0 hqB1 r hr_origin hdxpos hslope
      · 
        push_neg at hslope
        refine ⟨⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp
        · exact ray_hits_CA_of_dxpos o qA qC hqA0 hqA1 hqC0 hqC1 r hr_origin hdxpos hslope
    · push_neg at hdxpos
      by_cases hdxneg : r.direction.x < 0
      · 
        by_cases h_AB : r.direction.y > -(1 + qB) * r.direction.x
        · 
          refine ⟨⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp
          · exact ray_hits_AB_of_dxneg o qA qB hqA0 hqA1 hqB0 hqB1 r hr_origin hdxneg h_AB
        · push_neg at h_AB
          by_cases h_CA : r.direction.y < (1 - qC) * r.direction.x
          · 
            refine ⟨⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp
            · exact ray_hits_CA_of_dxneg o qA qC hqA0 hqA1 hqC0 hqC1 r hr_origin hdxneg h_CA
          · 
            push_neg at h_CA
            refine ⟨⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp
            · exact ray_hits_BC_of_dxneg o qB qC hqB0 hqB1 hqC0 hqC1 r hr_origin hdxneg h_CA h_AB
      · 
        push_neg at hdxneg
        have hdx_zero : r.direction.x = 0 := le_antisymm hdxpos hdxneg
        
        have hdy_ne : r.direction.y ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          apply r.direction_nonzero
          ext
          · exact hdx_zero
          · exact h0
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hdy_ne with hdy_neg | hdy_pos
        · 
          
          
          
          refine ⟨⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp
          · 
            set α := r.direction.x * (1 + qA - qC) - 2 * r.direction.y with hα_def
            have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
              rw [hα_def, hdx_zero]
              linarith
            have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
            set t := (1 - qA - qC) / α
            have hqAC : 0 < 1 - qA - qC := by linarith
            have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg hqAC.le hα_pos.le
            have h_tdx : t * r.direction.x = 0 := by rw [hdx_zero]; ring
            set s := (1 + t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
            have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by rw [hs_def, h_tdx]; ring
            have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs_half]; norm_num
            have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by rw [hs_half]; norm_num
            apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
            · simp only [triA, triC]; rw [hr_origin]
              rw [h_tdx]; rw [hs_half]; ring
            · simp only [triA, triC]; rw [hr_origin]
              rw [hs_half]
              have ht_mul : t * α = 1 - qA - qC := by
                show (1 - qA - qC) / α * α = 1 - qA - qC
                field_simp
              rw [hα_def, hdx_zero] at ht_mul
              linear_combination -ht_mul / 2
        · 
          refine ⟨⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp
          · set α := 2 * r.direction.y + r.direction.x * (1 + qB - qA) with hα_def
            have hα_pos : 0 < α := by
              rw [hα_def, hdx_zero]
              linarith
            have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα_pos
            set t := (1 + qA + qB) / α
            have hqAB_nn : 0 ≤ 1 + qA + qB := by linarith
            have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg hqAB_nn hα_pos.le
            have h_tdx : t * r.direction.x = 0 := by rw [hdx_zero]; ring
            set s := (1 - t * r.direction.x) / 2 with hs_def
            have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by rw [hs_def, h_tdx]; ring
            have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs_half]; norm_num
            have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by rw [hs_half]; norm_num
            apply ray_hits_seg_at r _ t s ht_nn hs0 hs1
            · simp only [triA, triB]; rw [hr_origin]
              rw [h_tdx]; rw [hs_half]; ring
            · simp only [triA, triB]; rw [hr_origin]
              rw [hs_half]
              have ht_mul : t * α = 1 + qA + qB := by
                show (1 + qA + qB) / α * α = 1 + qA + qB
                field_simp
              rw [hα_def, hdx_zero] at ht_mul
              linear_combination ht_mul / 2
  · 
    intro seg hseg
    have hsegs : (⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩ : Polygon).segments =
        [⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩] := by
      simp [Polygon.segments, List.zip]
    rw [hsegs] at hseg
    simp at hseg
    intro ho
    rcases hseg with h1 | h2 | h3
    · 
      subst h1
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hx, hy⟩ := ho
      simp only [triA, triB] at hx hy
      have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [hs_half] at hy
      
      
      
      linarith
    · 
      subst h2
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hx, hy⟩ := ho
      simp only [triB, triC] at hx
      
      linarith
    · 
      subst h3
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hx, hy⟩ := ho
      simp only [triC, triA] at hx hy
      have hs_half : s = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [hs_half] at hy
      linarith
  · 
    intro r hr seg1 hseg1 seg2 hseg2 h_r_seg1 h_r_seg2
    have hr_origin := h_origin r hr
    have hsegs : (⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩ : Polygon).segments =
        [⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩] := by
      simp [Polygon.segments, List.zip]
    rw [hsegs] at hseg1 hseg2
    simp at hseg1 hseg2
    have h_A_avoid : triA o qA ∉ r.toSet := triA_avoids_rays o qA rs h_origin hqA_good r hr
    have h_B_avoid : triB o qB ∉ r.toSet := triB_avoids_rays o qB rs h_origin hqB_good r hr
    have h_C_avoid : triC o qC ∉ r.toSet := triC_avoids_rays o qC rs h_origin hqC_good r hr
    rcases hseg1 with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases hseg2 with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (not_both_AB_BC o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqC1 r hr_origin h_B_avoid
        h_r_seg1 h_r_seg2) id
    · exact absurd (not_both_AB_CA o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqA1 hqC1 r hr_origin h_A_avoid
        h_r_seg1 h_r_seg2) id
    · exact absurd (not_both_AB_BC o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqC1 r hr_origin h_B_avoid
        h_r_seg2 h_r_seg1) id
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (not_both_BC_CA o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqA1 hqC1 r hr_origin h_C_avoid
        h_r_seg1 h_r_seg2) id
    · exact absurd (not_both_AB_CA o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqA1 hqC1 r hr_origin h_A_avoid
        h_r_seg2 h_r_seg1) id
    · exact absurd (not_both_BC_CA o qA qB qC hqA0 hqB0 hqC0 hqA1 hqC1 r hr_origin h_C_avoid
        h_r_seg2 h_r_seg1) id
    · rfl
  · 
    have hsegs : (⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩ : Polygon).segments =
        [⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩] := by
      simp [Polygon.segments, List.zip]
    rw [hsegs]
    
    
    have hA_ne_B : triA o qA ≠ triB o qB := by
      intro h
      have : (triA o qA).x = (triB o qB).x := congrArg Vector2D.x h
      simp only [triA, triB] at this
      linarith
    have hA_ne_C : triA o qA ≠ triC o qC := by
      intro h
      have : (triA o qA).x = (triC o qC).x := congrArg Vector2D.x h
      simp only [triA, triC] at this
      linarith
    have hB_ne_C : triB o qB ≠ triC o qC := by
      intro h
      have : (triB o qB).y = (triC o qC).y := congrArg Vector2D.y h
      simp only [triB, triC] at this
      linarith
    have h1_ne_2 : (LineSegment.mk (triA o qA) (triB o qB)) ≠
        (LineSegment.mk (triB o qB) (triC o qC)) := by
      intro h
      have : triA o qA = triB o qB := (LineSegment.mk.injEq _ _ _ _).mp h |>.1
      exact hA_ne_B this
    have h1_ne_3 : (LineSegment.mk (triA o qA) (triB o qB)) ≠
        (LineSegment.mk (triC o qC) (triA o qA)) := by
      intro h
      have : triA o qA = triC o qC := (LineSegment.mk.injEq _ _ _ _).mp h |>.1
      exact hA_ne_C this
    have h2_ne_3 : (LineSegment.mk (triB o qB) (triC o qC)) ≠
        (LineSegment.mk (triC o qC) (triA o qA)) := by
      intro h
      have : triB o qB = triC o qC := (LineSegment.mk.injEq _ _ _ _).mp h |>.1
      exact hB_ne_C this
    simp [List.Nodup, h1_ne_2, h1_ne_3, h2_ne_3]
  · 
    intro seg hseg t
    have hsegs : (⟨[triA o qA, triB o qB, triC o qC]⟩ : Polygon).segments =
        [⟨triA o qA, triB o qB⟩, ⟨triB o qB, triC o qC⟩, ⟨triC o qC, triA o qA⟩] := by
      simp [Polygon.segments, List.zip]
    rw [hsegs] at hseg
    simp at hseg
    intro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    rcases hseg with h1 | h2 | h3
    · 
      subst h1
      simp only [triA, triB] at hx hy
      
      have ht_half : t = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [ht_half] at hy
      
      linarith
    · 
      subst h2
      simp only [triB, triC] at hx
      
      linarith
    · 
      subst h3
      simp only [triC, triA] at hx hy
      
      have ht_half : t = 1/2 := by linarith
      rw [ht_half] at hy
      
      linarith

name: segment_split_set
statement:
private lemma segment_split_set (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet =
    (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hsx, hsy⟩ := h_pt
  ext p; simp only [LineSegment.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩ | ⟨u, hu0, hu1, hux, huy⟩)
    · exact ⟨u * s, mul_nonneg hu0 hs0, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
    · exact ⟨s + u * (1 - s), by nlinarith, by nlinarith,
            by rw [hux, hsx]; ring, by rw [huy, hsy]; ring⟩
  · intro ⟨t, ht0, ht1, htx, hty⟩
    by_cases hts : t ≤ s
    · by_cases hs_zero : s = 0
      · have ht_zero : t = 0 := le_antisymm (hs_zero ▸ hts) ht0
        left
        exact ⟨0, le_refl 0, zero_le_one, by simp [htx, ht_zero], by simp [hty, ht_zero]⟩
      · left
        have hs_pos : (0 : ℚ) < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_zero)
        exact ⟨t / s, div_nonneg ht0 (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ hts (le_of_lt hs_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩
    · push_neg at hts
      by_cases hs1' : s = 1
      · linarith
      · right
        have h1s_pos : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - s := by linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hs1']
        exact ⟨(t - s) / (1 - s),
               div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hts)) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               div_le_one_of_le₀ (by linarith) (le_of_lt h1s_pos),
               by rw [htx, hsx]; field_simp; ring,
               by rw [hty, hsy]; field_simp; ring⟩

name: segment_split_rayIntersects
statement:
private lemma segment_split_rayIntersects (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, b⟩ ↔
    (rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∨ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h_union := segment_split_set a b pt h_pt
  constructor
  · intro ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩
    have : q ∈ (LineSegment.mk a pt).toSet ∪ (LineSegment.mk pt b).toSet :=
      h_union ▸ hq_seg
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq_ray, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩ | ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩)
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ Set.mem_union_left _ hq_seg⟩
    · exact ⟨q, hq_ray, h_union ▸ Set.mem_union_right _ hq_seg⟩

name: ray_not_both_sub
statement:
private lemma ray_not_both_sub (r : Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    ¬(rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ ∧ rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨⟨q1, hq1_ray, hq1_seg⟩, ⟨q2, hq2_ray, hq2_seg⟩⟩
  apply h_avoids
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1_0, ht1_1, hq1x, hq1y⟩ := hq1_seg
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2_0, ht2_1, hq2x, hq2y⟩ := hq2_seg
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hptx, hpty⟩ := h_pt
  obtain ⟨tr1, htr1_0, hq1x_r, hq1y_r⟩ := hq1_ray
  obtain ⟨tr2, htr2_0, hq2x_r, hq2y_r⟩ := hq2_ray
  dsimp only at hq1x hq1y hq2x hq2y hptx hpty
  by_cases ht1_eq_1 : t1 = 1
  · subst ht1_eq_1; simp at hq1x hq1y
    exact ⟨tr1, htr1_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  by_cases ht2_eq_0 : t2 = 0
  · subst ht2_eq_0; simp at hq2x hq2y
    exact ⟨tr2, htr2_0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have ht1_lt_1 : t1 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1_1 ht1_eq_1
  have ht2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < t2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht2_0 (Ne.symm ht2_eq_0)
  set D := s * (1 - t1) + t2 * (1 - s) with hD_def
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    rw [hD_def]
    by_cases hs_eq_0 : s = 0
    · simp [hs_eq_0]; linarith
    · have : s > 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs_eq_0)
      nlinarith
  have hD_ne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD_pos
  set u := s * (1 - t1) / D with hu_def
  have hcomb_x : pt.x = (1 - u) * q1.x + u * q2.x := by
    rw [hq1x, hq2x, hu_def]; field_simp [hD_ne]; rw [hD_def, hptx]; ring
  have hcomb_y : pt.y = (1 - u) * q1.y + u * q2.y := by
    rw [hq1y, hq2y, hu_def]; field_simp [hD_ne]; rw [hD_def, hpty]; ring
  refine ⟨(1 - u) * tr1 + u * tr2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hu_0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
    have hu_1 : u ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hu_def]; exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by rw [hD_def]; nlinarith) (le_of_lt hD_pos)
    nlinarith
  · rw [hcomb_x, hq1x_r, hq2x_r]; ring
  · rw [hcomb_y, hq1y_r, hq2y_r]; ring

name: segRaysCount_split
statement:
private lemma segRaysCount_split (rs : List Ray) (a b pt : Vector2D)
    (h_pt : pt ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet)
    (h_avoids : ∀ r ∈ rs, pt ∉ r.toSet) :
    segRaysCount ⟨a, pt⟩ rs + segRaysCount ⟨pt, b⟩ rs = segRaysCount ⟨a, b⟩ rs
proof:
:= by
  unfold segRaysCount
  induction rs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons r rest ih =>
    have h_avoids_rest : ∀ r' ∈ rest, pt ∉ r'.toSet :=
      fun r' hr' => h_avoids r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr')
    have h_avoids_r : pt ∉ r.toSet := h_avoids r (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have h_split := segment_split_rayIntersects r a b pt h_pt
    have h_not_both := ray_not_both_sub r a b pt h_pt h_avoids_r
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have ih' := ih h_avoids_rest
    by_cases h1 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨a, pt⟩ <;>
      by_cases h2 : rayIntersectsSegment r ⟨pt, b⟩ <;>
      simp_all <;> omega

name: segRaysCount_ge_two
statement:
private lemma segRaysCount_ge_two (rs : List Ray) (seg : LineSegment)
    (_h_distinct : rs.Pairwise (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet))
    (r1 r2 : Ray) (hr1 : r1 ∈ rs) (hr2 : r2 ∈ rs) (hne : r1 ≠ r2)
    (hr1_int : rayIntersectsSegment r1 seg)
    (hr2_int : rayIntersectsSegment r2 seg) :
    2 ≤ segRaysCount seg rs
proof:
:= by
  unfold segRaysCount
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have h1_dec : decide (rayIntersectsSegment r1 seg) = true := by
    simp [hr1_int]
  have h2_dec : decide (rayIntersectsSegment r2 seg) = true := by
    simp [hr2_int]
  
  
  have h_countP_ge : ∀ (l : List Ray) (ra rb : Ray),
      ra ∈ l → rb ∈ l → ra ≠ rb →
      decide (rayIntersectsSegment ra seg) = true →
      decide (rayIntersectsSegment rb seg) = true →
      2 ≤ l.countP (fun r => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro ra rb h1 _ _ _ _; exact absurd h1 (List.not_mem_nil _)
    | cons x tail ih =>
      intro ra rb h1 h2 hne hd1 hd2
      rw [List.countP_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with rfl | h1'
      · 
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp h2 with rfl | h2'
        · exact absurd rfl hne
        · 
          have hd : decide (rayIntersectsSegment ra seg) = true := hd1
          have hcount : 1 ≤ tail.countP (fun r => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) := by
            have hmem : rb ∈ tail.filter (fun r => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) := by
              rw [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨h2', hd2⟩
            rw [List.countP_eq_length_filter]
            exact List.length_pos_of_mem hmem
          have hbool : (decide (rayIntersectsSegment ra seg) : Bool) = true := hd
          rw [if_pos hbool]
          omega
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h2 with rfl | h2'
        · 
          have hd : decide (rayIntersectsSegment rb seg) = true := hd2
          have hcount : 1 ≤ tail.countP (fun r => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) := by
            have hmem : ra ∈ tail.filter (fun r => decide (rayIntersectsSegment r seg)) := by
              rw [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨h1', hd1⟩
            rw [List.countP_eq_length_filter]
            exact List.length_pos_of_mem hmem
          have hbool : (decide (rayIntersectsSegment rb seg) : Bool) = true := hd
          rw [if_pos hbool]
          omega
        · 
          have hih := ih ra rb h1' h2' hne hd1 hd2
          split <;> omega
  exact h_countP_ge rs r1 r2 hr1 hr2 hne h1_dec h2_dec

name: exists_good_pt_on_seg
statement:
private lemma exists_good_pt_on_seg (rs : List Ray) (o : Vector2D)
    (_h_origin : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.origin = o)
    (seg : LineSegment)
    (h_p1 : ∀ r ∈ rs, seg.p1 ∉ r.toSet)
    (h_p2 : ∀ r ∈ rs, seg.p2 ∉ r.toSet)
    (h_p1_ne : seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h_no_origin : o ∉ seg.toSet) :
    ∃ pt : Vector2D, pt ∈ seg.toSet ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, pt ∉ r.toSet) ∧
      pt ≠ o ∧
      pt ≠ seg.p1 ∧ pt ≠ seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set denom : Ray → ℚ := fun r =>
    r.direction.x * (seg.p2.y - seg.p1.y) - r.direction.y * (seg.p2.x - seg.p1.x)
  set badSFor : Ray → Option ℚ := fun r =>
    if h : denom r ≠ 0 then
      some ((r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) - r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y)) / denom r)
    else none
  set badS : Finset ℚ := (rs.filterMap badSFor).toFinset
  have h_lt : (0 : ℚ) < 1 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨s, hs_pos, hs_lt, hs_good⟩ := exists_rat_in_open_ioo 0 1 h_lt badS
  refine ⟨⟨(1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x, (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine ⟨s, hs_pos.le, hs_lt.le, rfl, rfl⟩
  · 
    intro r hr h_on_r
    obtain ⟨t, ht_nn, htx, hty⟩ := h_on_r
    
    dsimp only at htx hty
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_key : s * denom r =
        r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) - r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) := by
      have hcross : r.direction.y * ((1-s)*seg.p1.x + s*seg.p2.x) -
                    r.direction.x * ((1-s)*seg.p1.y + s*seg.p2.y) =
                    r.direction.y * r.origin.x - r.direction.x * r.origin.y := by
        rw [htx, hty]; ring
      show s * denom r = _
      simp only [denom]
      linarith
    
    by_cases hdenom : denom r = 0
    · 
      
      
      
      
      rw [hdenom] at h_key
      have hrhs_zero : r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) - r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) = 0 := by linarith
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      have hdir := r.direction_nonzero
      by_cases hdx : r.direction.x = 0
      · have hdy_ne : r.direction.y ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply hdir
          ext; exact hdx; exact h
        
        have h_p1x : seg.p1.x = r.origin.x := by
          rw [hdx] at hrhs_zero
          have : r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) = 0 := by linarith
          have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hdy_ne
          linarith
        
        have h_p2x : seg.p2.x = seg.p1.x := by
          simp only [denom] at hdenom
          rw [hdx] at hdenom
          have : r.direction.y * (seg.p2.x - seg.p1.x) = 0 := by linarith
          have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hdy_ne
          linarith
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        set t1 := (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y with ht1_def
        set t2 := (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y with ht2_def
        
        have hp1_param_x : seg.p1.x = r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x := by
          rw [hdx]; rw [h_p1x]; ring
        have hp1_param_y : seg.p1.y = r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y := by
          rw [ht1_def]; field_simp; try linarith
        have hp2_param_x : seg.p2.x = r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x := by
          rw [hdx]; rw [h_p2x, h_p1x]; ring
        have hp2_param_y : seg.p2.y = r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y := by
          rw [ht2_def]; field_simp; try linarith
        
        have ht1_neg : t1 < 0 := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          exact h_p1 r hr ⟨t1, h, hp1_param_x, hp1_param_y⟩
        have ht2_neg : t2 < 0 := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          exact h_p2 r hr ⟨t2, h, hp2_param_x, hp2_param_y⟩
        
        have ht_eq : t * r.direction.y = (1-s)*t1*r.direction.y + s*t2*r.direction.y := by
          have := hty
          rw [hp1_param_y, hp2_param_y] at this
          linarith
        have ht_val : t = (1-s)*t1 + s*t2 := by
          have : r.direction.y * (t - ((1-s)*t1 + s*t2)) = 0 := by linarith
          have : t - ((1-s)*t1 + s*t2) = 0 := by
            rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
            · exact absurd h hdy_ne
            · exact h
          linarith
        have : t < 0 := by
          rw [ht_val]
          have : (1 - s) * t1 < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) ht1_neg
          have : s * t2 < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs_pos ht2_neg
          linarith
        linarith
      · 
        have hdx_ne : r.direction.x ≠ 0 := hdx
        
        
        
        set t1 := (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x with ht1_def
        set t2 := (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x with ht2_def
        have hp1_param_x : seg.p1.x = r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x := by
          rw [ht1_def]; field_simp; try linarith
        have hp1_param_y : seg.p1.y = r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y := by
          
          
          have : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) = r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) := by linarith
          rw [ht1_def]
          field_simp
          linarith
        have hp2_param_x : seg.p2.x = r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x := by
          rw [ht2_def]; field_simp; try linarith
        have hp2_param_y : seg.p2.y = r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y := by
          
          simp only [denom] at hdenom
          have hdenom' : r.direction.x * (seg.p2.y - seg.p1.y) =
                         r.direction.y * (seg.p2.x - seg.p1.x) := by linarith
          
          
          
          have h_diff : r.direction.x * (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) = r.direction.y * (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) := by
            have h_p1_rel : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) = r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) := by linarith
            linarith
          rw [ht2_def]
          field_simp
          linarith
        have ht1_neg : t1 < 0 := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          exact h_p1 r hr ⟨t1, h, hp1_param_x, hp1_param_y⟩
        have ht2_neg : t2 < 0 := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          exact h_p2 r hr ⟨t2, h, hp2_param_x, hp2_param_y⟩
        have ht_eq : t * r.direction.x = (1-s)*t1*r.direction.x + s*t2*r.direction.x := by
          have := htx
          rw [hp1_param_x, hp2_param_x] at this
          linarith
        have ht_val : t = (1-s)*t1 + s*t2 := by
