        ∃ h_distinct : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2,
          pG = poly.toEvenGraph h_len h_distinct) ∧
      G.Equiv (EvenGraph.combine polyGraphs)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨polys, hperm⟩ := exists_polygon_decomposition_perm G
  have h_flat_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ polys.flatMap Polygon.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := by
    intro seg hseg
    have hp_mem : f seg ∈ (polys.flatMap Polygon.segments).map f :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨seg, hseg, rfl⟩
    have hg_mem : f seg ∈ G.segments.map f := hperm.mem_iff.mpr hp_mem
    obtain ⟨seg', hseg', h_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hg_mem
    have h_nd : (f seg').Nodup :=
      pair_nodup_iff.mpr (G.segments_nondegenerate seg' hseg')
    rw [h_eq] at h_nd
    exact pair_nodup_iff.mp h_nd
  have h_all_nondeg : ∀ p ∈ polys, ∀ seg ∈ p.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := by
    intro p hp seg hseg
    apply h_flat_nondeg
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨p, hp, hseg⟩
  obtain ⟨polyGraphs, h_valid, h_flat⟩ := construct_polyGraphs polys h_all_nondeg
  refine ⟨polyGraphs, h_valid, ?_⟩
  show G.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~
       (EvenGraph.combine polyGraphs).segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset
  rw [EvenGraph.combine_segments, h_flat]
  exact hperm

name: decomposeListFuel_perm
statement:
theorem decomposeListFuel_perm :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : List LineSegment),
      L.length ≤ n →
      (∀ s ∈ L, s.p1 ≠ s.p2) →
      (∀ v, Even (incCount L v)) →
      L.map f ~ ((decomposeListFuel n L).flatMap Polygon.segments).map f
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro L hL h_nondeg h_even
    cases L with
    | nil =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [decomposeListFuel]
      | succ m => simp [decomposeListFuel]
    | cons s₀ rest =>
      have h_empty : (s₀ :: rest) ≠ [] := List.cons_ne_nil _ _
      cases n with
      | zero => simp at hL
      | succ m =>
        let L : List LineSegment := s₀ :: rest
        have hL_def : L = s₀ :: rest := rfl
        let u := s₀.p1
        have hs₀ : s₀ ∈ L := (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
        
        obtain ⟨s, vnext, rec_path, rec_rem, h_s_mem, _, _, h_vnext_ne_u, h_walk_eq, h_rec_eq⟩ :=
          walkFromFuel_takes_step L u s₀ hs₀ (Or.inl rfl) h_nondeg
        have h_path_eq : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 = u :: rec_path := by
          rw [h_walk_eq]
        have h_rem_eq : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2 = rec_rem := by
          rw [h_walk_eq]
        have h_last : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.getLast? = some u :=
          walkFromFuel_closes_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        rw [h_path_eq] at h_last
        have h_rec_path_ne : rec_path ≠ [] := by
          have := walkFromFuel_ne_nil (L.length - 1) (L.erase s) vnext
          rw [h_rec_eq] at this
          exact this
        obtain ⟨vnext', rest', h_rec_eq2⟩ :
            ∃ n' r, rec_path = n' :: r := by
          rcases rec_path with _ | ⟨n', r⟩
          · exact absurd rfl h_rec_path_ne
          · exact ⟨n', r, rfl⟩
        have h_vnext'_eq : vnext' = vnext := by
          have := walkFromFuel_head (L.length - 1) (L.erase s) vnext
          rw [h_rec_eq, h_rec_eq2] at this
          simpa using this
        rw [h_vnext'_eq] at h_rec_eq2
        clear h_vnext'_eq vnext'
        have h_rest_ne : rest' ≠ [] := by
          intro h_rest_nil
          subst h_rest_nil
          have h_vnext_u : vnext = u := by
            rw [h_rec_eq2] at h_last
            simp [List.getLast?] at h_last
            exact h_last
          exact h_vnext_ne_u h_vnext_u
        obtain ⟨v₃, rest'', h_rest_eq⟩ :
            ∃ v₃ r'', rest' = v₃ :: r'' := by
          rcases rest' with _ | ⟨v₃, r''⟩
          · exact absurd rfl h_rest_ne
          · exact ⟨v₃, r'', rfl⟩
        subst h_rest_eq
        have h_path_full : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 = u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'' := by
          rw [h_path_eq, h_rec_eq2]
        have h_closed : (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').getLast? = some u := by
          rw [← h_path_full]; exact walkFromFuel_closes_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        have h_walk_poly : walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'') =
            (Polygon.mk (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').dropLast).segments :=
          walkEdges_eq_polygon_of_closed_ge3 u vnext v₃ rest'' h_closed
        have h_perm : L.map f ~ (walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 ++
            (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).map f :=
          walkFromFuel_perm _ _ _
        have h_len_eq : L.length =
            (walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1).length +
            (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length := by
          have := h_perm.length_eq
          simp at this
          exact this
        have h_walkE_len : (walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'')).length ≥ 2 := by
          simp [walkEdges_cons_cons]
        have h_rem_short : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length < L.length := by
          rw [h_path_full] at h_len_eq
          omega
        have h_rem_even : ∀ v, Even (incCount (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2 v) :=
          walkFromFuel_rem_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        have h_rem_nondeg : ∀ s' ∈ (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2, s'.p1 ≠ s'.p2 :=
          fun s' hs' => h_nondeg s' (walkFromFuel_rem_subset L.length L u s' hs')
        have h_rem_len_le : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length ≤ m := by
          have hL_le : L.length ≤ m + 1 := hL
          omega
        have h_rem_lt_n : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length < m + 1 := by omega
        
        have h_ih_rem : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.map f ~
            ((decomposeListFuel m (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).flatMap
              Polygon.segments).map f :=
          ih m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2
            h_rem_len_le h_rem_nondeg h_rem_even
        
        show L.map f ~ ((decomposeListFuel (m+1) L).flatMap Polygon.segments).map f
        rw [hL_def]
        unfold decomposeListFuel
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append]
        
        
        have h_poly_segs : (Polygon.mk (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.dropLast).segments =
            walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'') := by
          rw [h_path_full]; exact h_walk_poly.symm
        calc L.map f
            ~ (walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 ++
               (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).map f := h_perm
          _ = (walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'')).map f ++
              (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.map f := by rw [h_path_full, List.map_append]
          _ = (Polygon.mk (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').dropLast).segments.map f ++
              (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.map f := by rw [h_walk_poly]
          _ ~ (Polygon.mk (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').dropLast).segments.map f ++
              ((decomposeListFuel m (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).flatMap
                Polygon.segments).map f := List.Perm.append_left _ h_ih_rem
          _ = (Polygon.mk (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.dropLast).segments.map f ++
              ((decomposeListFuel m (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).flatMap
                Polygon.segments).map f := by rw [h_path_full]

name: decomposeList_perm
statement:
theorem decomposeList_perm (G : EvenGraph) :
    G.segments.map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset ~
    ((decomposeList G.segments).flatMap Polygon.segments).map LineSegment.toEndpointsMultiset
proof:
:= by
  show G.segments.map f ~ _
  exact decomposeListFuel_perm G.segments.length G.segments
    (Nat.le_refl _) G.segments_nondegenerate G.even_degree

name: walkFromFuel_walkEdges_nondeg
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing L u with
  | zero =>
    rw [walkFromFuel_zero]
    simp [walkEdges_singleton]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [walkFromFuel_succ]
    split
    · simp [walkEdges_singleton]
    · next s hfind =>
      have h_mem : s ∈ L := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfind
      have h_s_inc : s.p1 = u ∨ s.p2 = u := by
        have := List.find?_some hfind
        simpa using this
      set next : Vector2D := if s.p1 = u then s.p2 else s.p1 with hnext_def
      set rec_res := walkFromFuel m (L.erase s) next with hrec
      have h_path_ne : rec_res.1 ≠ [] := walkFromFuel_ne_nil m (L.erase s) next
      obtain ⟨phead, ptail, hph⟩ :
          ∃ (ph : Vector2D) (pt : List Vector2D), rec_res.1 = ph :: pt := by
        rcases hpath : rec_res.1 with _ | ⟨ph, pt⟩
        · exact absurd hpath h_path_ne
        · exact ⟨ph, pt, rfl⟩
      have h_phead : phead = next := by
        have hh := walkFromFuel_head m (L.erase s) next
        rw [← hrec] at hh
        rw [hph] at hh
        simp at hh
        exact hh
      have h_u_ne_next : u ≠ next :=
        u_ne_next_of_nondeg s u (by simpa [isInc] using h_s_inc) (h_nondeg s h_mem)
      
      show ∀ seg ∈ walkEdges (u :: rec_res.1), seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2
      rw [hph, walkEdges_cons_cons]
      intro seg hseg
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hseg
      rcases hseg with rfl | h_seg_in
      · 
        show u ≠ phead
        rw [h_phead]; exact h_u_ne_next
      · 
        have h_eq : walkEdges (phead :: ptail) = walkEdges rec_res.1 := by rw [hph]
        rw [h_eq] at h_seg_in
        have h_nondeg' : ∀ s' ∈ L.erase s, s'.p1 ≠ s'.p2 := fun s' hs' =>
          h_nondeg s' (List.mem_of_mem_erase hs')
        exact ih (L.erase s) next h_nondeg' seg h_seg_in

name: decomposeListFuel_polys_valid
statement:
theorem decomposeListFuel_polys_valid :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : List LineSegment),
      L.length ≤ n →
      (∀ s ∈ L, s.p1 ≠ s.p2) →
      (∀ v, Even (incCount L v)) →
      ∀ poly ∈ decomposeListFuel n L,
        poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro L hL h_nondeg h_even
    cases L with
    | nil =>
      cases n with
      | zero => intro poly hp; simp [decomposeListFuel] at hp
      | succ m => intro poly hp; simp [decomposeListFuel] at hp
    | cons s₀ rest =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp at hL
      | succ m =>
        let L : List LineSegment := s₀ :: rest
        have hL_def : L = s₀ :: rest := rfl
        let u := s₀.p1
        have hs₀ : s₀ ∈ L := (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
        
        obtain ⟨s, vnext, rec_path, rec_rem, h_s_mem, _, _, h_vnext_ne_u, h_walk_eq, h_rec_eq⟩ :=
          walkFromFuel_takes_step L u s₀ hs₀ (Or.inl rfl) h_nondeg
        have h_path_eq : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 = u :: rec_path := by
          rw [h_walk_eq]
        have h_last : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.getLast? = some u :=
          walkFromFuel_closes_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        rw [h_path_eq] at h_last
        have h_rec_path_ne : rec_path ≠ [] := by
          have := walkFromFuel_ne_nil (L.length - 1) (L.erase s) vnext
          rw [h_rec_eq] at this
          exact this
        obtain ⟨vnext', rest', h_rec_eq2⟩ :
            ∃ n' r, rec_path = n' :: r := by
          rcases rec_path with _ | ⟨n', r⟩
          · exact absurd rfl h_rec_path_ne
          · exact ⟨n', r, rfl⟩
        have h_vnext'_eq : vnext' = vnext := by
          have := walkFromFuel_head (L.length - 1) (L.erase s) vnext
          rw [h_rec_eq, h_rec_eq2] at this
          simpa using this
        rw [h_vnext'_eq] at h_rec_eq2
        clear h_vnext'_eq vnext'
        have h_rest_ne : rest' ≠ [] := by
          intro h_rest_nil
          subst h_rest_nil
          have h_vnext_u : vnext = u := by
            rw [h_rec_eq2] at h_last
            simp [List.getLast?] at h_last
            exact h_last
          exact h_vnext_ne_u h_vnext_u
        obtain ⟨v₃, rest'', h_rest_eq⟩ :
            ∃ v₃ r'', rest' = v₃ :: r'' := by
          rcases rest' with _ | ⟨v₃, r''⟩
          · exact absurd rfl h_rest_ne
          · exact ⟨v₃, r'', rfl⟩
        subst h_rest_eq
        have h_path_full : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 = u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'' := by
          rw [h_path_eq, h_rec_eq2]
        have h_closed : (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').getLast? = some u := by
          rw [← h_path_full]; exact walkFromFuel_closes_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        have h_walk_poly : walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'') =
            (Polygon.mk (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').dropLast).segments :=
          walkEdges_eq_polygon_of_closed_ge3 u vnext v₃ rest'' h_closed
        
        have h_head_len : (Polygon.mk (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.dropLast).vertices.length ≥ 2 := by
          show (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.dropLast.length ≥ 2
          rw [h_path_full]
          
          
          show (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'').dropLast.length ≥ 2
          simp [List.dropLast]
        have h_head_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈
            (Polygon.mk (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1.dropLast).segments,
            seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := by
          intro seg hseg
          have h_seg_in : seg ∈ walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 := by
            rw [h_path_full] at hseg ⊢
            rw [h_walk_poly]
            exact hseg
          exact walkFromFuel_walkEdges_nondeg L.length L u h_nondeg seg h_seg_in
        
        have h_rem_nondeg : ∀ s' ∈ (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2, s'.p1 ≠ s'.p2 :=
          fun s' hs' => h_nondeg s' (walkFromFuel_rem_subset L.length L u s' hs')
        have h_rem_even : ∀ v, Even (incCount (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2 v) :=
          walkFromFuel_rem_even L u h_nondeg h_even
        have h_perm : L.map f ~ (walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1 ++
            (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2).map f :=
          walkFromFuel_perm _ _ _
        have h_len_eq : L.length =
            (walkEdges (walkFromFuel L.length L u).1).length +
            (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length := by
          have := h_perm.length_eq
          simp at this
          exact this
        have h_walkE_len : (walkEdges (u :: vnext :: v₃ :: rest'')).length ≥ 2 := by
          simp [walkEdges_cons_cons]
        have h_rem_short : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length < L.length := by
          rw [h_path_full] at h_len_eq
          omega
        have h_rem_len_le : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length ≤ m := by
          have hL_le : L.length ≤ m + 1 := hL
          omega
        have h_rem_lt_n : (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2.length < m + 1 := by omega
        have h_ih_rem :=
          ih m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) (walkFromFuel L.length L u).2
            h_rem_len_le h_rem_nondeg h_rem_even
        
        intro poly hp
        show poly.vertices.length ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2
        unfold decomposeListFuel at hp
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | h_in
        · exact ⟨h_head_len, h_head_nondeg⟩
        · exact h_ih_rem poly h_in

name: exists_polygons_inter_interior_eq_symmDiffAll_interiors_sdiff_boundaries
statement:
theorem exists_polygons_inter_interior_eq_symmDiffAll_interiors_sdiff_boundaries
    (poly1 poly2 : Polygon)
    (h1_len : poly1.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h2_len : poly2.vertices.length ≥ 2)
    (h1_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ poly1.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h2_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ poly2.segments, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h_fin : Set.Finite (poly1.toBoundarySet ∩ poly2.toBoundarySet)) :
    ∃ polys : List Polygon,
      poly1.interior ∩ poly2.interior =
        (polys.map Polygon.interior).symmDiffAll \
          { p : Vector2D | ∃ poly ∈ polys, p ∈ poly.toBoundarySet }
proof:
:=
  PolygonIntersectionProofs.exists_polygons_inter_interior_eq_symmDiffAll_interiors_sdiff_boundaries_impl
    poly1 poly2 h1_len h2_len h1_nondeg h2_nondeg h_fin

name: exists_polygon_separating_rays
statement:
theorem exists_polygon_separating_rays
    (rs : List Ray)
    (h_origin : ∀ r1 ∈ rs, ∀ r2 ∈ rs, sameOrigin r1 r2)
    (h_distinct : rs.Pairwise (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet)) :
    ∃ poly : Polygon,
      (∀ v ∈ poly.toVertices, ∀ r ∈ rs, v ∉ r.toSet) ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, ∀ r1 ∈ rs, ∀ r2 ∈ rs,
         rayIntersectsSegment r1 seg → rayIntersectsSegment r2 seg → r1 = r2) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, ∃ seg ∈ poly.segments, rayIntersectsSegment r seg) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ seg1 ∈ poly.segments, ∀ seg2 ∈ poly.segments,
         rayIntersectsSegment r seg1 → rayIntersectsSegment r seg2 → seg1 = seg2) ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ t : ℚ,
         ¬ (r.origin.x = (1-t)*seg.p1.x + t*seg.p2.x ∧
            r.origin.y = (1-t)*seg.p1.y + t*seg.p2.y)) ∧
      poly.segments.Nodup
proof:
:=
  GraphVertexNeighborhoodProofs.exists_polygon_separating_rays rs h_origin h_distinct

name: exists_vertex_neighborhood_avoiding_non_incident
statement:
theorem exists_vertex_neighborhood_avoiding_non_incident
    (G : Graph) (v : Vector2D)
    (hv : ∃ seg ∈ G.segments, seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v)
    (h_no_segment_interior_vertices : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments,
      seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ G.segments, seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v →
         ∀ p ∈ seg.toSet, r^2 ≤ (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2) ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ G.segments, ∀ w : Vector2D,
         (w = seg.p1 ∨ w = seg.p2) → w ≠ v →
         r^2 ≤ (w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2)
proof:
:=
  GraphVertexNeighborhoodProofs.exists_vertex_neighborhood_avoiding_non_incident
    G v hv h_no_segment_interior_vertices

name: tD_eq_tNum
statement:
private lemma tD_eq_tNum
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment) (t s : ℚ)
    (heq1 : t * r.direction.x + s * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x)
    (heq2 : t * r.direction.y + s * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) :
    t * raySegDet r seg = raySegTNum r seg
proof:
:= by
  show t * (r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) - r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x)) =
    (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) -
      (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x)
  linear_combination (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) * heq1 - (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) * heq2

name: sD_eq_sNum
statement:
private lemma sD_eq_sNum
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment) (t s : ℚ)
    (heq1 : t * r.direction.x + s * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x)
    (heq2 : t * r.direction.y + s * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) :
    s * raySegDet r seg = raySegSNum r seg
proof:
:= by
  show s * (r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) - r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x)) =
    r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) - r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x)
  linear_combination (-r.direction.y) * heq1 + r.direction.x * heq2

name: intersect_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma intersect_of_det_ne_zero
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment)
    (hD : raySegDet r seg ≠ 0)
    (htD : raySegTNum r seg * raySegDet r seg ≥ 0)
    (hsD0 : 0 ≤ raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg)
    (hsD1 : raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg ≤ raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r seg
proof:
:= by
  set D := raySegDet r seg with hDdef
  set tNum := raySegTNum r seg with htNumDef
  set sNum := raySegSNum r seg with hsNumDef
  set t : ℚ := tNum / D with htDef
  set s : ℚ := sNum / D with hsDef
  have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by
    rw [htDef]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hD with hDneg | hDpos
    · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos (by nlinarith [htD]) (le_of_lt hDneg)
    · exact div_nonneg (by nlinarith [htD]) (le_of_lt hDpos)
  have hs_nn : 0 ≤ s := by
    rw [hsDef]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hD with hDneg | hDpos
    · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos (by nlinarith [hsD0]) (le_of_lt hDneg)
    · exact div_nonneg (by nlinarith [hsD0]) (le_of_lt hDpos)
  have hs_le_one : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hsDef]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hD with hDneg | hDpos
    · rw [div_le_one_of_neg hDneg]; nlinarith [hsD1]
    · rw [div_le_one hDpos]; nlinarith [hsD1]
  have htD_eq : t * D = tNum := by
    rw [htDef]; field_simp
  have hsD_eq : s * D = sNum := by
    rw [hsDef]; field_simp
  
  have hkey_x : D * ((1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x) =
                D * (r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x) := by
    have h1 : t * D = tNum := htD_eq
    have h2 : s * D = sNum := hsD_eq
    have hDexp : D = r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) -
                     r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) := hDdef
    have htN : tNum = (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) -
                      (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) := htNumDef
    have hsN : sNum = r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) -
                      r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) := hsNumDef
    rw [htN] at h1
    rw [hsN] at h2
    rw [hDexp] at h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-r.direction.x) * h1 + (-(seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x)) * h2
  have hkey_y : D * ((1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y) =
                D * (r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y) := by
    have h1 : t * D = tNum := htD_eq
    have h2 : s * D = sNum := hsD_eq
    have hDexp : D = r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) -
                     r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) := hDdef
    have htN : tNum = (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) -
                      (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) := htNumDef
    have hsN : sNum = r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) -
                      r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) := hsNumDef
    rw [htN] at h1
    rw [hsN] at h2
    rw [hDexp] at h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-r.direction.y) * h1 + (-(seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y)) * h2
  have heq_x : (1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x = r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hD hkey_x
  have heq_y : (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y = r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hD hkey_y
  refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y⟩,
          ⟨t, ht_nn, rfl, rfl⟩,
          ⟨s, hs_nn, hs_le_one, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact heq_x.symm
  · exact heq_y.symm

name: cond_of_intersect_det_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma cond_of_intersect_det_ne_zero
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment)
    (_hD : raySegDet r seg ≠ 0)
    (h : rayIntersectsSegment r seg) :
    raySegTNum r seg * raySegDet r seg ≥ 0 ∧
    0 ≤ raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg ∧
    raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg ≤ raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨t, ht_nn, hqx_eq, hqy_eq⟩ := hq_ray
  obtain ⟨s, hs_nn, hs_le_one, hqx_seg, hqy_seg⟩ := hq_seg
  have heq1 : t * r.direction.x + s * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x := by
    have hh : r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x = (1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x := by
      rw [← hqx_eq, hqx_seg]
    linarith [hh]
  have heq2 : t * r.direction.y + s * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y := by
    have hh : r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y = (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y := by
      rw [← hqy_eq, hqy_seg]
    linarith [hh]
  have htD_eq : t * raySegDet r seg = raySegTNum r seg := tD_eq_tNum r seg t s heq1 heq2
  have hsD_eq : s * raySegDet r seg = raySegSNum r seg := sD_eq_sNum r seg t s heq1 heq2
  have hD2_nn : 0 ≤ raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg := mul_self_nonneg _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrw : raySegTNum r seg * raySegDet r seg =
                t * (raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) := by
      rw [← htD_eq]; ring
    rw [hrw]
    exact mul_nonneg ht_nn hD2_nn
  · have hrw : raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg =
                s * (raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) := by
      rw [← hsD_eq]; ring
    rw [hrw]
    exact mul_nonneg hs_nn hD2_nn
  · have hrw : raySegSNum r seg * raySegDet r seg =
                s * (raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) := by
      rw [← hsD_eq]; ring
    rw [hrw]
    have hh : s * (raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) ≤
              1 * (raySegDet r seg * raySegDet r seg) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_le_one hD2_nn
    linarith [hh]

name: intersect_of_det_zero
statement:
private lemma intersect_of_det_zero
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment)
    (hD : raySegDet r seg = 0)
    (_htN : raySegTNum r seg = 0)
    (hsN : raySegSNum r seg = 0)
    (h_overlap : collinearRaySegOverlap r seg = true) :
    rayIntersectsSegment r seg
proof:
:= by
  unfold collinearRaySegOverlap at h_overlap
  by_cases hdx : r.direction.x ≠ 0
  · rw [if_pos hdx] at h_overlap
    set t1 : ℚ := (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x with ht1_def
    set t2 : ℚ := (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x with ht2_def
    have ht_max_nn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ max t1 t2 := of_decide_eq_true h_overlap
    have h_t1_x : t1 * r.direction.x = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x := by
      rw [ht1_def]; field_simp
    have h_t2_x : t2 * r.direction.x = seg.p2.x - r.origin.x := by
      rw [ht2_def]; field_simp
    clear_value t1 t2
    have hp1_x : seg.p1.x = r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x := by linarith [h_t1_x]
    have hp2_x : seg.p2.x = r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x := by linarith [h_t2_x]
    have hsN' : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) =
                r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) := by
      have hh : raySegSNum r seg = 0 := hsN
      unfold raySegSNum at hh
      linarith [hh]
    have hp1_y : seg.p1.y = r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y := by
      have hkey : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) =
                  r.direction.x * (t1 * r.direction.y) := by
        have hexp : r.direction.x * (t1 * r.direction.y) =
                    r.direction.y * (t1 * r.direction.x) := by ring
        rw [hexp, h_t1_x, hsN']
      have h_eq := mul_left_cancel₀ hdx hkey
      linarith [h_eq]
    have hD' : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) =
               r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) := by
      have hh : raySegDet r seg = 0 := hD
      unfold raySegDet at hh
      linarith [hh]
    have h_p1x_minus_p2x : seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x = (t1 - t2) * r.direction.x := by
      have hexp : (t1 - t2) * r.direction.x = t1 * r.direction.x - t2 * r.direction.x := by ring
      rw [hexp, h_t1_x, h_t2_x]; ring
    have h_p1y_minus_p2y : seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y = (t1 - t2) * r.direction.y := by
      have hkey : r.direction.x * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) =
                  r.direction.x * ((t1 - t2) * r.direction.y) := by
        have hexp : r.direction.x * ((t1 - t2) * r.direction.y) =
                    r.direction.y * ((t1 - t2) * r.direction.x) := by ring
        rw [hexp, ← h_p1x_minus_p2x, hD']
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hdx hkey
    have hp2_y : seg.p2.y = r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y := by
      have hexp : seg.p2.y = seg.p1.y - (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) := by ring
      rw [hexp, h_p1y_minus_p2y, hp1_y]; ring
    rcases lt_or_ge t2 t1 with h12 | h12
    · 
      have hmax : max t1 t2 = t1 := max_eq_left (le_of_lt h12)
      rw [hmax] at ht_max_nn
      refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y⟩,
              ⟨t1, ht_max_nn, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨0, le_refl _, zero_le_one, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · show r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x = (1 - 0) * seg.p1.x + 0 * seg.p2.x
        rw [hp1_x]; ring
      · show r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y = (1 - 0) * seg.p1.y + 0 * seg.p2.y
        rw [hp1_y]; ring
    · 
      have hmax : max t1 t2 = t2 := max_eq_right h12
      rw [hmax] at ht_max_nn
      refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y⟩,
              ⟨t2, ht_max_nn, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨1, zero_le_one, le_refl _, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · show r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x = (1 - 1) * seg.p1.x + 1 * seg.p2.x
        rw [hp2_x]; ring
      · show r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y = (1 - 1) * seg.p1.y + 1 * seg.p2.y
        rw [hp2_y]; ring
  · push_neg at hdx
    have hcond : ¬ (r.direction.x ≠ 0) := fun h => h hdx
    rw [if_neg hcond] at h_overlap
    have hdy : r.direction.y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hdy
      apply r.direction_nonzero
      ext
      · exact hdx
      · exact hdy
    set t1 : ℚ := (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y with ht1_def
    set t2 : ℚ := (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y with ht2_def
    have ht_max_nn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ max t1 t2 := of_decide_eq_true h_overlap
    have h_t1_y : t1 * r.direction.y = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y := by
      rw [ht1_def]; field_simp
    have h_t2_y : t2 * r.direction.y = seg.p2.y - r.origin.y := by
      rw [ht2_def]; field_simp
    clear_value t1 t2
    have hp1_y : seg.p1.y = r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y := by linarith [h_t1_y]
    have hp2_y : seg.p2.y = r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y := by linarith [h_t2_y]
    have hp1_x : seg.p1.x = r.origin.x := by
      have hsN' : raySegSNum r seg = 0 := hsN
      unfold raySegSNum at hsN'
      rw [hdx] at hsN'
      have hh : r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) = 0 := by linarith [hsN']
      have h_diff : seg.p1.x - r.origin.x = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hh with h | h
        · exact absurd h hdy
        · exact h
      linarith [h_diff]
    have hp2_x : seg.p2.x = r.origin.x := by
      have hD' : raySegDet r seg = 0 := hD
      unfold raySegDet at hD'
      rw [hdx] at hD'
      have hh : r.direction.y * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) = 0 := by linarith [hD']
      have h_diff : seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hh with h | h
        · exact absurd h hdy
        · exact h
      linarith [hp1_x, h_diff]
    rcases lt_or_ge t2 t1 with h12 | h12
    · 
      have hmax : max t1 t2 = t1 := max_eq_left (le_of_lt h12)
      rw [hmax] at ht_max_nn
      refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y⟩,
              ⟨t1, ht_max_nn, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨0, le_refl _, zero_le_one, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · show r.origin.x + t1 * r.direction.x = (1 - 0) * seg.p1.x + 0 * seg.p2.x
        rw [hp1_x, hdx]; ring
      · show r.origin.y + t1 * r.direction.y = (1 - 0) * seg.p1.y + 0 * seg.p2.y
        rw [hp1_y]; ring
    · 
      have hmax : max t1 t2 = t2 := max_eq_right h12
      rw [hmax] at ht_max_nn
      refine ⟨⟨r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x, r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y⟩,
              ⟨t2, ht_max_nn, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨1, zero_le_one, le_refl _, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · show r.origin.x + t2 * r.direction.x = (1 - 1) * seg.p1.x + 1 * seg.p2.x
        rw [hp2_x, hdx]; ring
      · show r.origin.y + t2 * r.direction.y = (1 - 1) * seg.p1.y + 1 * seg.p2.y
        rw [hp2_y]; ring

name: cond_of_intersect_det_zero
statement:
private lemma cond_of_intersect_det_zero
    (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment)
    (hD : raySegDet r seg = 0)
    (h : rayIntersectsSegment r seg) :
    raySegTNum r seg = 0 ∧ raySegSNum r seg = 0 ∧
    collinearRaySegOverlap r seg = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_seg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨t, ht_nn, hqx_eq, hqy_eq⟩ := hq_ray
  obtain ⟨s, hs_nn, hs_le_one, hqx_seg, hqy_seg⟩ := hq_seg
  have heq1 : t * r.direction.x + s * (seg.p1.x - seg.p2.x) = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x := by
    have hh : r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x = (1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x := by
      rw [← hqx_eq, hqx_seg]
    linarith [hh]
  have heq2 : t * r.direction.y + s * (seg.p1.y - seg.p2.y) = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y := by
    have hh : r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y = (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y := by
      rw [← hqy_eq, hqy_seg]
    linarith [hh]
  have htD_eq : t * raySegDet r seg = raySegTNum r seg := tD_eq_tNum r seg t s heq1 heq2
  have hsD_eq : s * raySegDet r seg = raySegSNum r seg := sD_eq_sNum r seg t s heq1 heq2
  have htN : raySegTNum r seg = 0 := by
    rw [← htD_eq, hD, mul_zero]
  have hsN : raySegSNum r seg = 0 := by
    rw [← hsD_eq, hD, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨htN, hsN, ?_⟩
  show collinearRaySegOverlap r seg = true
  unfold collinearRaySegOverlap
  by_cases hdx : r.direction.x ≠ 0
  · rw [if_pos hdx]
    
    let t1' : ℚ := (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x
    let t2' : ℚ := (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x
    show decide (max t1' t2' ≥ 0) = true
    have ht1_eq : t1' * r.direction.x = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x := by
      show (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x * r.direction.x = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x
      field_simp
    have ht2_eq : t2' * r.direction.x = seg.p2.x - r.origin.x := by
      show (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) / r.direction.x * r.direction.x = seg.p2.x - r.origin.x
      field_simp
    have h_combine : r.origin.x + t * r.direction.x =
                     (1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x := by
      rw [← hqx_eq, hqx_seg]
    
    suffices h : ∀ (t1 t2 : ℚ),
        t1 * r.direction.x = seg.p1.x - r.origin.x →
        t2 * r.direction.x = seg.p2.x - r.origin.x →
        decide (max t1 t2 ≥ 0) = true by
      exact h t1' t2' ht1_eq ht2_eq
    intro t1 t2 h1 h2
    have h_mul : t * r.direction.x = ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2) * r.direction.x :=
      calc t * r.direction.x
          = ((1 - s) * seg.p1.x + s * seg.p2.x) - r.origin.x := by linarith [h_combine]
        _ = (1 - s) * (seg.p1.x - r.origin.x) + s * (seg.p2.x - r.origin.x) := by ring
        _ = (1 - s) * (t1 * r.direction.x) + s * (t2 * r.direction.x) := by rw [h1, h2]
        _ = ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2) * r.direction.x := by ring
    have ht_eq : t = (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 := mul_right_cancel₀ hdx h_mul
    have h_le : (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 ≤ max t1 t2 := by
      have h1s : 0 ≤ 1 - s := by linarith
      have ha : (1 - s) * t1 ≤ (1 - s) * max t1 t2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) h1s
      have hb : s * t2 ≤ s * max t1 t2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hs_nn
      nlinarith [ha, hb]
    have hmax_nn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ max t1 t2 := by linarith [ht_eq, h_le, ht_nn]
    exact decide_eq_true hmax_nn
  · push_neg at hdx
    have hcond : ¬ (r.direction.x ≠ 0) := fun h => h hdx
    rw [if_neg hcond]
    show decide (max ((seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y)
                 ((seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y) ≥ 0) = true
    have hdy : r.direction.y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hdy
      apply r.direction_nonzero
      ext
      · exact hdx
      · exact hdy
    let t1' : ℚ := (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y
    let t2' : ℚ := (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y
    show decide (max t1' t2' ≥ 0) = true
    have ht1_eq : t1' * r.direction.y = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y := by
      show (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y * r.direction.y = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y
      field_simp
    have ht2_eq : t2' * r.direction.y = seg.p2.y - r.origin.y := by
      show (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) / r.direction.y * r.direction.y = seg.p2.y - r.origin.y
      field_simp
    have h_combine : r.origin.y + t * r.direction.y =
                     (1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y := by
      rw [← hqy_eq, hqy_seg]
    suffices h : ∀ (t1 t2 : ℚ),
        t1 * r.direction.y = seg.p1.y - r.origin.y →
        t2 * r.direction.y = seg.p2.y - r.origin.y →
        decide (max t1 t2 ≥ 0) = true by
      exact h t1' t2' ht1_eq ht2_eq
    intro t1 t2 h1 h2
    have h_mul : t * r.direction.y = ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2) * r.direction.y :=
      calc t * r.direction.y
          = ((1 - s) * seg.p1.y + s * seg.p2.y) - r.origin.y := by linarith [h_combine]
        _ = (1 - s) * (seg.p1.y - r.origin.y) + s * (seg.p2.y - r.origin.y) := by ring
        _ = (1 - s) * (t1 * r.direction.y) + s * (t2 * r.direction.y) := by rw [h1, h2]
        _ = ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2) * r.direction.y := by ring
    have ht_eq : t = (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 := mul_right_cancel₀ hdy h_mul
    have h_le : (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 ≤ max t1 t2 := by
      have h1s : 0 ≤ 1 - s := by linarith
      have ha : (1 - s) * t1 ≤ (1 - s) * max t1 t2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) h1s
      have hb : s * t2 ≤ s * max t1 t2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hs_nn
      nlinarith [ha, hb]
    have hmax_nn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ max t1 t2 := by linarith [ht_eq, h_le, ht_nn]
    exact decide_eq_true hmax_nn

name: rayIntersectsSegmentBool_iff
statement:
theorem rayIntersectsSegmentBool_iff (r : Ray) (seg : LineSegment) :
    rayIntersectsSegmentBool r seg = true ↔ rayIntersectsSegment r seg
proof:
:= by
  unfold rayIntersectsSegmentBool
  by_cases hD : raySegDet r seg = 0
  · simp [hD]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h_col, h_overlap⟩
      unfold collinearRaySeg at h_col
      simp at h_col
      obtain ⟨htN, hsN⟩ := h_col
      exact intersect_of_det_zero r seg hD htN hsN h_overlap
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨htN, hsN, h_overlap⟩ := cond_of_intersect_det_zero r seg hD h
      refine ⟨?_, h_overlap⟩
      unfold collinearRaySeg
      simp [htN, hsN]
  · simp [hD]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨htD, hsD0, hsD1⟩
      exact intersect_of_det_ne_zero r seg hD htD hsD0 hsD1
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨htD, hsD0, hsD1⟩ := cond_of_intersect_det_ne_zero r seg hD h
      exact ⟨htD, hsD0, hsD1⟩

name: exists_ray_avoiding_vertices
proof:
:= by
  have : Infinite ℚ := Infinite.of_injective (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℚ)) Nat.cast_injective
  let badSlopes : Finset ℚ := (poly.vertices.filterMap fun v =>
    if v.x > p.x then some ((v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x)) else none).toFinset
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finset.exists_not_mem badSlopes
  have h_nonzero : (⟨1, q⟩ : Vector2D) ≠ ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
    intro h; exact absurd (congrArg Vector2D.x h) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨⟨p, ⟨1, q⟩, h_nonzero⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [rayAvoidsVertices, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  intro v hv
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hv
  obtain ⟨hv_ray, hv_vert⟩ := hv
  simp only [Ray.toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv_ray
  simp only [Polygon.toVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv_vert
  obtain ⟨t, ht_nonneg, hvx, hvy⟩ := hv_ray
  simp only [mul_one] at hvx
  have hne : v ≠ p := h_not_vertex v hv_vert
  have ht_eq : t = v.x - p.x := by linarith
  by_cases h_gt : v.x > p.x
  · have h_slope_mem : (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) ∈ badSlopes := by
      simp only [badSlopes, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
      exact ⟨v, hv_vert, by simp [if_pos h_gt]⟩
    have hvmy : v.y - p.y = t * q := by linarith
    rw [ht_eq] at hvmy
    have hvx_ne : v.x - p.x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith : v.x - p.x > 0)
    have hq_eq : q = (v.y - p.y) / (v.x - p.x) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hvx_ne, mul_comm]; linarith
    exact hq (hq_eq ▸ h_slope_mem)
  · push_neg at h_gt
    by_cases h_eq : v.x = p.x
    · have ht_zero : t = 0 := by linarith
      have hvy_eq : v.y = p.y := by
        have := hvy; rw [ht_zero] at this; simp at this; exact this
      exact hne (by cases v; cases p; simp_all)
    · linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne h_gt h_eq]

name: exists_zip_pair'
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 generalizing l2 with
  | nil => simp at hv
  | cons x xs ih =>
    match l2 with
    | [] => simp at hlen
    | y :: ys =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
      · exact ⟨y, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
      · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ih (l2 := ys) hv' (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen; omega)
        exact ⟨w, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw⟩

name: vertex_on_some_segment'
proof:
:= by
  cases h_eq : poly.vertices with
  | nil => simp [h_eq] at hv
  | cons a tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil => simp [h_eq] at h_len
    | cons b rest =>
      rw [h_eq] at hv
      have hlen : (a :: b :: rest).length ≤ ((b :: rest) ++ [a]).length := by
        simp [List.length_cons, List.length_append]
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_zip_pair' hv hlen
      refine ⟨⟨v, w⟩, ?_, ⟨0, le_refl _, le_of_lt one_pos, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
      have h_poly : poly = ⟨a :: b :: rest⟩ := by cases poly; simp_all
      rw [h_poly]
      show (⟨v, w⟩ : LineSegment) ∈ (Polygon.mk (a :: b :: rest)).segments
      simp only [Polygon.segments, List.mem_map, Prod.exists]
      exact ⟨v, w, hw, rfl⟩

name: interior_forall_eq_exists
statement:
theorem interior_forall_eq_exists (poly : Polygon)
    (h_len : poly.vertices.length ≥ 2) :
    { p : Vector2D |
        (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ∧
        ∀ r : Ray, r.origin = p → rayAvoidsVertices r poly →
          intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly % 2 = 1 } =
    { p : Vector2D |
        (∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pointAvoidsSegment p seg) ∧
        ∃ r : Ray, r.origin = p ∧ rayAvoidsVertices r poly ∧
          intersectionRayPolygonSegmentsNumber r poly % 2 = 1 }
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · 
    intro ⟨h_avoids_segs, h_forall⟩
    have h_not_vertex : ∀ v ∈ poly.vertices, v ≠ p := by
      intro v hv h_eq; subst h_eq
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hp_on⟩ := vertex_on_some_segment' poly v hv h_len
      exact h_avoids_segs seg hseg hp_on
    obtain ⟨r, h_origin, h_avoids_verts⟩ := exists_ray_avoiding_vertices p poly h_not_vertex
    exact ⟨h_avoids_segs, r, h_origin, h_avoids_verts, h_forall r h_origin h_avoids_verts⟩
  · 
    intro ⟨h_avoids_segs, r₀, h_origin₀, h_avoids₀, h_parity₀⟩
    refine ⟨h_avoids_segs, fun r h_origin h_avoids => ?_⟩
    have h_same : sameOrigin r₀ r := by
      simp [sameOrigin, h_origin₀, h_origin]
    have h_seg_avoids : ∀ seg ∈ poly.segments, pointAvoidsSegment r₀.origin seg := by
      rwa [h_origin₀]
    have h_eq := intersectionParity_eq_of_sameOrigin_avoidsVertices r₀ r poly
      h_same h_avoids₀ h_avoids h_seg_avoids
    omega

name: segment_dist_sq_le_max
statement:
private theorem segment_dist_sq_le_max (v a b p : Vector2D) (M : ℚ)
    (hMa : (a.x - v.x)^2 + (a.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M)
    (hMb : (b.x - v.x)^2 + (b.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M)
    (hp : p ∈ (LineSegment.mk a b).toSet) :
    (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hpx, hpy⟩ := hp
  set ax := a.x - v.x with hax_def
  set ay := a.y - v.y with hay_def
  set bx := b.x - v.x with hbx_def
  set by_ := b.y - v.y with hby_def
  have h_p_minus_v_sq :
      (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 =
        (1-t)^2 * (ax^2 + ay^2) + 2 * (1-t) * t * (ax*bx + ay*by_) + t^2 * (bx^2 + by_^2) := by
    rw [hpx, hpy]
    simp only [hax_def, hay_def, hbx_def, hby_def] at *
    show ((1 - t) * a.x + t * b.x - v.x)^2 + ((1 - t) * a.y + t * b.y - v.y)^2 = _
    ring
  rw [h_p_minus_v_sq]
  have h_CS : 2 * (ax*bx + ay*by_) ≤ (ax^2 + ay^2) + (bx^2 + by_^2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ax - bx), sq_nonneg (ay - by_)]
  have h_1mt_nn : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
  have h_t_nn : 0 ≤ t := ht0
  have h_1mt_t : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * t := mul_nonneg h_1mt_nn h_t_nn
  have h_step1 : (1-t)^2 * (ax^2 + ay^2) + 2 * (1-t) * t * (ax*bx + ay*by_) + t^2 * (bx^2 + by_^2) ≤
      (1-t)^2 * (ax^2 + ay^2) + (1-t) * t * ((ax^2 + ay^2) + (bx^2 + by_^2)) + t^2 * (bx^2 + by_^2) := by
    have h2 : 2 * (1-t) * t * (ax*bx + ay*by_) = (1-t) * t * (2 * (ax*bx + ay*by_)) := by ring
    have h_mul : (1-t) * t * (2 * (ax*bx + ay*by_)) ≤ (1-t) * t * ((ax^2 + ay^2) + (bx^2 + by_^2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_CS h_1mt_t
    linarith
  have h_simplify : (1-t)^2 * (ax^2 + ay^2) + (1-t) * t * ((ax^2 + ay^2) + (bx^2 + by_^2)) + t^2 * (bx^2 + by_^2) =
      (1-t) * (ax^2 + ay^2) + t * (bx^2 + by_^2) := by ring
  rw [h_simplify] at h_step1
  have h_step2 : (1 - t) * (ax^2 + ay^2) + t * (bx^2 + by_^2) ≤ M := by
    have hh : (1 - t) * (ax^2 + ay^2) + t * (bx^2 + by_^2) ≤ (1 - t) * M + t * M := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMa h_1mt_nn
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMb h_t_nn
    have : (1 - t) * M + t * M = M := by ring
    linarith
  linarith

name: listMaxSqDist_ge_zero
statement:
private lemma listMaxSqDist_ge_zero (v : Vector2D) (l : List Vector2D) :
    0 ≤ listMaxSqDist v l
proof:
:= by
  unfold listMaxSqDist
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldr_cons]
    exact le_max_of_le_right ih

name: listMaxSqDist_ge
statement:
private lemma listMaxSqDist_ge (v : Vector2D) (l : List Vector2D) (p : Vector2D) (hp : p ∈ l) :
    (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 ≤ listMaxSqDist v l
proof:
:= by
  unfold listMaxSqDist
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp_rest
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (ih hp_rest)

name: mem_badShrinkFinset_of_line_through
statement:
private theorem mem_badShrinkFinset_of_line_through
    (P0 : Polygon) (verts : List Vector2D) (v : Vector2D)
    (h_v_off_lines : ∀ ps0 ∈ P0.segments, ∀ t : ℚ,
      ¬ (v.x = (1-t)*ps0.p1.x + t*ps0.p2.x ∧ v.y = (1-t)*ps0.p1.y + t*ps0.p2.y))
    {s : ℚ} {ps0 : LineSegment} {w : Vector2D} {t : ℚ}
    (h_nondeg : ps0.p1 ≠ ps0.p2)
    (hps0 : ps0 ∈ P0.segments) (hw : w ∈ verts)
    (hwx : w.x = (1-t)*(shrinkPoint v s ps0.p1).x + t*(shrinkPoint v s ps0.p2).x)
    (hwy : w.y = (1-t)*(shrinkPoint v s ps0.p1).y + t*(shrinkPoint v s ps0.p2).y) :
    s ∈ badShrinkFinset P0 verts v
proof:
:= by
  unfold badShrinkFinset
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · rw [hs0]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  · 
    apply Finset.mem_insert.mpr
    right
    rw [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
    refine ⟨(ps0, w), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact List.mem_product.mpr ⟨hps0, hw⟩
    · 
      unfold candidateBadS
      simp only
      set q1x := ps0.p1.x - v.x with hq1x
      set q1y := ps0.p1.y - v.y with hq1y
      set q2x := ps0.p2.x - v.x with hq2x
      set q2y := ps0.p2.y - v.y with hq2y
      set wx := w.x - v.x with hwx_def
      set wy := w.y - v.y with hwy_def
      set denom := q1x * q2y - q1y * q2x with hdenom_def
      
      have h_eq1 : wx = s * (q1x + t * (q2x - q1x)) := by
        simp only [shrinkPoint] at hwx
        simp only [hwx_def, hq1x, hq2x]
        linarith
      have h_eq2 : wy = s * (q1y + t * (q2y - q1y)) := by
        simp only [shrinkPoint] at hwy
        simp only [hwy_def, hq1y, hq2y]
        linarith
      
      
      have h_denom_ne : denom ≠ 0 := by
        intro h_denom_zero
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        by_cases hq1_zero : q1x = 0 ∧ q1y = 0
        · 
          obtain ⟨hq1xz, hq1yz⟩ := hq1_zero
          apply h_v_off_lines ps0 hps0 0
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · show v.x = (1 - 0) * ps0.p1.x + 0 * ps0.p2.x
            have : ps0.p1.x = v.x := by linarith [hq1xz]
            rw [this]; ring
          · show v.y = (1 - 0) * ps0.p1.y + 0 * ps0.p2.y
            have : ps0.p1.y = v.y := by linarith [hq1yz]
            rw [this]; ring
        · push_neg at hq1_zero
          by_cases hq2_zero : q2x = 0 ∧ q2y = 0
          · 
            obtain ⟨hq2xz, hq2yz⟩ := hq2_zero
            apply h_v_off_lines ps0 hps0 1
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · show v.x = (1 - 1) * ps0.p1.x + 1 * ps0.p2.x
              have : ps0.p2.x = v.x := by linarith [hq2xz]
              rw [this]; ring
            · show v.y = (1 - 1) * ps0.p1.y + 1 * ps0.p2.y
              have : ps0.p2.y = v.y := by linarith [hq2yz]
              rw [this]; ring
          · push_neg at hq2_zero
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            by_cases hq1q2x : q1x = q2x
            · 
              
              by_cases hq1xz : q1x = 0
              · 
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                by_cases hq1q2y : q1y = q2y
                · 
                  exfalso
                  apply h_nondeg
                  ext
                  · have : q1x = q2x := hq1q2x
                    simp only [hq1x, hq2x] at this
                    linarith
                  · have : q1y = q2y := hq1q2y
                    simp only [hq1y, hq2y] at this
                    linarith
                · 
                  set t' : ℚ := q1y / (q1y - q2y)
                  have hd_ne : q1y - q2y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hq1q2y
                  apply h_v_off_lines ps0 hps0 t'
                  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
                  · show v.x = (1 - t') * ps0.p1.x + t' * ps0.p2.x
                    have ha : (1-t')*ps0.p1.x + t'*ps0.p2.x =
                        v.x + ((1-t')*q1x + t'*q2x) := by
                      simp only [hq1x, hq2x]; ring
                    rw [ha]
                    
                    have : (1-t')*q1x + t'*q2x = 0 := by
                      rw [hq1xz, ← hq1q2x, hq1xz]; ring
                    linarith
                  · show v.y = (1 - t') * ps0.p1.y + t' * ps0.p2.y
                    have ha : (1-t')*ps0.p1.y + t'*ps0.p2.y =
                        v.y + ((1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y) := by
                      simp only [hq1y, hq2y]; ring
                    rw [ha]
                    have : (1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y = 0 := by
                      have h_t' : t' * (q1y - q2y) = q1y := by
                        rw [show t' = q1y / (q1y - q2y) from rfl]
                        field_simp
                      linarith
                    linarith
              · 
                
                exfalso
                
                
                have hq1q2y : q1y = q2y := by
                  have h_denom : q1x*q2y - q1y*q2x = 0 := h_denom_zero
                  have h2 : q1x*q2y - q1y*q1x = 0 := by rw [← hq1q2x] at h_denom; exact h_denom
                  have : q1x * (q2y - q1y) = 0 := by linarith
                  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with hh | hh
                  · exact absurd hh hq1xz
                  · linarith
                
                apply h_nondeg
                ext
                · have : q1x = q2x := hq1q2x
                  simp only [hq1x, hq2x] at this
                  linarith
                · have : q1y = q2y := hq1q2y
                  simp only [hq1y, hq2y] at this
                  linarith
            · 
              set t' : ℚ := q1x / (q1x - q2x)
              have hd_ne : q1x - q2x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hq1q2x
              apply h_v_off_lines ps0 hps0 t'
              refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
              · show v.x = (1 - t') * ps0.p1.x + t' * ps0.p2.x
                have ha : (1-t')*ps0.p1.x + t'*ps0.p2.x =
                    v.x + ((1-t')*q1x + t'*q2x) := by
                  simp only [hq1x, hq2x]; ring
                rw [ha]
                have : (1-t')*q1x + t'*q2x = 0 := by
                  have h_t' : t' * (q1x - q2x) = q1x := by
                    rw [show t' = q1x / (q1x - q2x) from rfl]
                    field_simp
                  linarith
                linarith
              · show v.y = (1 - t') * ps0.p1.y + t' * ps0.p2.y
                have ha : (1-t')*ps0.p1.y + t'*ps0.p2.y =
                    v.y + ((1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y) := by
                  simp only [hq1y, hq2y]; ring
                rw [ha]
                have : (1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y = 0 := by
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  have h_t' : t' * (q1x - q2x) = q1x := by
                    rw [show t' = q1x / (q1x - q2x) from rfl]
                    field_simp
                  
                  have hgoal : (q1x - q2x) * ((1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y) = 0 := by
                    have h1 : (q1x - q2x) * ((1-t')*q1y + t'*q2y) =
                        (q1x - q2x)*q1y + (t'*(q1x - q2x))*(q2y - q1y) := by ring
                    rw [h1, h_t']
                    have : (q1x - q2x)*q1y + q1x*(q2y - q1y) = q1x*q2y - q1y*q2x := by ring
                    rw [this]
                    exact h_denom_zero
                  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hgoal with hh | hh
                  · exact absurd hh hd_ne
                  · exact hh
                linarith
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      have h_eq3 : wx*(q2y - q1y) - wy*(q2x - q1x) = s*denom := by
        have e1 : wx*(q2y - q1y) = s*(q1x + t*(q2x - q1x))*(q2y - q1y) := by rw [h_eq1]
        have e2 : wy*(q2x - q1x) = s*(q1y + t*(q2y - q1y))*(q2x - q1x) := by rw [h_eq2]
        rw [e1, e2]
        simp only [hdenom_def]
        ring
      
      have h_target : (wx*(q2y - q1y) - wy*(q2x - q1x))/denom = s := by
        rw [h_eq3]
        field_simp
      
      
      rw [if_neg h_denom_ne]
      exact h_target

name: polygonShrink_vertex_dist_sq_le
statement:
private theorem polygonShrink_vertex_dist_sq_le (P0 : Polygon) (v : Vector2D)
    (s : ℚ) (M R : ℚ)
    (hM_bound : ∀ p ∈ P0.vertices, (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M)
    (h_sM_le_R : s^2 * M ≤ R) (_hM_nn : 0 ≤ M) (hs_sq_nn : 0 ≤ s^2) :
    ∀ q ∈ (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices,
      (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  rw [polygonShrink_vertices, List.mem_map] at hq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hq_eq⟩ := hq
  rw [← hq_eq]
  rw [shrinkPoint_dist_sq_eq]
  have hp_dist : (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M := hM_bound p hp
  have h_pos : 0 ≤ (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 := by positivity
  
  have : s^2 * ((p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2) ≤ s^2 * M :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_dist hs_sq_nn
  linarith

name: polygonShrink_segment_dist_sq_le
statement:
private theorem polygonShrink_segment_dist_sq_le
    (P0 : Polygon) (v : Vector2D) (s : ℚ) (R : ℚ)
    (h_vert_bound : ∀ q ∈ (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices,
      (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 ≤ R)
    (ps : LineSegment) (hps : ps ∈ (polygonShrink P0 v s).segments)
    (q : Vector2D) (hq : q ∈ ps.toSet) :
    (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_p1_vert : ps.p1 ∈ (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices := by
    have h_p1_list := polygon_segments_p1_list (polygonShrink P0 v s)
    
    by_cases h_len : (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices.length ≥ 2
    · have := polygon_segments_p1_list (polygonShrink P0 v s) h_len
      have : ps.p1 ∈ ((polygonShrink P0 v s).segments.map (fun ps' => ps'.p1)) :=
        List.mem_map_of_mem _ hps
      rw [polygon_segments_p1_list (polygonShrink P0 v s) h_len] at this
      exact this
    · push_neg at h_len
      
      have h_segs_nil : (polygonShrink P0 v s).segments = [] := by
        unfold Polygon.segments
        cases hverts : (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons v1 vs =>
          cases hvs : vs with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons w ws =>
            exfalso
            rw [hverts, hvs] at h_len
            simp at h_len
            omega
      rw [h_segs_nil] at hps
      simp at hps
  have h_p2_vert : ps.p2 ∈ (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices := by
    by_cases h_len : (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices.length ≥ 2
    · have h_perm := polygon_segments_p2_list (polygonShrink P0 v s) h_len
      have h_in : ps.p2 ∈ ((polygonShrink P0 v s).segments.map (fun ps' => ps'.p2)) :=
        List.mem_map_of_mem _ hps
      exact h_perm.mem_iff.mp h_in
    · push_neg at h_len
      have h_segs_nil : (polygonShrink P0 v s).segments = [] := by
        unfold Polygon.segments
        cases hverts : (polygonShrink P0 v s).vertices with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons v1 vs =>
          cases hvs : vs with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons w ws =>
            exfalso
            rw [hverts, hvs] at h_len
            simp at h_len
            omega
      rw [h_segs_nil] at hps
      simp at hps
  exact segment_dist_sq_le_max v ps.p1 ps.p2 q R
    (h_vert_bound ps.p1 h_p1_vert) (h_vert_bound ps.p2 h_p2_vert) hq

name: sum_indicator_swap
statement:
private theorem sum_indicator_swap (l1 : List LineSegment) (l2 : List LineSegment)
    (P : LineSegment → LineSegment → Bool) :
    (l1.map (fun a => (l2.map (fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)).sum =
    (l2.map (fun b => (l1.map (fun a => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    
    show (([] : List LineSegment).map fun a => (l2.map fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum).sum =
         (l2.map fun b => (([] : List LineSegment).map fun a => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum).sum
    rw [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    have h_l2_eq : (l2.map (fun b => (([] : List LineSegment).map fun a => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)) =
        l2.map (fun _ : LineSegment => (0:ℕ)) := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro b _; simp
    have h_sum_zero : (l2.map (fun _ : LineSegment => (0:ℕ))).sum = 0 := by
      induction l2 with
      | nil => simp
      | cons _ _ _ => simp
    rw [h_l2_eq, h_sum_zero]
  | cons a as ih =>
    
    
    have h_inner_cons : ∀ b : LineSegment,
        ((a :: as).map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum =
        (if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0) + (as.map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum := by
      intro b; simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    
    have h_map_eq : (l2.map (fun b => ((a :: as).map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)) =
        (l2.map (fun b => (if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0) +
                          (as.map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)) := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro b _; exact h_inner_cons b
    have h_rhs_eq : (l2.map (fun b => ((a :: as).map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)).sum =
        (l2.map (fun b => (if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0) +
                          (as.map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)).sum := by
      rw [h_map_eq]
    
    have h_sum_split : ∀ l2' : List LineSegment,
        (l2'.map (fun b => (if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0) +
                           (as.map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)).sum =
        (l2'.map (fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum +
        (l2'.map (fun b => (as.map fun a' => if P a' b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum)).sum := by
      intro l2'
      induction l2' with
      | nil => simp
      | cons b bs ih2 =>
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [ih2]
        ring
    
    rw [show ((a :: as).map fun a => (l2.map fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum).sum =
        (l2.map fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum +
        (as.map fun a => (l2.map fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0).sum).sum from
      by simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]]
    rw [ih, h_rhs_eq, h_sum_split]

name: sum_countP_swap
proof:
:= by
  have h_countP_eq : ∀ (l : List LineSegment) (Q : LineSegment → Bool),
      l.countP Q = (l.map (fun x => if Q x then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum := by
    intro l Q
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.countP_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [ih]
      by_cases hQ : Q x = true
      · rw [hQ]
        simp; omega
      · simp only [hQ]
        omega
  have h_lhs : (l1.map (fun a => l2.countP (P a))).sum =
      (l1.map (fun a => (l2.map (fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)).sum := by
    have heq : (l1.map (fun a => l2.countP (P a))) =
        (l1.map (fun a => (l2.map (fun b => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)) := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intros a _
      exact h_countP_eq l2 (P a)
    rw [heq]
  have h_rhs : (l2.map (fun b => l1.countP (fun a => P a b))).sum =
      (l2.map (fun b => (l1.map (fun a => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)).sum := by
    have heq : (l2.map (fun b => l1.countP (fun a => P a b))) =
        (l2.map (fun b => (l1.map (fun a => if P a b then (1:ℕ) else 0)).sum)) := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intros b _
      exact h_countP_eq l1 (fun a => P a b)
    rw [heq]
  rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
  exact sum_indicator_swap l1 l2 P

name: isEven_of_exists_interior_set
statement:
theorem isEven_of_exists_interior_set
    (G : Graph)
    (V_extra : Finset Vector2D)
    (S_extra : Finset LineSegment)
    (h_S_extra_nondeg : ∀ seg ∈ S_extra, seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2)
    (h_no_segment_interior_vertices : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices,
      (∀ seg ∈ G.segments, seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet) ∧
      (∀ seg ∈ S_extra, seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet))
    (h_exists : ∃ I : Set Vector2D,
      I ∩ G.toBoundarySet = ∅ ∧
      ∀ r : Ray,
        r.origin ∉ G.toBoundarySet →
        (∀ s ∈ S_extra, r.origin ∉ s.toSet) →
        rayAvoidsGraphVertices r G →
        (∀ v ∈ V_extra, v ∉ r.toSet) →
        (intersectionRayGraphSegmentsNumber r G % 2 = 1 ↔ r.origin ∈ I)) :
    G.IsEven
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI_disjoint, hI_property⟩ := h_exists
  
  let G_ext : Graph := G.append ⟨S_extra.toList, fun seg hseg =>
    h_S_extra_nondeg seg (Finset.mem_toList.mp hseg)⟩
  have hG_ext_segs : G_ext.segments = G.segments ++ S_extra.toList := rfl
  
  have h_mem_G_ext : ∀ seg, seg ∈ G_ext.segments ↔ seg ∈ G.segments ∨ seg ∈ S_extra := by
    intro seg
    rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_toList.mp h)
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_toList.mpr h)
  
  have h_GtV_sub_extV : ∀ v, v ∈ G.toVertices → v ∈ G_ext.toVertices := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Graph.toVertices, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons,
      (List.not_mem_nil _), or_false] at hv ⊢
    obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨seg, ?_, hh⟩
    rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inl hseg
  
  have h_no_segment_interior_vertices_ext : ∀ v ∈ G.toVertices, ∀ seg ∈ G_ext.segments,
      seg.p1 ≠ v → seg.p2 ≠ v → v ∉ seg.toSet := by
    intro v hv seg hseg hp1 hp2
    rcases (h_mem_G_ext seg).mp hseg with hG | hS
    · exact (h_no_segment_interior_vertices v hv).1 seg hG hp1 hp2
    · exact (h_no_segment_interior_vertices v hv).2 seg hS hp1 hp2
  intro v
  
  by_cases h_v_in : v ∈ G.toVertices
  · 
    
    
    have h_v_incident : ∃ seg ∈ G.segments, seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v := by
      simp only [Graph.toVertices, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons,
        (List.not_mem_nil _), or_false] at h_v_in
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := h_v_in
      refine ⟨seg, hseg, ?_⟩
      rcases hh with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h.symm
      · exact Or.inr h.symm
    have h_v_incident_ext : ∃ seg ∈ G_ext.segments, seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v := by
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := h_v_incident
      exact ⟨seg, by rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hseg, hh⟩
    
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_seg, hr_end⟩ :=
      exists_vertex_neighborhood_avoiding_non_incident G_ext v h_v_incident_ext
        (fun seg hseg => h_no_segment_interior_vertices_ext v h_v_in seg hseg)
    
    
    let rs_full : List Ray := raysFrom G_ext v
    have h_rs_full_origin : ∀ r ∈ rs_full, r.origin = v := by
      intro r hr; exact raysFrom_origin hr
    
    let rs : List Ray :=
      List.pwFilter (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet) rs_full
    have h_rs_sub : ∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ rs_full := List.pwFilter_subset _
    have h_rays_origin : ∀ r1 ∈ rs, ∀ r2 ∈ rs, sameOrigin r1 r2 := by
      intro r1 hr1 r2 hr2
      unfold sameOrigin
      rw [h_rs_full_origin r1 (h_rs_sub r1 hr1), h_rs_full_origin r2 (h_rs_sub r2 hr2)]
    have h_rays_distinct : rs.Pairwise (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet) :=
      List.pairwise_pwFilter _
    
    
    have h_rs_repr : ∀ r ∈ rs_full, ∃ r' ∈ rs, r.toSet = r'.toSet := by
      show ∀ r ∈ rs_full, ∃ r' ∈ List.pwFilter
        (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet) rs_full, r.toSet = r'.toSet
      generalize hL : rs_full = L
      clear hL
      intro r hr
      induction L with
      | nil => exact absurd hr (List.not_mem_nil _)
      | cons hd tl ih =>
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr_tl
        · 
          by_cases h_pos : ∀ b ∈ List.pwFilter (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet) tl,
              r.toSet ≠ b.toSet
          · 
            rw [List.pwFilter_cons_of_pos h_pos]
            exact ⟨r, (List.mem_cons_self _ _), rfl⟩
          · 
            rw [List.pwFilter_cons_of_neg h_pos]
            push_neg at h_pos
            obtain ⟨b, hb_mem, hb_eq⟩ := h_pos
            exact ⟨b, hb_mem, hb_eq⟩
        · 
          obtain ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩ := ih hr_tl
          by_cases h_pos : ∀ b ∈ List.pwFilter (fun r1 r2 => r1.toSet ≠ r2.toSet) tl,
              hd.toSet ≠ b.toSet
          · rw [List.pwFilter_cons_of_pos h_pos]
            exact ⟨r', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩
          · rw [List.pwFilter_cons_of_neg h_pos]
            exact ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩
    
    obtain ⟨P0, h_P0_avoid, h_P0_unique_seg, h_P0_hit, h_P0_unique_ray, h_P0_line_avoid_v,
        h_P0_segs_nodup⟩ :=
      exists_polygon_separating_rays rs h_rays_origin h_rays_distinct
    
    have h_G_ray_repr : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v →
        ∃ r' ∈ rs, (rayFrom v w h_ne).toSet = r'.toSet := by
      intro w h_ne hw
      have hw_ext : w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G_ext v := by
        rw [mem_incidentOtherEndpoints] at hw ⊢
        obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := hw
        exact ⟨seg, by rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hseg, hh⟩
      have h_in_full : rayFrom v w h_ne ∈ rs_full := by
        rw [mem_raysFrom]; exact ⟨w, hw_ext, h_ne, rfl⟩
      exact h_rs_repr _ h_in_full
    
    
    have h_P0_avoid_anyG : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v →
        ∀ p0 ∈ P0.vertices, p0 ∉ (rayFrom v w h_ne).toSet := by
      intro w h_ne hw p0 hp0 hp0_in
      obtain ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩ := h_G_ray_repr h_ne hw
      have : p0 ∈ r'.toSet := by rw [← hr'_eq]; exact hp0_in
      exact h_P0_avoid p0 hp0 r' hr'_mem this
    
    have h_P0_hit_G : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v →
        ∃ ps0 ∈ P0.segments, rayIntersectsSegment (rayFrom v w h_ne) ps0 := by
      intro w h_ne hw
      obtain ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩ := h_G_ray_repr h_ne hw
      obtain ⟨ps0, hps0, hint⟩ := h_P0_hit r' hr'_mem
      refine ⟨ps0, hps0, ?_⟩
      rw [rayIntersectsSegment] at hint ⊢
      obtain ⟨q, hq_r', hq_ps0⟩ := hint
      refine ⟨q, ?_, hq_ps0⟩
      rw [hr'_eq]; exact hq_r'
    
    have h_P0_unique_ray_G : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v →
        ∀ ps1 ∈ P0.segments, ∀ ps2 ∈ P0.segments,
          rayIntersectsSegment (rayFrom v w h_ne) ps1 →
          rayIntersectsSegment (rayFrom v w h_ne) ps2 → ps1 = ps2 := by
      intro w h_ne hw ps1 hps1 ps2 hps2 hint1 hint2
      obtain ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩ := h_G_ray_repr h_ne hw
      have hint1' : rayIntersectsSegment r' ps1 := by
        obtain ⟨q, hq_r, hq_ps⟩ := hint1
        exact ⟨q, by rw [← hr'_eq]; exact hq_r, hq_ps⟩
      have hint2' : rayIntersectsSegment r' ps2 := by
        obtain ⟨q, hq_r, hq_ps⟩ := hint2
        exact ⟨q, by rw [← hr'_eq]; exact hq_r, hq_ps⟩
      exact h_P0_unique_ray r' hr'_mem ps1 hps1 ps2 hps2 hint1' hint2'
    
    have h_S_ray_repr : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        (∃ s ∈ S_extra, otherEndpoint v s = some w) →
        ∃ r' ∈ rs, (rayFrom v w h_ne).toSet = r'.toSet := by
      intro w h_ne hw
      obtain ⟨s, hs_in, hs_op⟩ := hw
      have hw_ext : w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G_ext v := by
        rw [mem_incidentOtherEndpoints]
        refine ⟨s, ?_, hs_op⟩
        rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]
        right; exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr hs_in
      have h_in_full : rayFrom v w h_ne ∈ rs_full := by
        rw [mem_raysFrom]; exact ⟨w, hw_ext, h_ne, rfl⟩
      exact h_rs_repr _ h_in_full
    have h_P0_avoid_anyS : ∀ {w : Vector2D} (h_ne : w ≠ v),
        (∃ s ∈ S_extra, otherEndpoint v s = some w) →
        ∀ p0 ∈ P0.vertices, p0 ∉ (rayFrom v w h_ne).toSet := by
      intro w h_ne hw p0 hp0 hp0_in
      obtain ⟨r', hr'_mem, hr'_eq⟩ := h_S_ray_repr h_ne hw
      have : p0 ∈ r'.toSet := by rw [← hr'_eq]; exact hp0_in
      exact h_P0_avoid p0 hp0 r' hr'_mem this
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_inc_ne_nil : incidentOtherEndpoints G v ≠ [] := by
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := h_v_incident
      have h_op : (otherEndpoint v seg).isSome := by
        unfold otherEndpoint
        rcases hh with h | h
        · rw [if_pos h]; rfl
        · have hp1_ne : seg.p1 ≠ v := by
            intro hh'
            apply G.segments_nondegenerate seg hseg
            rw [hh', h]
          rw [if_neg hp1_ne, if_pos h]; rfl
      obtain ⟨w, hw_eq⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h_op
      intro h_emp
      have h_w_in : w ∈ G.segments.filterMap (otherEndpoint v) := by
        rw [List.mem_filterMap]
        exact ⟨seg, hseg, hw_eq⟩
      have : w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v := by
        unfold incidentOtherEndpoints
        rw [List.mem_dedup]
        exact h_w_in
      rw [h_emp] at this
      simp at this
    
    
    have h_inc_exists : ∃ w ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v, w ≠ v := by
      have h_ne := h_inc_ne_nil
      generalize h_l : incidentOtherEndpoints G v = inc_list at *
      cases inc_list with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl h_ne
      | cons w ws =>
        refine ⟨w, (List.mem_cons_self _ _), ?_⟩
        apply otherEndpoint_ne_v
        rw [h_l]; exact (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    obtain ⟨w0, hw0_in, hw0_ne⟩ := h_inc_exists
    
    have hw0_in_ext : w0 ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G_ext v := by
      rw [mem_incidentOtherEndpoints] at hw0_in ⊢
      obtain ⟨seg, hseg, hh⟩ := hw0_in
      exact ⟨seg, by rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hseg, hh⟩
    set r0_orig := rayFrom v w0 hw0_ne with hr0_orig_def
    have hr0_orig_in_full : r0_orig ∈ rs_full := by
      rw [mem_raysFrom]; exact ⟨w0, hw0_in_ext, hw0_ne, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨r0, hr0_mem, hr0_eq⟩ := h_rs_repr r0_orig hr0_orig_in_full
    
    have hr0_origin_eq_v : r0.origin = v := h_rs_full_origin r0 (h_rs_sub r0 hr0_mem)
    have hr0_origin : r0.origin = v := hr0_origin_eq_v
    have h_v_off_P0_lines : ∀ ps0 ∈ P0.segments, ∀ t : ℚ,
        ¬ (v.x = (1-t)*ps0.p1.x + t*ps0.p2.x ∧ v.y = (1-t)*ps0.p1.y + t*ps0.p2.y) := by
      intro ps0 hps0 t
      have := h_P0_line_avoid_v ps0 hps0 r0 hr0_mem t
      rw [hr0_origin] at this
      exact this
    
    have h_P0_verts_ne_v : ∀ p ∈ P0.vertices, p ≠ v := by
      intro p hp h_eq
      
      
      have h_p_in_v : p ∈ r0.toSet := by
        rw [h_eq, ← hr0_origin]
        refine ⟨0, le_refl _, ?_, ?_⟩
        · ring
        · ring
      exact h_P0_avoid p hp r0 hr0_mem h_p_in_v
    
    set M := listMaxSqDist v P0.vertices + 1 with hM_def
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by
      have := listMaxSqDist_ge_zero v P0.vertices
      linarith
    
    
    set verts_to_avoid : List Vector2D :=
      G.toVertices ++ V_extra.toList with hverts_to_avoid_def
    
    set bad_line := badShrinkFinset P0 verts_to_avoid v with hbad_line_def
    
    
    
    
    
    let candidateShrinkEq : Vector2D → Vector2D → ℚ := fun p0 w =>
      if p0.x = v.x then
        if p0.y = v.y then 0  
        else (w.y - v.y) / (p0.y - v.y)
      else (w.x - v.x) / (p0.x - v.x)
    set bad_pt : Finset ℚ :=
      ((P0.vertices.product V_extra.toList).map
        (fun p => candidateShrinkEq p.1 p.2)).toFinset with hbad_pt_def
    set bad : Finset ℚ := bad_line ∪ bad_pt with hbad_def
    
    
    set q_upper := r / (2 * (M + 1)) with hq_def
    have hq_upper_pos : 0 < q_upper := by
      apply div_pos hr_pos
      have : 0 < M + 1 := by linarith
      linarith
    
    set q_upper' := min q_upper 1 with hq'_def
    have hq_upper'_pos : 0 < q_upper' := by
      apply lt_min hq_upper_pos
      norm_num
    
    obtain ⟨s_f, hs_f_lb, hs_f_ub, hs_f_bad⟩ :=
      exists_rat_in_ioo_avoid 0 q_upper' hq_upper'_pos bad
    have hs_f_pos : 0 < s_f := hs_f_lb
    have hs_f_lt_q : s_f < q_upper := lt_of_lt_of_le hs_f_ub (min_le_left _ _)
    have hs_f_le_one : s_f ≤ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs_f_ub (min_le_right _ _))
    
    have h_sf_M1_lt : s_f * (M + 1) < r / 2 := by
      have h_M1_pos : 0 < M + 1 := by linarith
      rw [hq_def] at hs_f_lt_q
      
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < 2 * (M + 1))).mp hs_f_lt_q
      
      nlinarith
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_sf_sq_M_lt : s_f^2 * M < r^2 / 4 := by
      have h_M1_pos : 0 < M + 1 := by linarith
      have h1 : s_f * (M + 1) < r / 2 := h_sf_M1_lt
      
      have h_sf_sq_nn : 0 ≤ s_f^2 := by positivity
      have h_M_le : M ≤ M + 1 := by linarith
      have h2 : s_f^2 * M ≤ s_f^2 * (M + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_M_le h_sf_sq_nn
      
      
      have h3 : s_f * (s_f * (M + 1)) < s_f * (r / 2) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 hs_f_pos
      have h_eq : s_f * (s_f * (M + 1)) = s_f^2 * (M + 1) := by ring
      rw [h_eq] at h3
      
      
      have h4 : s_f * (r / 2) < (r / (2 * (M + 1))) * (r / 2) := by
        rw [hq_def] at hs_f_lt_q
        have : 0 < r / 2 := by linarith
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs_f_lt_q this
      have h5 : (r / (2 * (M + 1))) * (r / 2) = r^2 / (4 * (M + 1)) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [h5] at h4
      have h6 : r^2 / (4 * (M + 1)) ≤ r^2 / 4 := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
        · positivity
        · linarith
        · linarith
      linarith
    
    set P := polygonShrink P0 v s_f with hP_def
    
    
    have h_listMax : ∀ p ∈ P0.vertices, (p.x - v.x)^2 + (p.y - v.y)^2 ≤ M := by
      intro p hp
      have := listMaxSqDist_ge v P0.vertices p hp
      have : listMaxSqDist v P0.vertices ≤ M := by linarith [hM_def]
      linarith [listMaxSqDist_ge v P0.vertices p hp]
    have h_vert_bound : ∀ q ∈ P.vertices, (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 ≤ s_f^2 * M := by
      intro q hq
      have h_R : s_f^2 * M ≤ s_f^2 * M := le_refl _
      apply polygonShrink_vertex_dist_sq_le P0 v s_f M (s_f^2 * M) h_listMax h_R
      · linarith [listMaxSqDist_ge_zero v P0.vertices]
      · positivity
      exact hq
    have h_seg_bound : ∀ ps ∈ P.segments, ∀ q ∈ ps.toSet,
        (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 ≤ s_f^2 * M := by
      intro ps hps q hq
      exact polygonShrink_segment_dist_sq_le P0 v s_f (s_f^2 * M) h_vert_bound ps hps q hq
    
    have h_sf_sq_M_lt_rsq : s_f^2 * M < r^2 := by
      have hr_sq_pos : 0 < r^2 := by positivity
      nlinarith
    
    
    
    
    have h_polylines_combined : ∀ ps ∈ P.segments, ∀ w ∈ verts_to_avoid, ∀ t : ℚ,
        ¬ (w.x = (1-t)*ps.p1.x + t*ps.p2.x ∧ w.y = (1-t)*ps.p1.y + t*ps.p2.y) := by
      intro ps hps w hw t hcontra
      
      rw [polygonShrink_segments] at hps
      rw [List.mem_map] at hps
      obtain ⟨ps0, hps0, hps_eq⟩ := hps
      
      rw [← hps_eq] at hcontra
      
      
      
      
      by_cases h_p1p2 : ps0.p1 = ps0.p2
      · 
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        exfalso

    have h_polylines_vextra : ∀ ps ∈ P.segments, ∀ w ∈ V_extra, ∀ t : ℚ,
        ¬ (w.x = (1-t)*ps.p1.x + t*ps.p2.x ∧ w.y = (1-t)*ps.p1.y + t*ps.p2.y) := by
      intro ps hps w hw
      apply h_polylines_combined ps hps w
      rw [hverts_to_avoid_def, List.mem_append]
      right; exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr hw
    
    have h_sum_even : (P.segments.map fun ps => polysegCrossingsCount ps G).sum % 2 = 0 :=
      polygon_walk_count_even_no_nondegen P G I V_extra S_extra
        h_polylines h_polylines_vextra h_polyverts_off h_polyverts_off_sextra hI_property
    
    
    have h_swap : (P.segments.map fun ps => polysegCrossingsCount ps G).sum =
        (G.segments.map fun seg =>
          P.segments.countP (fun ps => decide (ps.toSet ∩ seg.toSet).Nonempty)).sum := by
      unfold polysegCrossingsCount
      exact sum_countP_swap P.segments G.segments
        (fun ps seg => decide (ps.toSet ∩ seg.toSet).Nonempty)
    
    have h_shrink_inj : Function.Injective (shrinkPoint v s_f) := by
      intro a b h
      simp only [shrinkPoint] at h
      have hsf_ne : s_f ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_f_pos
      have hx : a.x = b.x := by
        have hh := congrArg Vector2D.x h
        simp only at hh
        have h1 : s_f * a.x = s_f * b.x := by linarith
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hsf_ne h1
      have hy : a.y = b.y := by
        have hh := congrArg Vector2D.y h
        simp only at hh
        have h1 : s_f * a.y = s_f * b.y := by linarith
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hsf_ne h1
      exact Vector2D.ext hx hy
    
    have h_P_segs_nodup : P.segments.Nodup := by
      rw [hP_def, polygonShrink_segments]
      apply List.Nodup.map _ h_P0_segs_nodup
      
      intro a b h
      have h1 : shrinkPoint v s_f a.p1 = shrinkPoint v s_f b.p1 := by
        have := congrArg LineSegment.p1 h
        exact this
      have h2 : shrinkPoint v s_f a.p2 = shrinkPoint v s_f b.p2 := by
        have := congrArg LineSegment.p2 h
        exact this
      have hp1 : a.p1 = b.p1 := h_shrink_inj h1
      have hp2 : a.p2 = b.p2 := h_shrink_inj h2
      cases a; cases b; simp at hp1 hp2; subst hp1; subst hp2; rfl
    
    have h_per_seg : ∀ seg ∈ G.segments,
        P.segments.countP (fun ps => decide (ps.toSet ∩ seg.toSet).Nonempty) =
          if seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v then 1 else 0 := by
      intro seg hseg
      by_cases h_inc : seg.p1 = v ∨ seg.p2 = v
      · rw [if_pos h_inc]
        
        have h_segP1_ne_p2 : seg.p1 ≠ seg.p2 := G.segments_nondegenerate seg hseg
        
        by_cases h_p1v : seg.p1 = v
        · 
          have hw_ne : seg.p2 ≠ v := fun h => h_segP1_ne_p2 (by rw [h_p1v, h])
          have hw_in_inc : seg.p2 ∈ incidentOtherEndpoints G v := by
            rw [mem_incidentOtherEndpoints]
            refine ⟨seg, hseg, ?_⟩
            unfold otherEndpoint; rw [if_pos h_p1v]
          have h_seg_eq_v_w : ∀ q, q ∈ seg.toSet ↔ q ∈ (LineSegment.mk v seg.p2).toSet := by
            intro q
            constructor
            · intro hq
              obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hqx, hqy⟩ := hq
              refine ⟨t, ht0, ht1, ?_, ?_⟩
              · simp; rw [hqx, h_p1v]
              · simp; rw [hqy, h_p1v]
            · intro hq
              obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hqx, hqy⟩ := hq
              simp at hqx hqy
              refine ⟨t, ht0, ht1, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [hqx, h_p1v]
              · rw [hqy, h_p1v]
          have hseg_sub_ray : seg.toSet ⊆ (rayFrom v seg.p2 hw_ne).toSet := by
            intro q hq
            obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hqx, hqy⟩ := hq
            rw [mem_rayFrom]
            refine ⟨t, ht0, ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [hqx, h_p1v]; ring
            · rw [hqy, h_p1v]; ring
          
          set w := seg.p2 with hw_def
          set r_w := rayFrom v w hw_ne with hr_w_def
          obtain ⟨ps0, hps0, hps0_int⟩ := h_P0_hit_G hw_ne hw_in_inc
          set ps_target : LineSegment :=
            ⟨shrinkPoint v s_f ps0.p1, shrinkPoint v s_f ps0.p2⟩ with hps_t_def
          have h_ps_target_in_P : ps_target ∈ P.segments := by
            rw [hP_def, polygonShrink_segments]
            exact List.mem_map_of_mem _ hps0
          
          have h_target_int : (ps_target.toSet ∩ seg.toSet).Nonempty := by
            have h_line_avoid_v_ps0 := h_v_off_P0_lines ps0 hps0
            have h_iff := rayFromV_intersects_shrunken_iff v w hw_ne ps0 s_f hs_f_pos h_line_avoid_v_ps0
            have h_r_w_int_target : rayIntersectsSegment r_w ps_target := h_iff.mp hps0_int
            obtain ⟨q, hq_ray, hq_target⟩ := h_r_w_int_target
            have h_q_dist_lt : (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 < r^2 / 4 := by
              have h_q_dist_le := h_seg_bound ps_target h_ps_target_in_P q hq_target
              nlinarith
            have h_w_dist_ge : r^2 ≤ (w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2 := by
              have h_endcase : w = seg.p1 ∨ w = seg.p2 := Or.inr rfl
              have hseg_ext : seg ∈ G_ext.segments := by
                rw [hG_ext_segs, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hseg
              exact hr_end seg hseg_ext w h_endcase hw_ne
            rw [mem_rayFrom] at hq_ray
            obtain ⟨t, ht0, hqx_ray, hqy_ray⟩ := hq_ray
            have h_qx_minus : q.x - v.x = t * (w.x - v.x) := by linarith
            have h_qy_minus : q.y - v.y = t * (w.y - v.y) := by linarith
            have h_dist_sq_eq : (q.x - v.x)^2 + (q.y - v.y)^2 =
                t^2 * ((w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2) := by
              rw [h_qx_minus, h_qy_minus]; ring
            have h_w_v_sq_pos : 0 < (w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2 := by
              have : 0 < r^2 := by positivity
              linarith
            have h_t_sq_lt : t^2 < 1 := by
              have h_lt : t^2 * ((w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2) < r^2 / 4 := by
                rw [← h_dist_sq_eq]; exact h_q_dist_lt
              
              have h_r2_pos : 0 < r^2 := by positivity
              have h_lt2 : t^2 * ((w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2) < ((w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2) := by
                have : r^2 / 4 < r^2 := by linarith
                have : r^2 / 4 < (w.x - v.x)^2 + (w.y - v.y)^2 := by linarith
                linarith
              
              have := h_lt2
              nlinarith [h_w_v_sq_pos]
            have h_t_lt_one : t ≤ 1 := by
              by_contra h
              push_neg at h
              have : 1 ≤ t^2 := by nlinarith
              linarith
            refine ⟨q, hq_target, ?_⟩
            rw [h_seg_eq_v_w]
